articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

articles.title: Crash Champions Expands to Rhode Island, Acquires AutoPaint RI
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Crash Champions has announced its expansion to Rhode Island, the company’s 39th state. The announcement comes following the successful acquisition of AutoPaint RI, a high-quality collision repair center that previously served local customers as part of the New England division of Tasca Automotive Group.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 宣布将业务扩展到该公司的第 39 个州罗德岛州。该公告是在成功收购 AutoPaint RI 后发布的，AutoPaint RI 是一家高质量的碰撞修复中心，之前作为 Tasca 汽车集团新英格兰部门的一部分为当地客户提供服务。

paras.en: The I-CAR Gold Class facility is located at 47 Stamp Farm Road in Cranston, and begins operating as Crash Champions effective immediately.
paras.zh: I-CAR 黄金级设施位于克兰斯顿 Stamp Farm Road 47 号，并立即开始作为碰撞冠军运营。

paras.en: The nearly 20,000-square-foot collision repair center features approximately 16,550 square feet of dedicated production space, providing significant repair capacity to support customers and business partners throughout the region.
paras.zh: 占地近 20,000 平方英尺的碰撞维修中心拥有约 16,550 平方英尺的专用生产空间，提供强大的维修能力，为整个地区的客户和业务合作伙伴提供支持。

paras.en: As one of the most trusted comprehensive collision repair brands by both customers and automotive insurance carriers, all Crash Champions repairs are backed by a lifetime guarantee. Crash Champions also offers customers the convenience of flexible payment options through its recently launched Fix Now, Pay Later service.
paras.zh: 作为客户和汽车保险公司最值得信赖的综合碰撞维修品牌之一，所有 Crash Champions 维修均享有终身保修。 Crash Champions 还通过其最近推出的“立即修复，稍后付款”服务为客户提供灵活的支付选项。

paras.en: “Expanding into Rhode Island is an exciting milestone for Crash Champions as we continue to strengthen our nationwide footprint,” said Matt Ebert, founder and CEO of Crash Champions. “AutoPaint RI has built a strong reputation for quality repairs and customer service, making it a natural fit for our organization. We look forward to serving customers across the state while creating new opportunities for team members and industry professionals in the market.”
paras.zh: Crash Champions 创始人兼首席执行官马特·埃伯特 (Matt Ebert) 表示：“随着我们继续加强我们在全国范围内的业务，扩展到罗德岛州对于 Crash Champions 来说是一个令人兴奋的里程碑。” “AutoPaint RI 在优质维修和客户服务方面建立了良好的声誉，使其非常适合我们的组织。我们期待为全州的客户提供服务，同时为市场上的团队成员和行业专业人士创造新的机会。”

paras.en: Recently certified as a Great Place To Work, Crash Champions operates more than 650 repair centers across 39 states and continues to create opportunities for professionals interested in building rewarding careers within the collision repair industry.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 最近被认证为最佳工作场所，在 39 个州运营着 650 多个维修中心，并继续为有兴趣在碰撞维修行业建立高回报职业的专业人士创造机会。

paras.en: To explore career opportunities with Crash Champions, visit careers.crashchampions.com.
paras.zh: 要探索 Crash Champions 的职业机会，请访问 Careers.crashchampions.com。

paras.en: For more information on Crash Champions, visit www.crashchampions.com.
paras.zh: 有关碰撞冠军的更多信息，请访问 www.crashchampions.com。

paras.en: Trackhawk Advisors advised Tasca Automotive Group in the sale.
paras.zh: Trackhawk Advisors 在此次出售中为 Tasca Automotive Group 提供咨询服务。

articles.title: European Commission Approves AkzoNobel and Axalta Merger of Equals
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: AkzoNobel N.V. and Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. received conditional approval from the European Commission (EU) for their proposed all-stock merger of equals. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027, subject to pending regulatory approvals.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔 N.V. 和艾仕得涂料系统有限公司 (Axalta Coating Systems Ltd.) 的全股票对等合并提议获得了欧盟委员会 (EU) 有条件批准。该交易预计将于 2027 年初完成，尚待监管部门批准。

paras.en: Following discussions with the EU, the companies agreed to a targeted remedy involving the divestment of AkzoNobel’s European vehicle refinish business.
paras.zh: 在与欧盟讨论后，两家公司同意采取有针对性的补救措施，包括剥离阿克苏诺贝尔的欧洲汽车修补漆业务。

paras.en: Competition Commitments and Market Scope
paras.zh: 竞争承诺及市场范围

paras.en: The commitments offered address the preliminary competition concerns identified by the EU by removing the horizontal overlap between the companies’ activities in the European Economic Area, UK and Switzerland. No other competition issues were identified by the EU in any other markets.
paras.zh: 这些承诺通过消除欧洲经济区、英国和瑞士公司活动之间的横向重叠来解决欧盟确定的初步竞争问题。欧盟在任何其他市场都没有发现其他竞争问题。

paras.en: This outcome will preserve the same level of competition and customer choice in the vehicle refinish coatings market in Europe while maintaining the strategic benefits of the merger on the overall deal.
paras.zh: 这一结果将在欧洲汽车修补漆市场保持相同水平的竞争和客户选择，同时保持合并对整体交易的战略利益。

paras.en: The combination will bring together coatings companies with complementary portfolios, technologies and brands, creating a global coatings company with approximately $17 billion in revenue. The portfolio spans Powder Coatings, Aerospace Coatings, Refinish, Mobility, Marine and Protective Coatings, Industrial Coatings and Decorative Coatings.
paras.zh: 此次合并将汇集具有互补产品组合、技术和品牌的涂料公司，创建一家年收入约 170 亿美元的全球涂料公司。产品组合涵盖粉末涂料、航空航天涂料、修补漆、机动性、船舶和防护涂料、工业涂料和装饰涂料。

paras.en: “Receiving the European Commission’s approval is an important milestone as we move closer to completing our merger with Axalta,” said Greg Poux-Guillaume, CEO of AkzoNobel, who will serve as CEO of the combined company. “We’re well on track and look forward to bringing together our complementary technologies, expertise and talented teams to accelerate growth.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔首席执行官格雷格·普吉约姆 (Greg Poux-Guillaume) 表示：“随着我们距离完成与艾仕得的合并越来越近，获得欧盟委员会的批准是一个重要的里程碑。”他将担任合并后公司的首席执行官。 “我们一切顺利，期待将我们互补的技术、专业知识和才华横溢的团队结合在一起，以加速增长。”

paras.en: Added Chris Villavarayan, CEO and president of Axalta who will serve as Deputy CEO of the combined company, “We are pleased that the European Commission has approved the transaction. Together we will be better positioned to serve our customers around the world, accelerate investment in differentiated technologies and create a global leader in coatings with scale, innovation and capabilities to shape the future of our industry.”
paras.zh: 艾仕得首席执行官兼总裁 Chris Villavarayan 补充道，他将担任合并后公司的副首席执行官，“我们很高兴欧盟委员会批准了这项交易。我们将共同更好地为世界各地的客户提供服务，加快对差异化技术的投资，并打造一家具有规模、创新和能力的全球涂料领导者，塑造我们行业的未来。”

articles.title: MSO CEOs on the right people for the right jobs, and some industry misconceptions
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: This year’s MSO Symposium brought together “the Four Aces” — the CEOs of Boyd Group, Caliber, Classic Collision, and Crash Champions —in Las Vegas on Monday, who ultimately landed on a simple conclusion: the collision repair industry depends on the right people fitting into the right roles.
paras.zh: 今年的 MSO 研讨会周一在拉斯维加斯汇聚了“四大王牌”——Boyd Group、Calibre、Classic Collision 和 Crash Champions 的首席执行官，他们最终得出了一个简单的结论：碰撞修复行业取决于合适的人担任合适的角色。

paras.en: When moderator Dan Risley asked what they’re hearing from investors and other stakeholders about the industry today, Boyd Group CEO Brian Kaner responded that the industry isn’t “recession-proof, but it is recession-resilient.”
paras.zh: 当主持人丹·里斯利 (Dan Risley) 询问投资者和其他利益相关者今天对这个行业有何看法时，博伊德集团 (Boyd Group) 首席执行官布莱恩·卡纳 (Brian Kaner) 回答说，该行业“不能抵御衰退，但具有抵御衰退的能力”。

paras.en: “There are plenty of opportunities for us to continue to grow our businesses,” he said. “It all comes down to making sure you have the right people in the right roles with the right capabilities. And if you have that and you know how to keep score and you can win with the insurance carriers and you can take care of their customers and really be the extension of what they’re looking for, this is a great business to be in, and it’s something that we can continue to all thrive in.”
paras.zh: “我们有很多机会继续发展我们的业务，”他说。 “这一切都归结于确保你有合适的人担任合适的角色，并具有合适的能力。如果你具备这一点，你知道如何得分，你就可以赢得保险公司的青睐，你可以照顾他们的客户，真正成为他们所寻求的延伸，这是一个伟大的行业，我们可以继续在其中蓬勃发展。”

paras.en: However, in response to a different question Risley posed about the “temperature” of each MSO’s team leaders, Crash Champions CEO Matt Ebert and Kaner agreed it’s a tense, stressful time for them, and made some important points about estimators.
paras.zh: 然而，在回答里斯利提出的关于每个 MSO 团队领导者“温度”的不同问题时，Crash Champions 首席执行官马特·埃伯特 (Matt Ebert) 和卡纳 (Kaner) 一致认为，这对他们来说是一个紧张、有压力的时期，并提出了一些关于估算器的重要观点。

paras.en: Ebert said being an estimator, or as Crash Champions calls them, a service advisor, “has to be one of the most miserable spots.”
paras.zh: 埃伯特说，作为一名估算员，或者正如 Crash Champions 所说的那样，一名服务顾问，“一定是最悲惨的地方之一。”

paras.en: “You’ve got technicians bitching at you, you’ve got management or ownership bitching at you, you’ve got insurance companies bitching at you,” he said. “Everything you do gets criticized. Everything you do gets reviewed and sent back, and you have to do it again. I wouldn’t last a week. I would quit that job and tell you to shove it up your a**. If you want to know the temperature of our people, that is the truth.”
paras.zh: “技术人员对你发牢骚，管理层或所有权对你发牢骚，保险公司对你发牢骚，”他说。 “你所做的一切都会受到批评。你所做的一切都会受到审查并被退回，你必须再做一次。我撑不了一个星期。我会辞掉那份工作，并告诉你把它推到你的**。如果你想知道我们人民的温度，那就是事实。“

paras.en: Ebert added that general managers also face pressure to keep customers, employees, and insurance companies happy while trying to make money and handle the safety, legal, and logistical pieces of their jobs.
paras.zh: 埃伯特补充说，总经理在努力赚钱并处理工作中的安全、法律和后勤事务的同时，还面临着让客户、员工和保险公司满意的压力。

paras.en: Kaner said the industry has a “compelling opportunity” to invest in people.
paras.zh: 坎纳表示，该行业有一个“令人信服的机会”来投资于人才。

paras.en: “You’ve got to make investments in estimators,” he said. “We all make investments in technicians. I think one of the bigger gaps we have as an industry right now is in estimators. There’s not enough of them. There’s not enough of them that understand the metrics. There’s not enough of them that are salespeople that can go help actually go sell a consumer-paid job. …it’s a tense time and anytime when you’re in an environment where volume is tight, it just ups the pressure of the organization.”
paras.zh: “你必须对估算师进行投资，”他说。 “我们都对技术人员进行了投资。我认为，我们这个行业目前最大的差距之一是估算人员。他们的数量不够。了解指标的人也不够多。能够真正帮助销售消费者付费工作的销售人员也不够。……这是一个紧张的时期，任何时候当你处于一个工作量紧张的环境中时，它只会增加组织的压力。”

paras.en: Brad Anderson, who joined the collision repair industry in June to take over as CEO of Classic Collision, said he believes all jobs in the industry are hard.
paras.zh: 布拉德·安德森 (Brad Anderson) 于 6 月加入碰撞修复行业，接任 Classic Collision 首席执行官，他表示，他认为该行业的所有工作都很辛苦。

paras.en: “We put a lot on them, and I think all of us as an industry and ecosystem have to consider that it all crashes down to the people at the shop,” he said. “The small changes we make up here get really big when there’s 20 changes happening to the individual, whether it’s a tech, a GM, a service advisor, so we’ve got to simplify the work.”
paras.zh: “我们在这些方面投入了很多，我认为作为一个行业和生态系统，我们所有人都必须考虑到这一切都会归咎于店里的人，”他说。 “当个人发生 20 项变化时，无论是技术人员、总经理还是服务顾问，我们在这里所做的小改变都会变得非常大，所以我们必须简化工作。”

paras.en: During the discussion, Ebert also noted that 40-50% of MSO employees don’t touch a car, which he said “presents huge administrative opportunity,” another point he and Kaner agreed on.
paras.zh: 在讨论中，埃伯特还指出，40-50% 的 MSO 员工不碰汽车，他说这“提供了巨大的管理机会”，这是他和坎纳同意的另一点。

paras.en: “We have 15,000 people in our organization, and half of them are technicians and the other half are the people that are just trying to get the car to the back and do all the administrative things that they need to do to get it there,” Kaner said.
paras.zh: “我们的组织中有 15,000 名员工，其中一半是技术人员，另一半只是想把汽车开到后面，并完成所有需要做的行政工作，”卡纳说。

paras.en: The conversation also touched on declining repairable claims volume, with Risley asking what’s missing from that narrative.
paras.zh: 谈话还谈到了可修复索赔数量的下降，里斯利询问这种叙述中遗漏了什么。

paras.en: Caliber CEO David Simmons said the overall picture on repairable claims is probably a little more positive than the data that’s often quoted, “even though it is bad.” The primary misleading point, he said, is repairable claims data being viewed as representative of the market.
paras.zh: Calibre 首席执行官戴维·西蒙斯 (David Simmons) 表示，可修复索赔的总体情况可能比经常引用的数据要乐观一些，“尽管情况很糟糕。”他说，主要的误导点是可修复索赔数据被视为市场的代表。

paras.en: “If you allow yourself to be defined by repairable claims volumes, you have 30 years of history of insurance premium inflation in one year followed by claims frequency 12 to 18 months later,” he said. “And the pattern recognition in that 30-year data set would show that when you get into mid- to low-single-digit insurance premium inflation, which we’ve been in for several quarters now, you have a lag to low- to mid-single-digit claims frequency increase. There’s reasons for optimism that the old pattern holds, kind of offset by a structural shift with consumers because of the shock factor of insurance premium inflation.”
paras.zh: 他说：“如果你用可修复的索赔数量来定义自己，那么一年内保险费上涨的历史已有 30 年，随后 12 至 18 个月后索赔频率也随之增加。” “30年数据集中的模式识别表明，当保费通胀处于中低个位数时（我们已经经历了几个季度），索赔频率的增长会滞后于低个位数至中个位数。旧模式保持乐观的理由是存在的，但由于保费通胀的冲击因素，消费者的结构性转变在一定程度上抵消了这种变化。”

paras.en: However, outside of insurance claims, one point remains: people are still getting their cars repaired, but they’re paying out of pocket, he said.
paras.zh: 然而，除了保险索赔之外，还有一点仍然存在：人们仍在修理汽车，但他们要自掏腰包，他说。

paras.en: “We don’t track the juxtaposition of [the] increase in the dollar value of direct customer pay against the decrease in repairable claims and the dollar value of that,” Simmons said. “If you look at that, the total market has come down, but it’s a lot different dynamic. Now we’re built to service the insurance carrier, so it requires some adaptation to get at this customer pay. But if you want, we have to adapt, but if one’s willing to adapt, that market segment is there, and it’s growing, it’s growing robustly.”
paras.zh: 西蒙斯说：“我们没有跟踪直接客户支付的美元价值的增加与可修复索赔的减少及其美元价值的并列。” “如果你看一下，整个市场已经下降，但情况却有很大不同。现在我们是为保险公司服务的，所以需要进行一些调整才能获得客户的付费。但如果你愿意，我们就必须适应，但如果有人愿意适应，这个细分市场就在那里，而且它正在增长，正在强劲增长。”

paras.en: Simmons said he would love to see Mitchell and CCC “come together with a combined audited data set that is as close to accurate as possible on what’s really going on with claims, total losses, repairable claims, and segments of claims.”
paras.zh: 西蒙斯表示，他希望看到米切尔和 CCC“提供一个经过审计的综合数据集，该数据集尽可能准确地了解索赔、总损失、可修复索赔和索赔部分的实际情况。”

paras.en: Kaner said he thinks one thing people miss is that what’s happening in the industry isn’t all that different from what’s been happening.
paras.zh: 坎纳说，他认为人们错过的一件事是，行业中正在发生的事情与正在发生的事情并没有太大不同。

paras.en: “It’s like any ecosystem; something that happens can have a negative effect downstream, and this industry has the same thing,” he said.
paras.zh: “就像任何生态系统一样；发生的事情可能会对下游产生负面影响，这个行业也有同样的情况，”他说。

paras.en: In this case, “a very precipitous increase in premiums that then put consumers on heightened alert,” Kaner said, causing them to raise their deductibles, drop coverage, or not file a claim for fear of a large premium increase.
paras.zh: 坎纳说，在这种情况下，“保费急剧增加，然后让消费者提高警惕”，导致他们提高免赔额、降低承保范围，或者因为担心保费大幅增加而不提出索赔。

paras.en: “But if you look at what’s happening in the environment, the underlying claims themselves, i.e., we call for a claims environment to be down 2%,” he said. “I think the claims environment driven by the ADAS systems, collision avoidance systems, is probably just that. What’s happened is the propensity to file a claim over that two-year period of time is really what’s driven much of the negative in the industry. And as that starts to work itself out of the system, you’re starting to see the claims environment come back again.”
paras.zh: “但如果你看看环境中发生的事情，就会发现潜在的索赔本身，即我们呼吁索赔环境下降 2%，”他说。 “我认为由 ADAS 系统和防撞系统驱动的索赔环境可能就是这样。在这两年的时间内提出索赔的倾向确实是导致该行业大部分负面影响的原因。随着这种情况开始从系统中消失，您将开始看到索赔环境再次回归。”

paras.en: Kaner added that too much is ascribed to collision avoidance systems.
paras.zh: 坎纳补充说，太多的原因归咎于防撞系统。

paras.en: “We as an industry have to do a really good job of making sure people don’t hear things like, ‘Oh, well, front-end collisions are down 40%.’ Well, front-end collisions are down 40% in the cars that actually have that technology in them,” he said. “The reality is, for that technology to bleed through the system takes quite a while… Anything that happens new in a car takes 20 years to get all the way through the system.”
paras.zh: “作为一个行业，我们必须做得非常好，确保人们不会听到类似这样的话，‘哦，好吧，前端碰撞事故减少了 40%。’好吧，在真正配备这项技术的汽车中，前端碰撞事故减少了 40%，”他说。 “现实情况是，该技术要在系统中渗透需要相当长的时间……汽车中发生的任何新事物都需要 20 年才能完全渗透到系统中。”

paras.en: Risley also asked the group what the biggest threat to the collision repair industry is. Three out of the four responded, “ourselves.” Anderson’s take was technology.
paras.zh: 里斯利还询问该小组碰撞修复行业面临的最大威胁是什么。四人中的三人回答说：“我们自己。”安德森的选择是技术。

paras.en: Featured image: Brian Kaner, Boyd Group CEO; David Simmons, Caliber CEO; Brad Anderson, Classic Collision CEO; and Matt Ebert, Crash Champions CEO, participate in a panel discussion during the 2026 MSO Symposium, held Nov. 2.
paras.zh: 特色图片：博伊德集团首席执行官 Brian Kaner； Calibre 首席执行官 David Simmons；布拉德·安德森 (Brad Anderson)，Classic Collision 首席执行官；和 Crash Champions 首席执行官 Matt Ebert 参加 11 月 2 日举行的 2026 年 MSO 研讨会期间的小组讨论。

paras.en: All photos by Lurah Lowery/Repairer Driven News
paras.zh: 所有照片均由 Lurah Lowery/Repairer Driven News 拍摄

articles.title: Annual Red Carpet Awards recognize excellence in leadership, education, and advocacy
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards, held Tuesday during SEMA Week in Las Vegas, honored several individuals in the collision repair industry for their dedication to safe and proper repairs; education and training; consumer advocacy; and doing the right thing.
paras.zh: 周二在拉斯维加斯 SEMA 周期间举行的碰撞行业红地毯奖表彰了碰撞维修行业中致力于安全和正确维修的几位人士；教育和培训；消费者权益倡导；并做正确的事。

paras.en: The Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) honored Petra Schroeder, known to the industry as “Collisionista,” with the 2026 Humanitarian Award for a relentlessness never to stop giving to the industry.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 向被业界称为“碰撞专家”的佩特拉·施罗德 (Petra Schroeder) 授予 2026 年人道主义奖，以表彰其对行业永不停止奉献的不懈努力。

paras.en: “There are people who talk about giving back, and there are people who just quietly get to work, people who answer the phone when someone needs help, who encourage someone who’s trying to find their place in the industry, and who remind us that sometimes the most meaningful thing we can do for another person is simply show up,” said SCRS Board Member Kena Dacus, when co-presenting the award. “Our recipient has spent a lifetime doing exactly that.”
paras.zh: SCRS 董事会成员 Kena Dacus 在共同颁奖时表示：“有些人谈论回馈，有些人只是默默地投入工作，有些人在有人需要帮助时接听电话，有些人鼓励那些试图在行业中找到自己位置的人，有些人提醒我们，有时我们能为他人做的最有意义的事情就是出现。” “我们的接受者一生都在做这件事。”

paras.en: Past SCRS Chair and co-presenter Amber Alley added that Schroeder’s mentoring, advocacy, and generosity have never stopped, and her impact has kept growing with a genuine love for the industry.
paras.zh: SCRS 前任主席兼联合主持人 Amber Alley 补充道，Schroeder 的指导、倡导和慷慨从未停止，她的影响力因对行业的真诚热爱而不断增长。

paras.en: “I truly love this industry,” Schroeder said when accepting the award. “I truly love the people even more. And everything, every person that I ever met means a lot to me. …I just want to cry and just say thank you so much for your love, for your passion that you returned to this industry as much as I have returned to this industry.”
paras.zh: “我真的很喜欢这个行业，”施罗德在领奖时说道。 “我真的更爱这里的人们。我遇到的每一件事、每一个人对我来说都意义重大……我只想哭泣，非常感谢你们的爱和热情，你们回到了这个行业，就像我回到了这个行业一样。”

paras.en: SCRS also awarded the March Taylor Kina’Ole Award to Jason Bartanen in celebration of March Taylor, who passed away in 2007. SCRS says Taylor’s commitment to technical excellence, mentorship, and service to others left a lasting impression on the collision repair community and around the SCRS table.
paras.zh: SCRS 还向 Jason Bartanen 颁发了 March Taylor Kina’Ole 奖，以庆祝 2007 年去世的 March Taylor。 SCRS 表示，Taylor 对卓越技术、指导和为他人服务的承诺给碰撞修复界和 SCRS 界留下了持久的印象。

paras.en: Taylor was a master technician, owner of Auto Body Hawaii, and an industry leader who spearheaded the idea of a centralized service that repairers could use to submit inquiries challenging estimating systems’ data based on real-world repairs. That idea became the Data Enhancement Gateway (DEG).
paras.zh: 泰勒是一位技术大师，夏威夷汽车车身公司的所有者，也是一位行业领导者，他率先提出了集中服务的想法，维修人员可以使用该服务提交查询，从而挑战基于实际维修的系统数据估计。这个想法成为了数据增强网关（DEG）。

paras.en: “March was a technician first,” said Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director. “He was somebody who believed in the work that was being done behind the front office in the bays of our shops. He lived and breathed and taught the culture of doing the right thing, the right way, for the right reasons, and that’s what kina’ole means.
paras.zh: “March 首先是一名技术人员，”SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 说。 “他相信我们商店前台后台所做的工作。他生活、呼吸并教导以正确的理由、以正确的方式做正确的事情的文化，这就是 kina’ole 的含义。

paras.en: “I think March understood something that can get lost in conversations about this industry: that the greatest responsibility lies with the men and women who perform repairs; the people who go home at the end of the day with busted knuckles and calloused hands; the people who straighten the structures, and repair the damage, and put vehicles back together. They’re the ones whose work determines how vehicles will protect our families.”
paras.zh: “我认为马奇明白一些在有关这个行业的对话中可能会被忽视的事情：最大的责任在于进行维修的男男女女；那些在一天结束时带着指关节破裂、双手长满老茧回家的人；那些矫正结构、修复损坏并将车辆重新组装起来的人。他们的工作决定了车辆如何保护我们的家庭。”

paras.en: Barry Dorn added that Taylor “stood for the people whose voices weren’t always heard — the technicians, the people doing the work.”
paras.zh: 巴里·多恩补充说，泰勒“代表了那些声音不总是被听到的人——技术人员、从事工作的人。”

paras.en: Dorn said Bartanen never loses sight of his “why,” and has spent his career advocating for technicians, investing in their success, and making sure they have someone in their corner. Bartanen has spent years working with SkillsUSA students and now helps build technicians’ careers through his business, Collision ProAssist.
paras.zh: 多恩表示，巴塔宁从未忘记自己的“原因”，并在整个职业生涯中为技术人员提供支持，为他们的成功投资，并确保有人站在他们的立场上。 Bartanen 多年来一直与 SkillsUSA 的学生合作，现在通过他的公司 Collision ProAssist 帮助技术人员建立职业生涯。

paras.en: “I’ve always wanted to do the right thing,” Bartanen said. “Our technicians are the reason we’re here today; the men and women who are fixing cars each and every day. I want all of us to lift them up, recognize their accomplishments, and support them.”
paras.zh: “我一直想做正确的事，”巴塔宁说。 “我们的技术人员是我们今天来到这里的原因；每天都在修理汽车的男男女女。我希望我们所有人都支持他们，认可他们的成就并支持他们。”

paras.en: In honor of another collision repair industry leader, the Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) presented the first annual Clark Plucinski Legacy Award to Chris Evans of State Farm. Evans is a former collision technician and collision center manager who previously served as CREF’s chair and on I-CAR’s Board of Directors.
paras.zh: 为了纪念另一位碰撞修复行业的领导者，碰撞修复教育基金会 (CREF) 向 State Farm 的 Chris Evans 颁发了首届年度克拉克·普鲁辛斯基遗产奖。 Evans 曾担任碰撞技术员和碰撞中心经理，曾担任 CREF 主席和 I-CAR 董事会成员。

paras.en: The award recognizes an individual who embodies the spirit, dedication, and commitment that defined Plucinski’s life and career.
paras.zh: 该奖项旨在表彰那些体现了普鲁辛斯基生活和职业生涯的精神、奉献和承诺的个人。

paras.en: Plucinski dedicated more than 50 years to the collision repair industry, receiving numerous honors and recognitions throughout his career, including induction into the Hall of Eagles in 1993.
paras.zh: Plucinski 致力于碰撞修复行业 50 多年，在其职业生涯中获得了无数荣誉和认可，包括 1993 年入选老鹰厅。

paras.en: From 2012 until his retirement in 2020, Plucinski served as CREF’s executive director.
paras.zh: 从 2012 年到 2020 年退休，Plucinski 担任 CREF 的执行董事。

paras.en: “Those of you who knew Clark will remember hearing him say time and time again, ‘It’s all about the kids,'” shared Stacy Bartnik, CREF Board of Trustees member. “Those words were more than just a phrase. They reflected his passion, his purpose, his unwavering belief that the future of our industry depends on investing in the next generation. Clark dedicated his career to creating opportunities for students, supporting collision repair education and ensuring that young people had a path to successful careers in our industry.”
paras.zh: “认识克拉克的人都会记得听到他一次又一次地说，‘一切都是为了孩子’，”CREF 董事会成员史黛西·巴特尼克 (Stacy Bartnik) 分享道。 “这些话不仅仅是一个短语。它们反映了他的热情、他的目标以及他对我们行业的未来取决于对下一代的投资的坚定信念。克拉克致力于为学生创造机会、支持碰撞修复教育并确保年轻人在我们行业拥有成功职业生涯的道路。”

paras.en: Other Red Carpet awards presented this year were:
paras.zh: 今年颁发的其他红地毯奖项包括：

paras.en: Executive of the Year, single location: Bob Knodel, Silver Creek Auto Body in Silverton, Oregon
paras.zh: 年度最佳单一地点高管：Bob Knodel，俄勒冈州 Silverton 的 Silver Creek Auto Body

articles.title: How GM’s Digital Twins Help Engineers Build Fewer Prototypes
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: What if engineers could test thousands of engine designs before building the first physical prototype? GM ‘digital twins’ allow the company to evaluate engine behavior virtually, then use real-world testing to refine the results.
paras.zh: 如果工程师在构建第一个物理原型之前可以测试数千种发动机设计会怎么样？通用汽车的“数字双胞胎”使该公司能够虚拟评估发动机行为，然后使用现实世界的测试来完善结果。

paras.en: During a visit to GM’s Pontiac Engineering Center, engineer Radu Theyyunni explained how the company models everything from combustion and oil flow to component temperatures and structural stresses.
paras.zh: 在参观通用汽车庞蒂亚克工程中心时，工程师 Radu Theyyunni 解释了该公司如何对从燃烧和油流到部件温度和结构应力的一切进行建模。

paras.en: He compared the technology to a flight simulator for engineering.
paras.zh: 他将该技术与工程飞行模拟器进行了比较。

paras.en: GM used this approach to evaluate more than 20,000 virtual engine configurations and 50,000 combustion chamber designs during development of its new heavy-duty diesel. The company said it also simulated 500,000 operating scenarios, including demanding towing and temperature conditions.
paras.zh: 通用汽车在其新型重型柴油机的开发过程中使用这种方法评估了 20,000 多个虚拟发动机配置和 50,000 个燃烧室设计。该公司表示，它还模拟了 500,000 个操作场景，包括苛刻的牵引和温度条件。

paras.en: Physical testing remains essential. Engineers compare the results against their models, investigate differences, and use the findings to improve subsequent designs.
paras.zh: 物理测试仍然至关重要。工程师将结果与模型进行比较，调查差异，并利用调查结果改进后续设计。

paras.en: GM digital twins help engineers explore more possibilities before committing to hardware, while dynamometer testing provides the evidence needed to validate those decisions.
paras.zh: 通用汽车数字孪生帮助工程师在投入硬件之前探索更多可能性，而测功机测试提供了验证这些决策所需的证据。

paras.en: Watch this FE On the Road short from our sister property Fleet Equipment to hear Theyyanni explain why the combination matters.
paras.zh: 观看我们姊妹公司 Fleet Equipment 的 FE On the Road 短片，听 Theyyanni 解释为什么这种组合很重要。

articles.title: How Does Truck Tire Retreading Work?
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: The retreading process gives a truck tire another tread life by reusing its casing. Getting there involves a series of inspections, surface preparation, repairs, and manufacturing steps before that tire returns to the fleet.
paras.zh: 翻新过程通过重复使用其胎体，赋予卡车轮胎另一个胎面寿命。在轮胎返回车队之前，需要进行一系列检查、表面处理、维修和制造步骤。

paras.en: Fleet Equipment toured Bridgestone’s new Bandag Training Center in Akron, Ohio, to see that work up close. Tom Trego, director of franchise support for Bridgestone Bandag Tire Solutions, walked us through the equipment and explained what happens at each station.
paras.zh: Fleet Equipment 参观了普利司通位于俄亥俄州阿克伦市的新班达格培训中心，近距离观察了这项工作。普利司通 Bandag 轮胎解决方案的特许经营支持总监 Tom Trego 向我们介绍了设备并解释了每个站点发生的情况。

paras.en: Bandag teaches a 10-step process. I’ve grouped those steps into six broader stages to follow a casing from its arrival through the final inspection.
paras.zh: Bandag 教授了一个 10 步流程。我将这些步骤分为六个更广泛的阶段，以跟踪套管从到达到最终检查的整个过程。

paras.en: The first question is whether the casing qualifies for retreading. Technicians evaluate its condition against acceptance criteria, including requirements established by the fleet. Trego said those can include casing brands and age limits.
paras.zh: 第一个问题是外壳是否符合翻新条件。技术人员根据验收标准（包括车队制定的要求）评估其状况。特雷戈说，这些可能包括肠衣品牌和年龄限制。

paras.en: The inspection involves several checks. A spreader opens the tire for examination, equipment tests for nail holes, and shearography helps identify internal conditions technicians cannot see with the naked eye. Injuries requiring repair are marked so they can be addressed later in the process.
paras.zh: 检查涉及多项检查。吊具打开轮胎进行检查，对钉孔进行设备测试，剪切散斑法有助于识别技术人员用肉眼无法看到的内部状况。需要修复的损伤会被标记，以便稍后可以在过程中解决。

paras.en: For fleet managers, this is worth discussing with the dealer. Knowing why a casing qualifies, or why it doesn’t, helps explain what happens to the tires sent out for retreading.
paras.zh: 对于车队管理者来说，这值得与经销商讨论。了解胎体为何合格或不合格，有助于解释送去翻新的轮胎会发生什么情况。

paras.en: Once the casing passes inspection, the buffing machine removes the old tread and prepares the remaining surface to specifications. That prepared surface will receive the bonding rubber and replacement tread.
paras.zh: 一旦外壳通过检查，抛光机就会去除旧胎面，并按照规格准备剩余表面。准备好的表面将接受粘合橡胶和替换胎面。

paras.en: Mike Hazelrigg, training manager for Bridgestone Bandag Tire Solutions, explained that automated buffing procedures requires human review and approval, once the machine finishes. The casing still has additional preparation ahead before it reaches the builder.
paras.zh: 普利司通 Bandag 轮胎解决方案的培训经理 Mike Hazelrigg 解释说，机器完成后，自动抛光程序需要人工审核和批准。在外壳到达建造商之前，还需要进行额外的准备工作。

paras.en: With the old tread removed, technicians can examine damaged areas more closely. Skiving involves grinding into those areas to assess the injury and remove affected material.
paras.zh: 拆除旧胎面后，技术人员可以更仔细地检查受损区域。刮削涉及磨削这些区域以评估损伤情况并去除受影响的材料。

paras.en: Trego pointed to superficial damage found in gravel and waste applications as examples. He also described opening an area where rust appears on a belt after buffing. The work exposes the condition so technicians can evaluate and prepare it before applying new material.
paras.zh: Trego 以砾石和废物应用中发现的表面损坏为例。他还描述了在抛光后打开皮带上出现生锈的区域。这项工作暴露了情况，以便技术人员可以在应用新材料之前对其进行评估和准备。

paras.en: At the repair station, technicians address injuries marked during inspection. They prepare the repair surface and select patches suited to different injury types and sizes. A nail hole identified at the beginning of the process, for example, receives attention here before the casing moves on.
paras.zh: 在维修站，技术人员正在处理检查期间标记的损伤。他们准备修复表面并选择适合不同损伤类型和大小的补丁。例如，在过程开始时发现的钉孔在套管继续移动之前会受到关注。

paras.en: The first material applied is uncured bonding rubber, which an extruder places on the prepared casing. The replacement tread is already pre-cured. The rubber between the tread and casing will cure to form the bond.
paras.zh: The first material applied is uncured bonding rubber, which an extruder places on the prepared casing.替换胎面已预先固化。 The rubber between the tread and casing will cure to form the bond.

paras.en: The casing then moves to a builder, where the operator loads the tread design selected for the customer. As the tire rotates, the machine applies the tread, controls its tension, and cuts it to length.
paras.zh: 然后，外壳被转移到制造商，操作员在那里装载为客户选择的胎面设计。当轮胎旋转时，机器施加胎面，控制其张力，并将其切割成一定长度。

paras.en: The operator checks and joins the splice where the two ends meet. Rollers then press the tread against the casing through a process called stitching, removing trapped air and bringing the assembly together.
paras.zh: 操作员检查并连接两端相交的接头。然后，滚轮通过称为缝合的过程将胎面压在外壳上，去除滞留的空气并将组件组装在一起。

paras.en: At this point, the tire has its replacement tread in place. Completing the bond requires the next stage.
paras.zh: 此时，轮胎的替换胎面已就位。完成债券需要下一阶段。

paras.en: Before entering the chamber, the tire receives a flexible rubber envelope and sealing components. These allow the assembly to remain under controlled pressure while heat and time complete the cure.
paras.zh: 在进入腔室之前，轮胎接收柔性橡胶封套和密封部件。这些允许组件保持在受控压力下，同时通过热量和时间完成固化。

paras.en: The envelope stays around the tire throughout that cycle. Afterward, technicians remove it along with the sealing components, leaving the replacement tread bonded to the casing.
paras.zh: 在整个循环过程中，包络线始终保持在轮胎周围。之后，技术人员将其与密封部件一起移除，留下替换胎面粘合到外壳上。

paras.en: The Akron chamber holds 22 tires per cycle, Trego said. It automatically tracks temperature and pressure and provides alarms for problems during the cycle. Trego also noted that loading another batch into a chamber that is already warm can shorten the warmup period.
paras.zh: Trego 说，阿克伦室每个循环可容纳 22 个轮胎。它自动跟踪温度和压力，并针对循环期间的问题提供警报。 Trego 还指出，将另一批次装入已经温暖的腔室中可以缩短预热时间。

paras.en: Trego estimated five to six hours for the overall retreading process. Curing accounts much of the production time, with the rest of the stations around 45 minutes, total. He added that getting a tire from a fleet, retreading it, and sending it back, takes about a week.
paras.zh: Trego 估计整个翻新过程需要五到六个小时。固化占据了大部分生产时间，其余工位总共大约需要 45 分钟。他补充说，从车队获取轮胎，翻新，然后寄回，大约需要一周的时间。

paras.en: Once the envelope and sealing components are removed, technicians examine the finished retread. They check that it carries the customer’s specified tread and that the cure appears correct.
paras.zh: 一旦封套和密封部件被移除，技术人员就会检查完成的翻新。他们检查它是否带有客户指定的花纹以及治疗方法是否正确。

paras.en: The tires generally receive a fresh coat of paint before returning to customers. This is the last quality check after the work performed throughout the plant, from preparing the casing to applying and curing the tread.
paras.zh: 轮胎在返回给客户之前通常会涂上一层新漆。这是整个工厂从准备外壳到应用和固化胎面的工作结束后的最后一次质量检查。

paras.en: Each of these steps works toward putting an existing casing back into service with replacement tread. For fleets, that reuse carries financial and environmental benefits.
paras.zh: 这些步骤中的每一个步骤都旨在通过更换胎面使现有外壳重新投入使用。对于车队来说，这种再利用会带来经济和环境效益。

paras.en: At the ribbon cutting, Bridgestone said the retreading industry saves fleets more than $3 billion annually. The company also cited more than 217 million gallons of oil saved each year through retreading.
paras.zh: 普利司通在剪彩仪式上表示，翻新行业每年为车队节省超过 30 亿美元。该公司还表示，每年通过翻新可节省超过 2.17 亿加仑的石油。

paras.en: For Bandag specifically, Bridgestone reports more than 300 million tires diverted from landfills over the brand’s history. The company attributes that cumulative total to extending tire service life through retreading.
paras.zh: 特别是对于 Bandag，普利司通报告称，在该品牌的历史上，有超过 3 亿条轮胎从垃圾填埋场转出。该公司将这一累计总数归因于通过翻新延长轮胎使用寿命。

articles.title: Nokian Tyres Launches 2026 Virtual Green Tire Giveaway
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Nokian Tyres has launched its 2026 Virtual Green Tire Giveaway, an annual campaign tied to its mountain resort partnerships across the U.S. and Canada. Participants can compete for weekly tire prizes and a grand-prize mountain getaway through a digital scavenger hunt.
paras.zh: 诺记轮胎推出了 2026 年虚拟绿色轮胎赠品活动，这是一项与其在美国和加拿大山区度假村合作伙伴关系相关的年度活动。参与者可以通过数字寻宝游戏争夺每周轮胎奖品和大奖山区度假机会。

paras.en: The program debuted in 2023 and connects drivers with winter destinations and resort partners.
paras.zh: 该计划于 2023 年首次推出，将司机与冬季目的地和度假村合作伙伴联系起来。

paras.en: Now through Nov. 22, participants can follow clues shared through Nokian Tyres’ social media channels and participating mountain resort partners. The clues lead to a virtual green tire hidden on an interactive map.
paras.zh: 即日起至 11 月 22 日，参与者可以追踪通过诺基亚轮胎的社交媒体渠道和参与的山区度假村合作伙伴分享的线索。这些线索通向隐藏在交互式地图上的虚拟绿色轮胎。

paras.en: “Our resort partnerships help us connect with consumers who embrace winter and seek adventure,” said Hans Dyhrman, director of marketing, Nokian Tyres. “The Virtual Green Tire Giveaway is an engaging way for Nokian Tyres to reach drivers as they prepare for the winter season, while highlighting the confidence and peace of mind our tires provide.”
paras.zh: “我们的度假村合作伙伴关系帮助我们与拥抱冬季和寻求冒险的消费者建立联系，”诺记轮胎营销总监 Hans Dyhrman 说道。 “虚拟绿色轮胎赠品是诺记轮胎在为冬季做准备时向驾驶员提供的一种有吸引力的方式，同时强调我们的轮胎提供的信心和安心。”

paras.en: Throughout the campaign, Nokian Tyres will reveal a new resort destination and set of clues each week. Weekly winners will receive a set of Nokian Tyres tires. Runners-up will receive resort lift ticket vouchers.
paras.zh: 在整个活动中，诺记轮胎每周都会展示一个新的度假胜地和一系列线索。每周获奖者将获得一套诺基亚轮胎轮胎。亚军将获得度假村缆车票券。

paras.en: On Nov. 23, one grand-prize winner will be randomly selected to receive a three-night mountain getaway.
paras.zh: 11 月 23 日，将随机选出一名大奖获得者，获得为期三晚的山地度假。

paras.en: Participants can follow Nokian Tyres’ North America Facebook and Instagram channels for updates on resort destinations and clues.
paras.zh: 参与者可以关注诺记轮胎的北美 Facebook 和 Instagram 频道，获取度假胜地的最新信息和线索。

articles.title: XL Parts, The Parts House Expands VIP Event Series
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: XL Parts and The Parts House recently concluded its 2026 VIP Event Series with expanded programming across Houston, Dallas and Orlando.
paras.zh: XL Parts 和 The Parts House 最近结束了 2026 年 VIP 活动系列，并在休斯顿、达拉斯和奥兰多扩大了活动范围。

paras.en: “This year’s VIP Event Series represents a significant step forward in how we engage with our team, our vendor partners, and our customers,” said President and CEO Vikrant Aggarwal. “We have had the opportunity to create meaningful opportunities to align on strategic growth, strengthen industry relationships, and express our deep appreciation for the partners who drive our business forward.”
paras.zh: 总裁兼首席执行官维克兰特·阿加瓦尔 (Vikrant Aggarwal) 表示：“今年的 VIP 活动系列代表着我们在与团队、供应商合作伙伴和客户互动方面向前迈出了重要一步。” “我们有机会创造有意义的机会，以协调战略增长，加强行业关系，并向推动我们业务发展的合作伙伴表示深深的谢意。”

paras.en: This year’s events introduced an upgraded two-day experience in both Houston and Orlando. The new structure provided dedicated time for internal strategy sessions, vendor showcases, formal awards ceremonies for employee-of-the-year honorees and supplier partners and customer-focused trade shows and appreciation dinners.
paras.zh: 今年的活动在休斯顿和奥兰多推出了升级的两天体验。新的结构为内部战略会议、供应商展示、年度最佳员工获奖者和供应商合作伙伴的正式颁奖典礼以及以客户为中心的贸易展览和答谢晚宴提供了专门的时间。

paras.en: The series debuted Sept. 17-18 at The Woodlands Resort in Houston, TX, where XL Parts team members, vendor partners, and customers gathered for comprehensive product training, business development and vendor recognition.
paras.zh: 该系列于 9 月 17 日至 18 日在德克萨斯州休斯顿的 Woodlands Resort 首次亮相，XL Parts 团队成员、供应商合作伙伴和客户齐聚一堂，进行全面的产品培训、业务开发和供应商认可。

paras.en: It continued at The Shop Club in Dallas, TX, on September 24, where XL Parts says local shop owners and industry partners connected with suppliers over interactive exhibition booths, live entertainment, and multiple prizes.
paras.zh: 9 月 24 日，活动在德克萨斯州达拉斯市的 The Shop Club 继续进行，XL Parts 表示，当地店主和行业合作伙伴通过互动展位、现场娱乐表演和多种奖品与供应商建立了联系。

paras.en: The VIP event line-up concluded Oct. 1–2 at the Gaylord Palms Resort in Orlando, FL, where The Parts House (TPH) honored VIP customers and supplier partners through targeted product training, networking, and evening celebrations.
paras.zh: VIP 活动系列于 10 月 1 日至 2 日在佛罗里达州奥兰多盖洛德棕榈度假村结束，The Parts House (TPH) 通过有针对性的产品培训、社交和晚间庆祝活动向 VIP 客户和供应商合作伙伴致敬。

articles.title: Milwaukee Introduces M12 Fuel Straight Die Grinders
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Milwaukee Tool has introduced the next generation M12 Fuel 1/4″ Straight Die Grinder and new M12 Fuel 1/4″ Extended Die Grinder.
paras.zh: Milwaukee Tool 推出了下一代 M12 Fuel 1/4" 直模磨床和新型 M12 Fuel 1/4" 加长模磨床。

paras.en: According to the company, these cordless die grinders provide sustained power while not requiring hoses and compressors, allowing professionals to work more efficiently in tight spaces. Applications include rust removal, deburring, grinding, cutting and finishing.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，这些无绳模磨机可提供持续的动力，同时不需要软管和压缩机，使专业人员能够在狭小的空间中更高效地工作。应用包括除锈、去毛刺、研磨、切割和精加工。

paras.en: - 2″ cutting wheels and 3″ sanding accessories
paras.zh: - 2英寸切割轮和3英寸打磨配件

paras.en: According to the company, the M12 Fuel 1/4″ Straight Die Grinder is built for more control in precision applications, featuring an improved ergonomic handle; while the M12 Fuel Gen 2 1/4″ Extended Straight Die Grinder delivers greater mobility with extended access, incorporating a 4″ shaft designed to reach deeper into confined or hard‑to‑access areas.
paras.zh: 据该公司介绍，M12 Fuel 1/4" 直模磨床专为精密应用中的更多控制而设计，具有改进的符合人体工程学的手柄；而 M12 Fuel Gen 2 1/4" 加长直模磨床可提供更大的移动性和扩展的操作范围，其 4" 轴设计用于更深入地进入受限或难以进入的区域。

paras.en: M12 Fuel 1/4″ Straight Die Grinder Kit (3486-22)
paras.zh: M12 燃油 1/4" 直模研磨机套件 (3486-22)

paras.en: Kit Includes: (1) M12 Fuel 1/4 Straight Die Grinder (3486-20); (1) M12 RedLithium HO XC5.0 Battery (48-11-2450)(1) M12 RedLithium HO CP2.5 Battery (48-11-2425)(1) Carrying Case (1) Wrench
paras.zh: 套件包括：(1) M12 燃油 1/4 直模磨床 (3486-20)； (1) M12 RedLithium HO XC5.0 电池 (48-11-2450)(1) M12 RedLithium HO CP2.5 电池 (48-11-2425)(1) 便携包 (1) 扳手

paras.en: M12 Fuel 1/4″ Extended Die Grinder (3487-20)
paras.zh: M12 燃油 1/4" 加长模具研磨机 (3487-20)

articles.title: Hybrids Forecast to Reach 32% of U.S. Sales by 2035
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Hybrids are playing a larger role in how Americans move toward electrified vehicles. A new report from the Auto Care Association and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers forecasts substantial hybrid sales growth over the next decade. Meanwhile, U.S. battery electric vehicle (BEV) adoption continues at a slower pace than in China and Europe.
paras.zh: 混合动力汽车在美国人转向电动汽车的过程中发挥着越来越大的作用。汽车护理协会和 MEMA 售后市场供应商的一份新报告预测，未来十年混合动力车销量将大幅增长。与此同时，美国纯电动汽车 (BEV) 的采用速度仍然慢于中国和欧洲。

paras.en: Developed with Strategy&, PwC’s strategy division, the 2026 Joint Powertrain Trends & Outlook Forecast projects significant growth for hybrids. Their share of U.S. new-vehicle sales will increase from 17% in 2026 to 32% in 2035. The report also forecasts BEV market share will rise from 8% in 2025 to 25% in 2035.
paras.zh: 2026 年动力总成联合趋势与展望预测由普华永道战略部门思略特共同开发，预计混合动力汽车将出现显着增长。它们在美国新车销量中的份额将从2026年的17%增加到2035年的32%。报告还预测纯电动汽车的市场份额将从2025年的8%增加到2035年的25%。

paras.en: The findings point to a transition that includes an important hybrid phase before BEVs become more prominent.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，在纯电动汽车变得更加突出之前，存在一个过渡，其中包括一个重要的混合动力阶段。

paras.en: Hybrids Lead Key Powertrain Forecast Findings
paras.zh: 混合动力车引领关键动力总成预测结果

paras.en: – Hybrids are gaining share. The report forecasts hybrids will account for 32% of U.S. new-vehicle sales in 2035, compared with 17% in 2026.
paras.zh: – 混合动力车的市场份额正在增加。该报告预测，到 2035 年，混合动力车将占美国新车销量的 32%，而 2026 年这一比例为 17%。

paras.en: – U.S. BEV adoption trails other markets. BEVs accounted for approximately 6% of U.S. new-vehicle sales in the first half of 2026. That compares with 38% in China and an estimated 23% in European markets.
paras.zh: – 美国纯电动汽车的采用率落后于其他市场。 2026 年上半年，纯电动汽车约占美国新车销量的 6%。相比之下，中国的这一比例为 38%，欧洲市场的这一比例约为 23%。

paras.en: – Price remains a hurdle. Automakers are placing greater emphasis on models priced below $45,000, a segment that accounts for more new-vehicle sales.
paras.zh: – 价格仍然是一个障碍。汽车制造商更加重视价格低于 45,000 美元的车型，这一细分市场占新车销量的大部分。

paras.en: – Hybrids can cost less to own. Despite higher purchase prices, hybrids have lower three-year ownership costs than comparable internal combustion engine vehicles. Lower fuel costs and higher residual values contribute to the difference.
paras.zh: – 混合动力车的拥有成本更低。尽管购买价格较高，但混合动力汽车的三年拥有成本比同类内燃机汽车低。较低的燃料成本和较高的残值造成了差异。

paras.en: – Buyers will have more choices. The report expects the number of hybrid models to triple between 2025 and 2035. These include full hybrids, plug-in hybrids and range-extended vehicles.
paras.zh: – 买家将有更多选择。该报告预计，2025 年至 2035 年间，混合动力车型的数量将增加两倍。其中包括全混合动力汽车、插电式混合动力汽车和增程式汽车。

paras.en: What the Forecast Means for the Aftermarket
paras.zh: 预测对售后市场意味着什么

paras.en: The report also puts the powertrain shift in the context of a growing aftermarket. The U.S. light-vehicle aftermarket, including warranty and post-warranty activity, will grow from $543 billion in 2026 to $733 billion in 2035. That represents an increase of approximately $190 billion, or 3.4% annually.
paras.zh: 该报告还将动力总成的转变放在不断增长的售后市场的背景下。美国轻型汽车售后市场（包括保修和保修后活动）将从 2026 年的 5,430 亿美元增长到 2035 年的 7,330 亿美元。这意味着增长约 1,900 亿美元，即每年增长 3.4%。

paras.en: Consumers’ “repair, don’t replace” response to the cost of new and gently used vehicles drives growth. Price and product mix also contribute to growth as vehicle population growth remains modest.
paras.zh: 消费者对新车和旧车成本的“修理，而不是更换”反应推动了增长。由于车辆保有量增长仍然温和，价格和产品组合也有助于增长。

paras.en: Within the post-warranty market, the report forecasts parts revenue associated with electrification will grow approximately 24% annually through 2035. It also projects ADAS hardware revenue will grow approximately 23% annually.
paras.zh: 在保修后市场，该报告预测，到2035年，与电气化相关的零部件收入将每年增长约24%。它还预测ADAS硬件收入每年将增长约23%。

paras.en: “The shift toward electrification is not happening in one straight line,” said Philip Atkins, director of strategic research and planning at MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers. “Hybrids are becoming a bigger part of the picture, and suppliers need to plan for that reality. The mix of vehicles on the road will keep changing, and understanding where that demand is headed will help companies make better decisions about products and investment. This report will help companies do that.”
paras.zh: MEMA 售后市场供应商战略研究和规划总监 Philip Atkins 表示：“向电气化的转变并不是直线发生的。” “混合动力汽车正在占据更重要的地位，供应商需要针对这一现实进行规划。道路上的车辆组合将不断变化，了解需求的走向将有助于公司在产品和投资方面做出更好的决策。这份报告将帮助公司做到这一点。”

paras.en: “Price and choice matter to consumers, and the forecast makes that clear,” said Michael Chung, executive director of market intelligence at Auto Care Association. “As more hybrid models become available and automakers focus on affordability, the market is responding. This research helps aftermarket businesses understand the vehicles they will be serving in the years ahead.”
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会市场情报执行董事迈克尔·钟 (Michael Chung) 表示：“价格和选择对消费者来说很重要，这一点的预测表明了这一点。” “随着越来越多的混合动力车型上市以及汽车制造商关注可负担性，市场正在做出反应。这项研究有助于售后市场企业了解他们将在未来几年服务的车辆。”

paras.en: Auto Care Association and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers members can access the 2026 Joint Powertrain Trends & Outlook Forecast as a membership benefit.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会和 MEMA 售后市场供应商会员可以享受 2026 年联合动力总成趋势和前景预测作为会员权益。

paras.en: Nonmembers can purchase the report at digital.autocare.org or mema.org.
paras.zh: 非会员可以在 digital.autocare.org 或 mema.org 上购买该报告。

articles.title: Northwood University Celebrates 2026  Education Award Honorees
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Northwood University is celebrating four distinguished automotive aftermarket professionals whose leadership, industry achievements and commitment to education are helping shape the next generation of business leaders.
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德大学正在庆祝四位杰出的汽车售后市场专业人士，他们的领导能力、行业成就和对教育的承诺正在帮助塑造下一代商业领袖。

paras.en: The recipients of the 2026 Automotive Aftermarket Management Education Awards were honored Tuesday, Nov. 3, during an awards luncheon at the Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX) in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日星期二，在拉斯维加斯汽车售后市场产品博览会 (AAPEX) 举行的颁奖午宴上，授予了 2026 年汽车售后市场管理教育奖的获奖者。

paras.en: -Robert Roos, president and CEO of The Pronto Network
paras.zh: ——罗伯特·鲁斯 (Robert Roos)，Pronto Network 总裁兼首席执行官

paras.en: –Shawn Senior, chief executive officer of Eastern Warehouse Distributors
paras.zh: –Shawn Senior，Eastern Warehouse Distributors 首席执行官

paras.en: –Jessica Toliuszis, vice president of national accounts at Highline Warren
paras.zh: ——Jessica Toliuszis，Highline Warren 国民账户副总裁

paras.en: –Keith Zar, managing partner of Schwartz Advisors and principal of KAZ Enterprises
paras.zh: ——Keith Zar，Schwartz Advisors 管理合伙人兼 KAZ Enterprises 负责人

paras.en: Since 1975, Northwood has recognized automotive aftermarket professionals for their significant contributions to education, professional development and industry advancement. This year’s recipients represent decades of leadership across distribution, corporate strategy, sales, operations and business development, with a shared commitment to preparing future generations for success.
paras.zh: 自 1975 年以来，Northwood 一直认可汽车售后市场专业人士对教育、专业发展和行业进步的重大贡献。今年的获奖者代表了数十年来在分销、企业战略、销售、运营和业务发展方面的领导地位，并共同致力于为子孙后代的成功做好准备。

paras.en: “These honorees exemplify the leadership, innovation and entrepreneurial spirit that have long defined the automotive aftermarket,” said Dr. Dave Oventhal, director of the Center for Automotive & Mobility Studies (CAMS) and Subaru of New England Professor of Automotive Strategy at Northwood University. “Their success is impressive, but equally important is their willingness to share their knowledge, mentor emerging professionals and invest in the people who will lead this industry into the future. We are grateful for their contributions and pleased to recognize their achievements.”
paras.zh: “这些获奖者体现了长期以来定义汽车售后市场的领导力、创新和创业精神，”诺斯伍德大学汽车与移动研究中心 (CAMS) 主任、新英格兰斯巴鲁汽车战略教授戴夫·奥文塔尔 (Dave Oventhal) 博士说。 “他们的成功令人印象深刻，但同样重要的是他们愿意分享知识、指导新兴专业人士并投资于将引领这个行业走向未来的人们。我们感谢他们的贡献，并很高兴认可他们的成就。”

articles.title: October Class 8 Orders Fall 36% Year-Over-Year
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: October Class 8 orders in North America totaled a preliminary 15,600 units, down 24% month-over-month (M/M) and 36% year-over-year (Y/Y), FTR reported. The research firm described the results as a weaker-than-expected start to the 2027 order season.
paras.zh: 据 FTR 报道，10 月份北美 Class 8 订单初步总计 15,600 辆，环比下降 24%，同比下降 36%。该研究公司将这一结果描述为 2027 年订单季开局弱于预期。

paras.en: Orders were nearly 50% below the 10-year October average of 31,089 units. Combined September-October orders reached 36,002, down 20% from the same period last year.
paras.zh: 10 月份的订单量比 10 年来的平均水平 31,089 架低了近 50%。 9月至10月订单合计达36,002份，较去年同期下降20%。

paras.en: Despite the recent declines, year-to-date (YTD) orders totaled 278,201 units, up 74% Y/Y.
paras.zh: 尽管近期有所下降，但年初至今 (YTD) 订单总数为 278,201 辆，同比增长 74%。

paras.en: Regulatory and Pricing Uncertainty Weigh on Purchases
paras.zh: 监管和定价的不确定性影响采购

paras.en: FTR linked the October results to uncertainty about the Environmental Protection Agency’s (EPA) 2027 NOx regulations and model year 2027 pricing. OEMs have begun opening order boards, but the firm suggested some may still be holding back build slots or final pricing.
paras.zh: FTR 将 10 月份的结果与环境保护局 (EPA) 2027 年氮氧化物法规和 2027 年车型定价的不确定性联系起来。原始设备制造商已开始开放订单委员会，但该公司表示，一些原始设备制造商可能仍会推迟生产时间或最终定价。

paras.en: Under the proposed framework, FTR estimated nonconformance penalties could add $6,000 to $7,000 per engine if passed through to buyers. It compared that with an estimated $8,000 to $12,000 premium for fully compliant engines.
paras.zh: 根据拟议的框架，FTR 估计，如果转嫁给买家，每台发动机的不合格罚款可能会增加 6,000 至 7,000 美元。相比之下，完全合规发动机的溢价估计为 8,000 至 12,000 美元。

paras.en: Actual costs will depend on the final rule and OEM pricing decisions. The firm suggested fleets may be waiting for regulatory clarity and potentially more favorable pricing.
paras.zh: 实际成本将取决于最终规则和 OEM 定价决策。该公司表示，船队可能正在等待监管的明确性和可能更优惠的定价。

paras.en: “Other factors may also be contributing to the slower ordering pace. Fleet capital spending priorities may be shifting toward trailers rather than tractors in the near term. Also, while freight rates are strong, so are costs for fuel, insurance, and labor, pressuring margins and possibly limiting purchases for now,” said Dan Moyer, FTR senior analyst, commercial vehicles.
paras.zh: “其他因素也可能导致订购速度放缓。短期内，车队资本支出重点可能会转向拖车而不是牵引车。此外，虽然运费强劲，但燃料、保险和劳动力成本也很高，这对利润率造成压力，目前可能会限制购买，”FTR商用车高级分析师丹·莫耶(Dan Moyer)表示。

paras.en: Read the full article on fleetequipmentmag.com.
paras.zh: 请在 fancyequipmentmag.com 上阅读完整文章。

articles.title: Bennie Skelton Named 2026 WIX Filters Counter Pro of the Year
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: WIX Filters and Counterman have named Bennie Skelton of Crow-Burlingame’s Bumper to Bumper store in Neosho, Missouri, the 2026 Counter Professional of the Year. Skelton brings more than four decades of parts experience to the counter, building customer relationships that now extend across generations. His career reflects a commitment to helping customers and a determination to overcome challenges.
paras.zh: WIX Filters 和 Counterman 任命密苏里州 Neosho 的 Crow-Burlingame Bumper to Bumper 商店的 Bennie Skelton 为 2026 年度柜台专业人士。 Skelton 将四十多年的零件经验带到了柜台，建立了跨越几代人的客户关系。他的职业生涯体现了帮助客户的承诺和克服挑战的决心。

paras.en: Skelton entered the parts field in 1980 when he enlisted in the U.S. Air Force. During 12 years of service, he learned to identify parts using microfiche and paper catalogs, measure engine components and supervise military and civilian personnel. While stationed in California, he worked weekends at an auto parts story after leaving the Air Force in 1992. Skelton joined Crow-Burlingame in 2009.
paras.zh: Skelton 于 1980 年加入美国空军，进入零部件领域。在 12 年的服役生涯中，他学会了使用缩微胶片和纸质目录来识别零件、测量发动机部件以及监督军事和文职人员。 1992 年离开空军后，他在加利福尼亚州驻扎期间，周末在一家汽车零部件公司工作。Skelton 于 2009 年加入 Crow-Burlingame。

paras.en: “Bennie has great customer service and has a lifetime of knowledge,” said Darren Brewer, manager of the Neosho store. “I don’t have to tell him to do something when he sees it needs to be done, he does it. He’s the best man I’ve ever worked with. ”
paras.zh: Neosho 商店经理达伦·布鲁尔 (Darren Brewer) 表示：“Bennie 拥有出色的客户服务和终生的知识。” “当他认为需要做某事时，我不必告诉他做某事，他就会去做。他是我共事过的最好的人。”

paras.en: Brewer credits Skelton with helping strengthen the store’s financial performance and praised his initiative, sales ability and perseverance.
paras.zh: 布鲁尔称赞斯克尔顿帮助加强了商店的财务业绩，并赞扬了他的主动性、销售能力和毅力。

paras.en: In 2012, Skelton suffered a major stroke that affected his speech and the use of his right side. He spent months relearning how to walk and talk, adapting to perform tasks left-handed. Today, he continues building hydraulic hoses, pulling parts and completing paperwork while serving the customers he knows so well.
paras.zh: 2012年，斯克尔顿遭遇严重中风，影响了他的言语和右侧肢体的使用。他花了几个月的时间重新学习如何走路和说话，以适应用左手执行任务。如今，他继续制造液压软管、拉动零件并完成文书工作，同时为他熟悉的客户提供服务。

paras.en: Established in 1986, Counter Professional of the Year recognizes excellence among automotive aftermarket parts professionals. WIX Filters has sponsored the program since 2006.
paras.zh: Counter Professional of the Year 成立于 1986 年，旨在表彰汽车售后市场零部件专业人士的卓越表现。 WIX Filters 自 2006 年以来一直赞助该计划。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Newnan, Ga.
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Newnan, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 216 Bullsboro Dr. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from West Georgia Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在纽南开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 Bullsboro Dr. 216 号的商店开业，举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和西乔治亚技术学院的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the College’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学院的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to open our newest store in Newnan and continue serving customers across the area,” said Mike Fogarty, Rregional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “This location helps us better support local drivers and professional customers with convenient access to the parts, and products they rely on. We’re also proud to support students at West Georgia Technical College and strengthen our connection to the Newnan community.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mike Fogarty 表示：“我们很高兴在纽南开设最新的商店，并继续为该地区的客户提供服务。” “这个地点帮助我们更好地支持当地司机和专业客户，方便地获取他们所依赖的零件和产品。我们也很自豪能够为西乔治亚技术学院的学生提供支持，并加强我们与纽南社区的联系。”

paras.en: “Community support plays an important role in career and technical education,” said Brittney Wells, executive director of institutional advancement at West Georgia Technical College. “We are grateful to Advance Auto Parts for this contribution, which helps support our students as they gain practical experience and explore opportunities in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: “社区支持在职业和技术教育中发挥着重要作用，”西乔治亚技术学院机构发展执行主任布里特尼·韦尔斯说。 “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 的这一贡献，这有助于支持我们的学生获得实践经验并探索汽车行业的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers.
paras.zh: 新商店还充当市场中心——一个集中设施，旨在提高整个商店网络的零件可用性和当日履行能力，从而提高专业客户的硬件零件覆盖率。

articles.title: Worldpac to Open First Automated Distribution Center in Georgia
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Worldpac announced plans to open its first automated distribution center, a new 413,000-square-foot facility in Forest Park, Georgia. Scheduled to begin operations in the first half of 2027, the facility will feature AutoStore robotic storage and retrieval technology, expanding Worldpac’s distribution capacity and supporting future growth, the company said.
paras.zh: Worldpac 宣布计划在佐治亚州森林公园开设其第一个自动化配送中心，占地 413,000 平方英尺。该公司表示，该设施计划于 2027 年上半年开始运营，将采用 AutoStore 机器人存储和检索技术，扩大 Worldpac 的配送能力并支持未来的增长。

paras.en: The facility will support Worldpac branches and customers across the Southeast and surrounding markets, while providing more than 250,000 additional square feet compared with the current Norcross distribution center.
paras.zh: 该设施将为 Worldpac 东南部及周边市场的分支机构和客户提供支持，同时与目前的诺克罗斯配送中心相比，额外提供超过 250,000 平方英尺的面积。

paras.en: The facility will utilize AutoStore, an advanced automated storage and retrieval system that uses robotics to store, retrieve, and process inventory within a highly efficient storage grid. Rather than team members traveling through warehouse aisles to locate parts, inventory is automatically delivered to workstations for picking, replenishment and processing. The technology will enable more efficient inventory management and order processing while supporting consistent, reliable service as Worldpac continues to grow, the company said.
paras.zh: 该设施将利用 AutoStore，这是一种先进的自动化存储和检索系统，利用机器人技术在高效的存储网格内存储、检索和处理库存。团队成员无需在仓库过道中寻找零件，库存会自动运送到工作站进行拣选、补货和处理。该公司表示，随着 Worldpac 的不断发展，该技术将实现更高效的库存管理和订单处理，同时支持一致、可靠的服务。

paras.en: 2160 Anvil Block Road, Suite 200 Forest Park, GA 30297
paras.zh: 2160 Anvil Block Road, Suite 200 森林公园, GA 30297

paras.en: - 28 miles from the current Norcross distribution center
paras.zh: - 距当前诺克罗斯配送中心 28 英里

paras.en: - 8 miles from Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport
paras.zh: - 距离哈茨菲尔德-杰克逊亚特兰大国际机场 8 英里

paras.en: - 413,000 square feet of office and distribution space
paras.zh: - 413,000平方英尺的办公和配送空间

paras.en: - Expected to create more than 150 new jobs in Forest Park
paras.zh: -预计将为森林公园创造150多个新就业岗位

paras.en: - First customer shipments expected in spring 2027
paras.zh: - 预计将于 2027 年春季向客户发货

paras.en: “We are excited to expand Worldpac’s distribution presence in the Atlanta metro market and strengthen our ability to serve customers throughout the Southeastern United States. The Forest Park facility represents a major step forward in our use of robotics and automation, helping us improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency,” said Rich Tannenbaum, chief operating officer of Worldpac.
paras.zh: Worldpac 首席运营官 Rich Tannenbaum 表示：“我们很高兴能够扩大 Worldpac 在亚特兰大地铁市场的分销业务，并增强我们为整个美国东南部客户提供服务的能力。森林公园设施代表着我们在使用机器人和自动化方面向前迈出了重要一步，帮助我们提高了速度、准确性和效率。”

articles.title: The Maya used so much red paint that they poisoned their water with mercury, mud sediments reveal
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: The Maya used so much red paint that they accidentally poisoned their lakes and waterways with mercury, a new study finds.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，玛雅人使用了太多的红色油漆，以至于他们不小心用汞污染了他们的湖泊和水道。

paras.en: The problem was cinnabar, a vivid-red mercury-sulfide mineral that can be used as the pigment vermilion in red paint. The run-off from the paint can enter waterways, where anaerobic bacteria then transform cinnabar into highly toxic methylmercury in the sediments of lakes. Over time, the methylmercury accumulates to higher levels in the food chain.
paras.zh: 问题在于朱砂，一种鲜红色的硫化汞矿物，可用作红色油漆中的朱红色颜料。油漆的径流可以进入水道，然后厌氧细菌将朱砂转化为湖泊沉积物中的剧毒甲基汞。随着时间的推移，甲基汞在食物链中积累到更高的水平。

paras.en: The ancient Maya, a people who lived in what is now southern Mexico and Central America and whose descendants are still around today, painted almost everything red. Archaeologists have found countless artifacts that the Maya reddened, including sculptures, monuments, walls, plazas, pottery and the dead for ceremonial funerals. Cinnabar was a common pigment in the paint they made, along with red ocher, which gets its color from a nontoxic iron mineral called hematite.
paras.zh: 古代玛雅人生活在现在的墨西哥南部和中美洲，他们的后裔至今仍然存在，他们几乎把所有东西都漆成了红色。考古学家发现了无数被玛雅人染红的文物，包括雕塑、纪念碑、墙壁、广场、陶器和葬礼上的死者。朱砂和红赭石是他们制造的油漆中的常见颜料，赭石的颜色来自一种称为赤铁矿的无毒铁矿物。

paras.en: But the Maya passion for the color red — which to them represented the sun, blood and life — caused an environmental disaster when the nearby waters were poisoned by the cinnabar runoff, said study first author Matthew Waters, a paleolimnologist (a scientist who studies ancient waterways) at Auburn University in Alabama.
paras.zh: 但玛雅人对红色的热情——对他们来说代表着太阳、血液和生命——造成了环境灾难，附近的水域被朱砂径流污染，该研究的第一作者、阿拉巴马州奥本大学的古湖泊学家（研究古代水道的科学家）马修·沃特斯说。

paras.en: "They would have seen a strange color change in the water … and a drop in its productivity, such as fish for protein," he told Live Science. The Maya depended heavily on freshwater fisheries, including for freshwater shellfish.
paras.zh: 他告诉《生活科学》杂志：“他们会看到水发生了奇怪的颜色变化……并且生产力下降，例如鱼的蛋白质含量下降。”玛雅人严重依赖淡水渔业，包括淡水贝类。

paras.en: Previous studies had already found evidence for high levels of mercury in the Maya's southern highlands and south-central lowlands, but no one had fully examined levels of the toxic mineral in Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula.
paras.zh: 此前的研究已经发现玛雅南部高地和中南部低地汞含量较高的证据，但没有人全面检查墨西哥尤卡坦半岛有毒矿物的含量。

paras.en: To investigate, Waters and his colleagues studied mercury levels in Maya-era mud in the Yucatán, and found overwhelming signs of mercury poisoning, probably from cinnabar paint, they reported in their study, published Nov. 4 in the journal Science Advances.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，沃特斯和他的同事研究了尤卡坦州玛雅时代泥浆中的汞含量，并在 11 月 4 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上的研究报告中发现了压倒性的汞中毒迹象，很可能是来自朱砂涂料。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "We did not suspect [the Maya] used it in the quantities that we were seeing," he said.
paras.zh: “我们并不怀疑（玛雅人）使用它的数量达到了我们所看到的程度，”他说。

paras.en: The study found extreme levels of mercury in sediment cores from two Maya-era sites: Cobá Lake, a shallow lake beside the Maya city of that name, and Cenote Xcach (also spelled X-Canché), a flooded sinkhole beside a ruined city in the jungle that few have excavated.
paras.zh: 研究发现，两个玛雅时代遗址的沉积物核心中汞含量极高：科巴湖（Cobá Lake），玛雅城市旁边的一个浅湖，以及 Cenote Xcach（也拼写为 X-Canché），这是丛林中一座废墟城市旁边的一个被淹没的天坑，很少有人挖掘过。

paras.en: The sediment cores chronicle the composition of earth and water over more than 2,000 years, and the times of mercury poisoning coincide with several periods during the Preclassic and Classic periods of the Maya civilization from about A.D. 40 to 820.
paras.zh: 沉积物岩芯记录了 2000 多年来地球和水的组成，汞中毒的时间与玛雅文明前古典时期和古典时期（大约公元 40 年至 820 年）的几个时期相吻合。

paras.en: Waters explained that the Environmental Protection Agency in the U.S. has determined it is unsafe to drink water with mercury levels above 2 parts per billion, while the official limit for the level of mercury in fish, where it builds up over time, is 1 part per million — any number above that means the fish can be seized by authorities.
paras.zh: 沃特斯解释说，美国环境保护局已确定饮用汞含量超过十亿分之二的水是不安全的，而随着时间的推移，鱼体内汞含量的官方限值是百万分之一——任何高于该数字的鱼都可能被当局扣押。

paras.en: Severe poisoning occurs when the mercury levels in human blood exceed about 100 parts per billion, from drinking contaminated water or eating contaminated marine animals, such as fish. In humans, mercury poisoning can cause severe symptoms, including permanent lung damage, brain damage and death.
paras.zh: 当人体血液中的汞含量超过十亿分之一百分之十时，就会发生严重中毒，原因是饮用受污染的水或食用受污染的海洋动物（例如鱼）。对于人类来说，汞中毒会导致严重的症状，包括永久性肺损伤、脑损伤和死亡。

paras.en: The most polluted parts of the Yucatan cores had a mercury level of 2.3 parts per million, the team discovered. "They experienced this for decades and, in one case, for centuries," Waters said.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，尤卡坦核心污染最严重的部分汞含量为百万分之 2.3。沃特斯说：“他们经历了这种情况数十年，甚至几个世纪。”

paras.en: The researchers then examined the sediment cores for signs of environmental damage caused by the mercury poisoning. They found that the cores lacked tiny fossils of freshwater shellfish, indicating that the high mercury levels were killing marine life. The team also noticed that the sediment cores had hardly any traces of algal blooms, which should have happened frequently, Waters said. That's likely because algae could not survive in the poisoned water nutrients.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后检查了沉积物核心，寻找汞中毒造成的环境破坏的迹象。他们发现岩心中缺少淡水贝类的微小化石，这表明高汞含量正在杀死海洋生物。沃特斯说，研究小组还注意到沉积物核心几乎没有任何藻华的痕迹，而藻华应该经常发生。这可能是因为藻类无法在有毒的水中营养物质中生存。

paras.en: Scholars debate why the Maya civilization collapsed in the eighth and ninth centuries, but a leading suspect is the disruption of food supplies caused by drought.
paras.zh: 学者们争论玛雅文明为何在八世纪和九世纪崩溃，但最主要的怀疑是干旱造成的粮食供应中断。

paras.en: But although mercury levels were high during the Preclassic and Classic periods, the environmental damage caused by mercury levels had been falling in many places for hundreds of years by the time of the Maya collapse, Waters said, although it may have been a contributing factor.
paras.zh: 沃特斯说，虽然前古典时期和古典时期的汞含量很高，但到玛雅崩溃时的数百年里，许多地方汞含量造成的环境破坏一直在下降，尽管这可能是一个促成因素。

paras.en: Cinnabar does not occur naturally in the Yucatán, so it must have been imported there, probably from what's now Honduras, the researchers said. It seems these cinnabar imports eventually stopped at Cobá Lake, and the poisoning there fell to a background level of about 20 parts per billion by A.D. 520. However, the sediment cores showed that the mercury poisoning continued at Cenote Xcach until the collapse, they said.
paras.zh: 研究人员说，朱砂在尤卡坦半岛并不是天然存在的，因此它肯定是从那里进口的，很可能是从现在的洪都拉斯进口的。这些朱砂进口似乎最终在科巴湖停止了，到公元 520 年，那里的中毒量已降至约十亿分之 20 的背景水平。不过，他们说，沉积岩芯显示，Cenote Xcach 的汞中毒一直持续到塌方。

paras.en: Waters, M. N., Wooten, S. L., Abrook, A. M., Brenner, M., Curtis, J. H., Langdon, P. G., Medina-Gonzalez, R. M., Paradeisis-Stathis, S., & Vachula, R. S. (2026). Toxic mercury, aquatic ecosystem collapse, and the ancient Lowland Maya. Science Advances, 12(45), eaeh3280. https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aeh3280
paras.zh: Waters, M. N.、Wooten, S. L.、Abrook, A. M.、Brenner, M.、Curtis, J. H.、Langdon, P. G.、Medina-Gonzalez, R. M.、Paradeisis-Stathis, S. 和 Vachula, R. S. (2026)。有毒汞、水生生态系统崩溃以及古代低地玛雅人。科学进展，12(45)，eaeh3280。 https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aeh3280

paras.en: What do you know about the civilization that built pyramids across Mesoamerica? Find out with our ancient Maya quiz.
paras.zh: 您对在中美洲建造金字塔的文明了解多少？通过我们古老的玛雅测验来找出答案。

paras.en: Tom Metcalfe is a freelance journalist and regular Live Science contributor who is based in London in the United Kingdom. Tom writes mainly about science, space, archaeology, the Earth and the oceans. He has also written for the BBC, NBC News, National Geographic, Scientific American, Air & Space, and many others.
paras.zh: 汤姆·梅特卡夫 (Tom Metcalfe) 是一名自由撰稿人，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，常驻英国伦敦。汤姆主要撰写有关科学、太空、考古学、地球和海洋的文章。他还为 BBC、NBC 新闻、国家地理、科学美国人、航空航天等多家媒体撰稿。

articles.title: Nazca infant had rare, fatal birth defect that left her with one central eye 1,600 years ago
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists in Peru have discovered the skeleton of an infant with a rare birth defect that left only one central eye socket in the child's skull. DNA analysis of the remains confirmed a chromosomal abnormality caused the deadly condition in the infant over 1,600 years ago, according to a new study.
paras.zh: 秘鲁的考古学家发现了一具婴儿的骨骼，该婴儿患有罕见的先天缺陷，导致孩子的头骨中只剩下一个中央眼窝。一项新的研究表明，对遗骸的 DNA 分析证实，染色体异常导致了 1600 多年前婴儿的致命状况。

paras.en: "We cannot really say how long this individual survived," study co-author Lars Fehren-Schmitz, an anthropologist at the University of California, Santa Cruz, told Live Science in an email. But "the burial of this infant suggests that the Nasca treated this individual in death like most other infants."
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的人类学家拉尔斯·费伦-施密茨在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》：“我们确实无法确定这个人存活了多久。”但“这个婴儿的埋葬表明纳斯卡人像对待大多数其他婴儿一样对待这个人的死亡。”

paras.en: The skeleton of this female infant was discovered alongside a second one inside a ceramic urn at the archaeological site of Jauranga in Peru's Palpa Valley, where numerous geoglyphs known as the Nazca Lines have been found. Archaeologists uncovered several dozen other burials dated to the Middle Nazca (also spelled Nasca) period (A.D. 325 to 440) at the site, but one of the co-buried infants had an extremely rare condition, researchers wrote in a study published Monday (Nov. 9) in the journal PNAS.
paras.zh: 在秘鲁帕尔帕谷贾兰加考古遗址的一个陶瓷瓮内，发现了这具女婴的骨架和第二具女婴的骨架，那里发现了许多被称为纳斯卡线的地质符号。研究人员在周一（11 月 9 日）发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）杂志上的一项研究中写道，考古学家在该遗址还发现了几十个可以追溯到中纳斯卡时期（公元 325 年至 440 年）的其他墓葬，但其中一个共同埋葬的婴儿患有极其罕见的疾病。

paras.en: The infant had a very small skull and a single eye socket in the middle of her face, along with other developmental issues of the cranial bones. These traits match modern clinical descriptions of cyclopia, a lethal condition that occurs when the front part of a fetus's brain fails to divide into left and right hemispheres.
paras.zh: 这名婴儿的头骨非常小，脸部中央只有一个眼窝，还有颅骨的其他发育问题。这些特征符合现代临床对独眼症的描述，独眼症是一种致命疾病，当胎儿大脑的前部无法分为左半球和右半球时就会发生这种情况。

paras.en: This condition can also cause alterations in the nasal structures, resulting in a missing nose or a tube-like nose above the single eye.
paras.zh: 这种情况还会导致鼻结构的改变，导致鼻子缺失或单眼上方出现管状鼻子。

paras.en: "The cause of the malformation was present at fertilization, but manifestation occurs around the fourth to fifth week in utero [in the womb], when the frontal lobe of the brain has to divide," study first author Elsa Tomasto-Cagigao, an archaeologist at the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、秘鲁天主教大学考古学家埃尔莎·托马斯托-卡吉高 (Elsa Tomasto-Cagigao) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“畸形的原因是在受精时出现的，但在子宫内的第四周到第五周左右就会出现畸形，此时大脑额叶必须分裂。”

paras.en: Cyclopia is a rare condition, occurring in about 1 out of every 100,000 births. To learn more about the infant's short life, the researchers sequenced her genome. (DNA suggested the infant carried two X chromosomes, typical of a female.)
paras.zh: 独眼症是一种罕见的疾病，大约每 10 万名新生儿中就有 1 人发生这种情况。为了更多地了解婴儿短暂的生命，研究人员对她的基因组进行了测序。 （DNA 显示婴儿携带两条 X 染色体，这是女性的典型特征。）

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The team detected an extra copy of chromosome 13, meaning the infant had a genetic condition called trisomy 13, or Patau syndrome. It's known to be a major chromosomal cause of cyclopia; that said, only a small percentage of trisomy 13 cases involve cyclopia.
paras.zh: 研究小组检测到了 13 号染色体的额外副本，这意味着婴儿患有一种称为 13 三体症或帕陶综合症的遗传病。众所周知，它是造成独眼症的一个主要染色体原因。也就是说，13 三体病例中只有一小部分涉及独眼。

paras.en: While trisomy 13 is associated with advanced maternal age, it is not clear whether that was the case for this infant, Fehren-Schmitz said.
paras.zh: Fehren-Schmitz 说，虽然 13 三体性与高龄产妇有关，但尚不清楚该婴儿的情况是否如此。

paras.en: "This condition has been documented in historic and modern anatomical collections, but to my knowledge this is the first archaeological example of this developmental abnormality," Siân Halcrow, a bioarchaeologist at the University of Otago in New Zealand who was not involved in the study, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “这种情况在历史和现代解剖学收藏中都有记录，但据我所知，这是这种发育异常的第一个考古例子，”未参与这项研究的新西兰奥塔哥大学生物考古学家 Siân Halcrow 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: The researchers' estimate of the infant's age at death suggests she may have survived for several weeks or months after birth, Halcrow pointed out. "This raises important questions about how infants with profound congenital differences were cared for and treated in past societies," she said.
paras.zh: 哈尔克罗指出，研究人员对婴儿死亡年龄的估计表明，她可能在出生后存活了几周或几个月。她说：“这提出了一个重要问题，即在过去的社会中如何照顾和治疗具有巨大先天差异的婴儿。”

paras.en: The infant was buried in a ceramic urn, the researchers noted in the study, which was a common burial method in the Nazca period, along with a second female infant who had no skeletal abnormalities. "The baby with cyclopia was at the bottom of the jar, while the other baby was on top. Nevertheless, it appears that they were interred in a single event," Tomasto-Cagigao said. The genetic analysis showed that the two infants did not have the same mother.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中指出，这名婴儿被埋在陶瓷瓮中，这是纳斯卡时期常见的埋葬方法，还有第二名没有骨骼异常的女婴。托马斯托-卡吉高说：“患有独眼症的婴儿位于罐子的底部，而另一个婴儿则位于罐子的顶部。尽管如此，他们似乎是在一次事件中被埋葬的。”基因分析显示，这两个婴儿并非同一母亲所生。

paras.en: A burial of two infants in one urn is unusual for this culture, the researchers said, but there is not enough archaeological evidence to conclude that the infant with cyclopia was given a different type of burial.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，在一个瓮中埋葬两个婴儿对于这种文化来说是不寻常的，但没有足够的考古证据可以得出结论，独眼婴儿的埋葬方式不同。

paras.en: "The fact that the individual was buried with a 'healthy' individual in a regular cemetery, without any special grave goods, suggests that, to some extent, the individual was not treated differently in death, even though it had such a rare condition," Fehren-Schmitz said. "It was neither 'excluded' because of it nor treated in a 'special' way."
paras.zh: 费伦-施米茨说：“这个人与‘健康’人一起埋葬在一个普通的墓地，没有任何特殊的陪葬品，这一事实表明，在某种程度上，这个人在死亡时并没有受到区别对待，尽管他的病情如此罕见。” “它既没有因此被‘排除’，也没有被以‘特殊’的方式对待。”

paras.en: In ancient Andean societies, some people with disabilities took on special societal roles, such as ones associated with religious practices. "If that reflects Nasca society as a whole, we can't say based on one case," Fehren-Schmitz said, "but it does reflect the community this infant was part of, even if only briefly."
paras.zh: 在古代安第斯社会，一些残疾人承担着特殊的社会角色，例如与宗教活动相关的角色。费伦-施米茨说：“如果这反映了整个纳斯卡社会，我们不能根据一个案例来判断，但它确实反映了这个婴儿所属的社区，即使只是短暂的。”

paras.en: Tomasto-Cagigao, E., Reindel, M., Isla Cuadrado, J., Lund Valle, M., Kassadjikova, K., Harkins, K., Fehren-Schmitz, L. (2026). A Nasca-period perinatal burial reveals cyclopia associated with trisomy 13 in southern Peru. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. https://www.pnas.org/cgi/doi/10.1073/pnas.2625042123
paras.zh: Tomasto-Cagigao, E.、Reindel, M.、Isla Cuadrado, J.、Lund Valle, M.、Kassadjikova, K.、Harkins, K.、Fehren-Schmitz, L. (2026)。纳斯卡时期的围产期墓葬揭示了秘鲁南部与 13 三体有关的独眼。美国国家科学院院刊。 https://www.pnas.org/cgi/doi/10.1073/pnas.2625042123

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。
