articles.title: DETUMBLER: Airbus’ Passive Spin Stabilization Solution
articles.author: Airbus

paras.en: The tumbling crisis: why dead satellites threaten orbit
paras.zh: 翻滚危机：为何失效卫星威胁轨道

paras.en: Every year, hundreds of satellites reach end-of-life, most are deorbited, but some fail abruptly. Yet, even when properly decommissioned, some dead satellites may start tumbling on their own, through the accumulation of tiny disturbances like solar radiation pressure, to the point where they become impossible to capture by active debris removal missions.
paras.zh: 每年都有数百颗卫星报废，大多数卫星脱离轨道，但也有一些卫星突然失效。然而，即使正确退役，一些报废的卫星也可能会通过太阳辐射压力等微小扰动的积累而开始自行翻滚，直至主动碎片清除任务无法捕获它们。

paras.en: With over 36,500 tracked debris objects in orbit, the risk of cascading collisions is real. ESA warns that without ADR (Active Debris Removal) solutions, some LEO orbits will become unusable. Ensuring that all dead satellites are properly detumbled would be a major element towards making ADR economically feasible.
paras.zh: 轨道上有超过 36,500 个被跟踪的碎片物体，级联碰撞的风险是真实存在的。欧空局警告说，如果没有 ADR（主动碎片清除）解决方案，一些低地球轨道将变得无法使用。确保所有报废卫星得到适当的修复将是使 ADR 在经济上可行的一个主要因素。

paras.en: Detumbler: the game-changing alternative
paras.zh: Detumbler：改变游戏规则的替代方案

paras.en: Developed by Airbus R&D, the Detumbler is a passive magnetic damping device that stabilizes tumbling satellites before they become uncontrollable. Acting like an induction brake, it dissipates kinetic energy through the Earth’s magnetic field, stopping tumbling in a few months. For the first time, operators have a reliable, low-cost, fully passive solution to prevent post-mission tumbling.
paras.zh: Detumbler 由空客研发部开发，是一种无源磁阻尼装置，可在翻滚的卫星变得失控之前稳定它们。它的作用就像感应制动器，通过地球磁场耗散动能，几个月后就停止翻滚。运营商第一次拥有了可靠、低成本、完全被动的解决方案来防止任务后翻滚。

paras.en: Without power and thus actuators, the only phenomenon that can limit tumbling rates in a dead spacecraft are the natural eddy currents created by the Earth’s magnetic field in the satellite’s rotating metallic structure. Short circuiting the magnetorquers at the end of life could help boost that natural effect. Unfortunately, the resulting resistive torque is proportional to the low magnetic field squared (the induced dipole moment M is proportional to B, and the resulting magnetic torque is MxB), making such effects extremely weak, too weak to prevent spontaneous tumbling in case of any asymmetry in the external disturbances. As an example, in 2017, 12 years after decommissioning, Topex-Poseidon had reached a spin rate of 34 deg/s (40,000 Nms of accumulated momentum).
paras.zh: 在没有电源和执行器的情况下，唯一可以限制报废航天器翻滚速率的现象是地球磁场在卫星旋转金属结构中产生的自然涡流。在磁力器寿命结束时将其短路可能有助于增强这种自然效应。不幸的是，产生的阻力矩与低磁场的平方成正比（感应偶极矩M与B成正比，产生的磁力矩为MxB），使得这种效应极其微弱，太弱以至于无法在外部干扰不对称的情况下防止自发翻滚。例如，2017 年，即退役 12 年后，Topex-Poseidon 的旋转速度达到了 34 度/秒（累积动量 40,000 Nms）。

paras.en: Despite its very modest mass and volume, the Detumbler can reach efficiencies many orders of magnitude higher, by using permanent magnets so that the braking torque is proportional to B, not B².
paras.zh: 尽管其质量和体积非常适中，但通过使用永磁体，制动力矩与 B 而不是 B² 成正比，Detumbler 的效率可以提高许多数量级。

paras.en: ESA’s Space Safety Program requires detumbling capacities for LEO missions >500kg (1100 lbs), targeting detumbling performances from 3°/s to 0.75°/s in less than a year. Airbus’ Detumbler is a leading solution for meeting ESA’s requirements and thus enabling active debris removal (ADR).
paras.zh: ESA 的空间安全计划要求低地球轨道任务的减滚能力 >500 公斤（1100 磅），目标是在不到一年的时间内将减滚性能从 3°/s 提高到 0.75°/s。空中客车公司的 Detumbler 是满足 ESA 要求的领先解决方案，从而实现主动碎片清除 (ADR)。

paras.en: How the Detumbler works: a satellite’s “magnetic brake”
paras.zh: Detumbler 的工作原理：卫星的“磁力制动器”

paras.en: The magnetized rotor inside the Detumbler tends to remain aligned with the Earth’s magnetic field. As the satellite tumbles, the Detumbler’s conductive housing rotates around the magnetized rotor, thus causing magnetic braking through eddy currents. This slowly but steadily dissipates the satellite’s kinetic energy, reducing the angular momentum exponentially, ultimately reaching a detumbled steady-state with very low residual rates. This is achieved without the need for any electrical or computing power, contrary to all other attitude control actuators.
paras.zh: Detumbler 内部的磁化转子往往与地球磁场保持一致。当卫星翻滚时，Detumbler 的导电外壳围绕磁化转子旋转，从而通过涡流产生磁力制动。这缓慢但稳定地消耗了卫星的动能，以指数方式减少角动量，最终达到残余率非常低的稳定状态。与所有其他姿态控制执行器相反，这是不需要任何电力或计算能力即可实现的。

paras.en: The Detumbler can then cancel or respectively prevent tumbling in all situations that might cause it:
paras.zh: 然后，Detumbler 可以在所有可能导致翻滚的情况下取消或分别防止翻滚：

paras.en: - catastrophic dynamic events (leaks, propulsion failures, impacts from debris or micrometeoroids)
paras.zh: - 灾难性动态事件（泄漏、推进故障、碎片或微流星体的影响）

paras.en: - slow buildup of angular momentum through the relentless action of tiny disturbance sources such as asymmetric solar radiation pressure (similar to the YORP effect in astronomy).
paras.zh: - 通过微小扰动源（例如不对称太阳辐射压力）的持续作用，角动量缓慢积累（类似于天文学中的 YORP 效应）。

paras.en: Weighing around 200g (0,440 lbs), the palm-sized device can be integrated almost anywhere (just not too close to the magnetometer) into existing platform designs, with little-to-no modifications, making it an easy decision for future LEO space missions.
paras.zh: 这款手掌大小的设备重约 200 克（0,440 磅），几乎可以在任何地方（只是距离磁力计不太近）集成到现有平台设计中，几乎不需要任何修改，这使其成为未来低地球轨道太空任务的一个轻松决定。

paras.en: Detumbler is no longer in R&D, it’s TRL 8 and already commercially available through the Airbus Space Electronics product portfolio.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不再处于研发阶段，它是 TRL 8，并且已经通过空中客车航天电子产品组合投入商业使用。

paras.en: ✔ 100% passive: Neither power nor attitude-control actuators intervention; working even after the end of the mission
paras.zh: ✔ 100%被动：动力和姿态控制执行器均不干预；任务结束后仍继续工作

paras.en: ✔ Compatible with a large range of platform sizes (from ~150 kg (330 lbs) to ~1.5 tons (3300 lbs)
paras.zh: ✔ 与多种平台尺寸兼容（从约 150 公斤（330 磅）到约 1.5 吨（3300 磅））

paras.en: ✔ Detumbling within weeks for the smaller platforms, within a year for the upper end of the size range
paras.zh: ✔ 对于较小的平台，可在数周内进行除滚；对于较大的平台，可在一年内进行除滚

paras.en: ✔ Prevents tumbling despite average external disturbances up to 5 µNm
paras.zh: ✔ 即使平均外部干扰高达 5 µNm，也能防止翻滚

paras.en: ✔ Tested under launch vibrations and orbital conditions.
paras.zh: ✔ 在发射振动和轨道条件下进行测试。

paras.en: While available now, Detumbler’s potential lies in large-scale adoption. MDA Space has selected the Detumbler for its first MDA AURORATM LEO satellite constellation order, with a view to tangibly ensuring a safer, sustainable use of Space. When the constellation launches, it will mark the first commercial large-scale integration of passive detumbling in orbit.
paras.zh: Detumbler 现已推出，其潜力在于大规模采用。 MDA Space 为其首个 MDA AURORATM LEO 卫星星座订单选择了 Detumbler，以切实确保更安全、可持续地利用太空。当该星座发射时，将标志着被动减滚在轨的首次商业化大规模集成。

paras.en: Detumbler is more than a product; it’s a cornerstone of Airbus’ sustainable space vision. By enabling active debris removal, it supports ESA’s Zero Debris targets and EU Space Traffic Management regulations, ensuring long-term orbital viability.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不仅仅是一种产品；它更是一种产品。它是空客可持续太空愿景的基石。通过主动清除碎片，它支持欧空局的零碎片目标和欧盟空间交通管理法规，确保长期轨道可行性。

paras.en: For Airbus, Detumbler proves that even the most complex space challenges can be solved through innovation and responsibility. As mega-constellations expand, technologies like Detumbler will be essential to preserving the usability of the shared low Earth orbit environment.
paras.zh: 对于空中客车公司来说，Detumbler 证明即使是最复杂的太空挑战也可以通过创新和责任来解决。随着巨型星座的扩张，像 Detumbler 这样的技术对于保持共享的近地轨道环境的可用性至关重要。

paras.en: The Detumbler effect: stability for a sustainable future
paras.zh: Detumbler 效应：稳定的未来

paras.en: The problem of tumbling satellites has persisted for decades, but Detumbler, ESA’s mandates, and renewed urgency for sustainability now require industry to solve it. By stabilizing uncontrolled satellites, Detumbler reduces ADR risks, costs, and complexity, making removal feasible at scale.
paras.zh: 卫星翻滚的问题已经持续了数十年，但 Detumbler、欧空局的指令以及可持续发展的新紧迫性现在需要工业界来解决这个问题。通过稳定不受控制的卫星，Detumbler 降低了 ADR 风险、成本和复杂性，使大规模移除成为可能。

paras.en: For operators, the message is clear: integrating Detumbler is not just compliance, it’s a business imperative. For the industry, it’s a step toward a stable and accessible orbit.
paras.zh: 对于运营商来说，信息很明确：集成 Detumbler 不仅仅是合规性，更是业务的当务之急。对于该行业来说，这是迈向稳定且可进入的轨道的一步。

paras.en: Ready to upgrade your next platform for meeting the sustainability imperatives of the upcoming decades? Contact Airbus Space Electronics to learn how the Detumbler secures the endgame in your mission’s life-cycle.
paras.zh: 准备好升级您的下一个平台以满足未来几十年的可持续发展要求了吗？联系空中客车航天电子公司，了解 Detumbler 如何确保任务生命周期的最后阶段。

paras.en: Avionics Actuators | Space Equipment | Airbus
paras.zh: 航空电子执行器|空间设备|空客

paras.en: For more information contact: space_electronics.sales@airbus.com
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请联系：space_ electronics.sales@airbus.com

articles.title: Simera Sense and Spacemanic to Collaborate on a New Complete Dual-Use Mission Solution
articles.author: Spacemanic

paras.en: Czech company Spacemanic and Belgian optical leader Simera Sense are teaming up to deliver a new dual-use satellite solution that can compete with bigger and heavier satellites. Simera Sense xScape200 Dual-Use (DU) camera is integrated into Spacemanic 16U CubeSat platform, bringing high-resolution imaging capabilities to a lightweight, compact spacecraft designed for repeatable deployment and constellation growth.
paras.zh: 捷克公司 Spacemanic 和比利时光学领导者 Simera Sense 正在联手提供一种新的两用卫星解决方案，可以与更大、更重的卫星竞争。 Simera Sense xScape200 两用 (DU) 相机集成到 Spacemanic 16U CubeSat 平台中，为专为可重复部署和星座增长而设计的轻型紧凑型航天器带来高分辨率成像功能。

paras.en: The xScape200 DU combines a compact 12U form factor, low SWaP, and standardised integration to give commercial and defence organisations high-resolution, dual-use imaging capabilities without the need for a larger spacecraft, increased launch costs, or power-intensive mission architectures.
paras.zh: xScape200 DU 结合了紧凑的 12U 外形尺寸、低 SWaP 和标准化集成，为商业和国防组织提供高分辨率、两用成像功能，而无需更大的航天器、增加发射成本或功耗密集型任务架构。

paras.en: Spacemanic designs and builds its satellite platforms, core subsystems and deployers in-house. Owning the whole chain lets the company shape the satellite around the camera instead of forcing the camera into a standard form factor. That covers the satellite’s structure and envelope, its mechanical, electrical, thermal and data interfaces, and how the satellite integrates with the deployer.
paras.zh: Spacemanic 在内部设计和建造卫星平台、核心子系统和部署器。拥有整个链条可以让公司围绕相机塑造卫星，而不是强迫相机采用标准的外形尺寸。其中涵盖了卫星的结构和外壳、机械、电气、热和数据接口，以及卫星如何与部署者集成。

paras.en: The SPACE CANNON deployer accommodates CubeSats up to 16U, with an expanded integration envelope for payloads with protruding elements on the sides and a tuna can at the bottom. This additional space supports larger payload configurations such as the xScape200 DU camera. Removable side panels on all four sides provide direct access to the satellite after integration, enabling final adjustments right before launch. SPACE CANNON is designed for integration with launch vehicles including Falcon 9, Ariane 6, Vega-C, HyImpulse SL1, InnoSpace Hanbit, Spectrum by Isar Aerospace, RFA ONE and HyPrSpace Baguette One.
paras.zh: SPACE CANNON 部署器可容纳高达 16U 的立方体卫星，并具有扩展的有效载荷集成外壳，侧面有突出元件，底部有一个金枪鱼罐头。这个额外的空间支持更大的有效负载配置，例如 xScape200 DU 相机。所有四个侧面的可拆卸侧面板可在集成后直接访问卫星，从而在发射前进行最终调整。 SPACE CANNON 设计用于与 Falcon 9、Ariane 6、Vega-C、HyImpulse SL1、InnoSpace Hanbit、Spectrum by Isar Aerospace、RFA ONE 和 HyPrSpace Baguette One 等运载火箭集成。

paras.en: Together, the camera, tailored platform and deployer form a complete mission solution that simplifies the path from payload integration to launch. Beyond the technical development, Spacemanic and Simera are shaping the future of the commercial and dual use market.
paras.zh: 相机、定制平台和部署器共同构成了完整的任务解决方案，简化了从有效载荷集成到发射的路径。除了技术开发之外，Spacemanic 和 Simera 还在塑造商业和军民两用市场的未来。

articles.title: CesiumAstro Secures $730 Million in Janus Henderson-Led Series D at a Valuation Above $4.5 Billion; Unveils Synchronicity Satellite Constellation Following Fully Successful Element-1 Mission
articles.author: CesiumAstro

paras.en: CesiumAstro Inc., a global leader in space and defense communications systems and satellites, today announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion. The financing brings CesiumAstro’s total capital announced in 2026 to more than $1.2 billion and supports its expansion into developing and operating its own satellite infrastructure.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro Inc. 是太空和国防通信系统及卫星领域的全球领导者，今天宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元。此次融资使 CesiumAstro 宣布的 2026 年总资本超过 12 亿美元，并支持其扩张至开发和运营自己的卫星基础设施。

paras.en: The company also announced Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation for commercial, sovereign, and defense missions. The announcement follows the launch of CesiumAstro’s first satellite Element-1, and the start of its on-orbit operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还宣布了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座，用于商业、主权和国防任务。该公告是在 CesiumAstro 的第一颗卫星 Element-1 发射并开始在轨运行之后发布的。

paras.en: This expansion builds on three strategic acquisitions that have strengthened CesiumAstro’s vertical integration from semiconductors to mission operations, helping accelerate the development and deployment of Synchronicity. The company is also expanding its engineering and manufacturing operations worldwide. As part of that effort, CesiumAstro has announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its Austin-area headquarters, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space.
paras.zh: 此次扩张建立在三项战略收购的基础上，这些收购加强了 CesiumAstro 从半导体到任务运营的垂直整合，有助于加速 Synchronicity 的开发和部署。该公司还在全球范围内扩展其工程和制造业务。作为这一努力的一部分，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元来扩建其奥斯汀地区总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。

paras.en: The equity round was led by Janus Henderson, with participation from Insight Partners, Sands Capital, Sumitomo Corporation of Americas, Woven Capital – Toyota’s Growth Fund, Incharge Capital, Magnetar, AV, and NewSpace Capital, alongside $100 million in debt financing provided through the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) and JPMorgan.
paras.zh: 此轮股权融资由 Janus Henderson 领投，Insight Partners、Sands Capital、Sumitomo Corporation of Americas、Woven Capital – 丰田成长基金、Incharge Capital、Magnetar、AV 和 NewSpace Capital 参与，此外还通过美国进出口银行 (EXIM) 和摩根大通提供了 1 亿美元的债务融资。

paras.en: The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: 新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: “For nearly a decade, we have invested in the engineering, intellectual property, manufacturing infrastructure, and the talented people required to build an enduring space technology company,” said Shey Sabripour, Founder and CEO of CesiumAstro. “With our technology proven on orbit, on the ground and in the air, a significantly expanded set of capabilities, and more than $1.2 billion in new capital raised this year, we are positioned to take the next major step in our growth.”
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 创始人兼首席执行官 Shey Saripour 表示：“近十年来，我们在工程、知识产权、制造基础设施和人才方面进行了投资，以建立一家持久的太空技术公司。” “凭借我们在轨道、地面和空中验证的技术、显着扩展的能力以及今年筹集的超过 12 亿美元的新资本，我们已准备好在增长方面迈出下一个重大步骤。”

paras.en: “Shey Sabripour is an extraordinary entrepreneur, and CesiumAstro is poised to revolutionize the space communications industry. This industry is at an inflection point; legacy solutions are not equipped for the demands of today’s customers,” said Aaron Schaechterle, Portfolio Manager, Janus Henderson. “When we met Shey and his team, it became clear that CesiumAstro provides transformative technology that is critical to the industry’s future. This investment was originated through the Janus Henderson Ascent platform, which was created to provide private market capital to visionary companies that redefine their industries and to support these companies on the journey from private to public markets.”
paras.zh: Janus Henderson 产品组合经理 Aaron Schaechterle 表示：“Shey Sabripour 是一位杰出的企业家，CesiumAstro 有望彻底改变太空通信行业。这个行业正处于拐点；传统解决方案无法满足当今客户的需求。” “当我们见到 Shey 和他的团队时，我们发现 CesiumAstro 提供的变革性技术对行业的未来至关重要。这项投资源自 Janus Henderson Ascent 平台，该平台的创建是为了向有远见的公司提供私募市场资本，重新定义其行业，并支持这些公司从私募市场走向公开市场。”

paras.en: Introducing Synchronicity: A 737-Satellite, AI-Enabled Constellation
paras.zh: 同步性简介：由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座

paras.en: Synchronicity takes CesiumAstro beyond supplying advanced space technologies and complete spacecraft to developing and operating its own integrated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 同步性使 CesiumAstro 不仅提供先进的空间技术和完整的航天器，还开发和运营自己的综合空间基础设施。

paras.en: The constellation is designed around a dynamically managed, multi-beam, multi-frequency architecture supporting Ku-, Ka-, and V-band communications, advanced edge compute, and multi-orbit operations. This unified system aims to deliver more flexible, resilient, and adaptable connectivity across a broad range of commercial and national security missions.
paras.zh: 该星座围绕动态管理、多波束、多频率架构设计，支持 Ku、Ka 和 V 频段通信、高级边缘计算和多轨道操作。这个统一的系统旨在为广泛的商业和国家安全任务提供更灵活、有弹性和适应性强的连接。

paras.en: AI is integrated throughout the architecture, enabling network optimization, dynamic allocation of communications resources, and autonomous adaptation to changing mission requirements and operating conditions. Edge processing capabilities are intended to bring compute closer to where data is generated, reducing dependence on terrestrial infrastructure and supporting increasingly time-sensitive applications.
paras.zh: 人工智能集成在整个架构中，可实现网络优化、通信资源的动态分配以及自主适应不断变化的任务要求和操作条件。边缘处理功能旨在使计算更接近数据生成的地方，减少对地面基础设施的依赖并支持对时间日益敏感的应用程序。

paras.en: Unlike architectures assembled from independently sourced components, Synchronicity will leverage CesiumAstro’s vertically integrated technology portfolio, including custom silicon, best-in-class active phased arrays, software-defined payloads, advanced processors, spacecraft, mission software, and terminals for air, ground, mobility, and maritime platforms. This approach enables system-wide performance optimization.
paras.zh: 与由独立采购的组件组装而成的架构不同，Synchronicity 将利用 CesiumAstro 的垂直集成技术组合，包括定制芯片、一流的有源相控阵、软件定义的有效载荷、先进处理器、航天器、任务软件以及空中、地面、移动和海上平台的终端。这种方法可以实现系统范围的性能优化。

paras.en: “Synchronicity is the culmination of the technology stack we have methodically built since CesiumAstro was founded,” said Sabripour. “We designed the silicon, the active phased array, the payload, processors, the spacecraft, ground terminals, and the network as one system. That vertical integration gives us the ability to build capabilities in space that evolve as mission requirements, technology, and operating conditions change.”
paras.zh: “同步性是我们自 CesiumAstro 成立以来有条不紊地构建的技术堆栈的顶峰，”Saripour 说。 “我们将芯片、有源相控阵、有效载荷、处理器、航天器、地面终端和网络设计为一个系统。这种垂直整合使我们能够在太空中构建随着任务要求、技术和操作条件的变化而发展的能力。”

paras.en: Three Strategic Acquisitions Expand CesiumAstro’s Capabilities
paras.zh: 三项战略收购扩大了 CesiumAstro 的能力

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has brought critical semiconductor, mission software, and artificial intelligence capabilities together through three acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr.
paras.zh: 在过去 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项收购将关键的半导体、任务软件和人工智能能力整合在一起：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr。

paras.en: Jariet Technologies — A leading millimeter-wave RF System-on-Chip (RF-SoC) semiconductor company specializing in advanced solutions for satellite communications, electronic warfare, and radar systems. The acquisition strengthens CesiumAstro’s technology portfolio with advanced mixed-signal semiconductors, digital signal processing, and digital beamforming capabilities, enabling greater performance and control across its communications payloads, active phased arrays, and spacecraft.
paras.zh: Jariet Technologies — 一家领先的毫米波射频片上系统 (RF-SoC) 半导体公司，专注于卫星通信、电子战和雷达系统的先进解决方案。此次收购增强了 CesiumAstro 的技术组合，包括先进的混合信号半导体、数字信号处理和数字波束形成功能，从而实现其通信有效载荷、有源相控阵和航天器的更高性能和控制。

paras.en: 1Aardvark — A company specializing in mission software, algorithms, and systems engineering for national defense programs. The acquisition expands CesiumAstro’s autonomous mission capabilities, enabling spacecraft to dynamically respond to changing conditions, operate with greater resilience, and maintain mission effectiveness in contested or connectivity-constrained environments.
paras.zh: 1Aardvark — 一家专门从事国防项目任务软件、算法和系统工程的公司。此次收购扩大了CesiumAstro的自主任务能力，使航天器能够动态响应不断变化的条件，以更大的弹性运行，并在有争议或连接受限的环境中保持任务有效性。

paras.en: Vidrovr — An AI company specializing in real-time multimodal signal analysis. The acquisition accelerates CesiumAstro’s integration of AI into space communications and sensing systems, enabling intelligent RF optimization, autonomous satellite operations, and reconfigurable edge compute across its space and defense platforms.
paras.zh: Vidrovr — 一家专门从事实时多模态信号分析的人工智能公司。此次收购加速了 CesiumAstro 将人工智能集成到空间通信和传感系统中，从而在其空间和国防平台上实现智能射频优化、自主卫星操作以及可重新配置的边缘计算。

paras.en: Element: A Decade of Engineering Proven on Orbit
paras.zh: 元素：在轨道上经过十年验证的工程

paras.en: CesiumAstro successfully launched and began on-orbit operation of Element-1 in October 2026.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 于 2026 年 10 月成功发射 Element-1 并开始在轨运行。

paras.en: Element-1 integrates CesiumAstro’s proprietary communications payloads, active phased array technology, compute systems, and spacecraft engineering in an operational satellite. The mission validates nearly a decade of investment in proprietary intellectual property, specialized engineering expertise, and in-house manufacturing capabilities.
paras.zh: Element-1 在一颗运行卫星中集成了 CesiumAstro 专有的通信有效载荷、有源相控阵技术、计算系统和航天器工程。该任务验证了近十年来在专有知识产权、专业工程专业知识和内部制造能力方面的投资。

paras.en: Element-1 is the first of eight planned spacecraft, with seven more launches secured for the next deployment phase. The Element program also advances CesiumAstro’s space-based edge processing and compute capabilities, enabling data to be processed closer to its source and supporting more intelligent, responsive, and autonomous missions.
paras.zh: Element-1 是计划中的八艘航天器中的第一艘，下一部署阶段还有七次发射。 Element 计划还提升了 CesiumAstro 的天基边缘处理和计算能力，使数据能够在更接近其来源的地方进行处理，并支持更智能、响应更快和自主的任务。

paras.en: Expanding Global Operations and Manufacturing Capacity
paras.zh: 扩大全球运营和制造能力

paras.en: In Texas, CesiumAstro announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its global headquarters in Austin, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space. The expansion will support precision electronics and spacecraft manufacturing, engineering, integration, and test, with plans to add 550 jobs and grow the Austin-area workforce to more than 1,000 employees by 2030.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元，以扩建其位于奥斯汀的全球总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。此次扩建将支持精密电子和航天器制造、工程、集成和测试，计划到 2030 年增加 550 个就业岗位，并将奥斯汀地区的员工人数增加到 1,000 多人。

paras.en: Across the United States, the company is investing hundreds of millions of dollars to expand its engineering, manufacturing, and operational capabilities, with additional facilities in Colorado, California, Alabama, Florida, and the Washington, D.C. area.
paras.zh: 在美国各地，该公司正在投资数亿美元来扩大其工程、制造和运营能力，并在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和华盛顿特区设立了额外的工厂。

paras.en: In Europe and Asia, the company is expanding its presence, with operations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Taiwan, Singapore, and Japan.
paras.zh: 在欧洲和亚洲，该公司正在扩大其业务，在英国、德国、瑞士、台湾、新加坡和日本开展业务。

paras.en: These expansions will support scaled production of its communications and sensing systems, advanced compute technologies, and spacecraft, as well as development and deployment of its next-generation space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 这些扩建将支持其通信和传感系统、先进计算技术和航天器的规模生产，以及下一代空间基础设施的开发和部署。

articles.title: Allen's Bills dominate slumping Vikings

paras.en: Josh Allen's Buffalo Bills dominate slumping Minnesota Vikings to improve to 7-1
paras.zh: 乔什·艾伦 (Josh Allen) 的布法罗比尔队 (Buffalo Bills) 战胜了低迷的明尼苏达维京人队 (Minnesota Vikings)，战绩提高到 7-1

paras.en: The Buffalo Bills improve to 7-1 on the season as they take advantage of a sputtering Minnesota Vikings in a 23-6 win on Monday night; the NFL returns to Europe on Sunday when the Detroit Lions face the New England Patriots in Munich, Germany, live on Sky Sports NFL from 2pm
paras.zh: 布法罗比尔队在周一晚上以 23-6 击败了状态不佳的明尼苏达维京人队，将本赛季战绩提升至 7 胜 1 负； NFL 将于周日返回欧洲，届时底特律雄狮队将在德国慕尼黑迎战新英格兰爱国者队，天空体育 NFL 从下午 2 点开始直播

paras.en: Josh Allen threw a touchdown pass with 44 seconds left before half-time, James Cook rushed 31 times for 107 yards and a late score, and the Buffalo Bills beat Minnesota 23-6 on Monday night, sending Vikings deeper into their unrelenting offensive slump.
paras.zh: 半场结束前 44 秒，约什·艾伦 (Josh Allen) 传球达阵，詹姆斯·库克 (James Cook) 冲球 31 次，推进 107 码并在最后时刻得分，周一晚上，布法罗比尔队 (Buffalo Bills) 以 23-6 击败明尼苏达队，让维京人队的进攻陷入更深的低迷。

paras.en: Linebackers Terrel Bernard and Dorian Williams had interceptions and Tyler Bass made four field goals to stretch his franchise-record streak to 25 straight as the Bills (7-1) matched their best eight-game start since 1993. That season ended with their last of four straight Super Bowl losses.
paras.zh: 线卫特雷尔·伯纳德 (Terrel Bernard) 和多里安·威廉姆斯 (Dorian Williams) 被拦截，泰勒·巴斯 (Tyler Bass) 投进四球，将他的队史连胜纪录扩大到 25 场，比尔队 (7-1) 追平了自 1993 年以来最好的八场开局。那个赛季以超级碗四连败中的最后一场结束。

paras.en: With Kyler Murray sidelined by a hamstring injury, Carson Wentz started at quarterback for the Vikings (6-2) and didn't finish what became one of the worst performances of his 11-year career.
paras.zh: 由于凯勒·穆雷因腿筋受伤缺阵，卡森·温茨在维京人队以四分卫身份首发（6胜2负），但未能完成比赛，这成为他 11 年职业生涯中最糟糕的表现之一。

paras.en: Wentz went 8 for 25 for 81 yards and three turnovers, including a backward pass in the first quarter that was thrown too high for even Justin Jefferson to catch it - resulting in a lost fumble near midfield.
paras.zh: 温茨25投8中，推进81码，出现3次失误，其中包括第一节的一次向后传球，传球传得太高，连贾斯汀·杰弗森都接不住，导致中场附近失球。

paras.en: Wentz, who was checked out in the medical tent at one point for an apparent lower leg injury, was replaced by Max Brosmer midway through the fourth quarter. Wentz completed 1 of 8 passes in the second half.
paras.zh: 温茨曾因小腿明显受伤而在医疗帐篷中接受检查，他在第四节中途被马克斯·布罗斯默换下。温茨下半场8次传球完成1次。

paras.en: The battle of Buffalo's highest-scoring offense in the league against the least-scored-on defense might well have gone to Minnesota had the offense been able to muster a decent drive or two.
paras.zh: 如果布法罗的进攻能够有一两次像样的进攻，那么联盟中得分最高的进攻队与得分最少的防守队的战斗很可能会输给明尼苏达队。

paras.en: But the Vikings had four straight possessions in the first half start beyond their 40-yard line, and the furthest they made it was the Bills' 48.
paras.zh: 但维京人队在上半场开始时就连续四次控球超出了他们的 40 码线，其中最远的是比尔队的 48 码。

paras.en: The Vikings as usual sent blitzers at Allen from every angle possible, recording four sacks and an interception of a heave into the end zone that Byron Murphy ran down and returned 55 yards.
paras.zh: 维京人一如既往地从各个角度对艾伦发起闪电战，共完成四次擒杀和一次拦截，拜伦·墨菲跑下并返回 55 码。

paras.en: But the Bills eked out just enough in the first half to give themselves a cushion, when Allen found tight end Keleki Latu open in the back of the end zone for a 25-yard touchdown as he rolled right and was hit hard by Andrew Van Ginkel.
paras.zh: 但比尔队在上半场的表现刚刚好，为自己提供了缓冲，艾伦发现近端锋凯莱基·拉图在达阵区后部空位，在右滚球时完成 25 码达阵，但被安德鲁·范·金克尔重重击中。

articles.title: England Lions hit record score as McKinney runs riot

paras.en: England Lions hit their highest List A cricket score of 487-5 as Durham's Ben McKinney smashes 145 from 65 balls
paras.zh: 达勒姆队球员本·麦金尼 (Ben McKinney) 65 个球中打出 145 个球，英格兰雄狮队 (England Lions) 取得了 487 胜 5 负的 A 类板球最高成绩

paras.en: Durham opener Ben McKinney smashes 15 fours and 10 sixes in his eye-catching century as England Lions make it five wins from five on West Indies tour; James Rew also scores a ton as Lions eclipse the Ben Duckett-inspired 425-1 the Lions amassed against Sri Lanka A in Canterbury in 2016
paras.zh: 达勒姆揭幕战球员本·麦金尼 (Ben McKinney) 在令人瞩目的世纪比赛中打出 15 个四分球和 10 个六分球，帮助英格兰雄狮队在西印度群岛巡回赛中取得五胜五负的成绩； 2016 年在坎特伯雷对阵斯里兰卡 A 队时，詹姆斯·鲁 (James Rew) 也取得了巨大的进球，帮助雄狮队以 425-1 的成绩击败了本·达克特 (Ben Duckett) 启发的雄狮队

paras.en: England Lions thumped their highest List A score of all time as they piled on 487-5 from 50 overs against West Indies A in the second unofficial ODI in St Kitts.
paras.zh: 在圣基茨举行的第二场非官方 ODI 比赛中，英格兰雄狮队以 50 轮比赛以 487 胜 5 负的战绩击败了西印度群岛 A 队，创下了 A 队历史最高成绩。

paras.en: The total, in which Durham opener Ben McKinney looted 145 from 65 deliveries and James Rew scored 107 not out from 56, eclipsed the 425-1 the side racked up against Sri Lanka A at Canterbury a decade ago.
paras.zh: 达勒姆队揭幕战球员本·麦金尼 (Ben McKinney) 65 次传球中拿下 145 次，詹姆斯·鲁 (James Rew) 56 次传球中拿下 107 分，超过了十年前球队在坎特伯雷对阵斯里兰卡 A 队时取得的 425 胜 1 负的战绩。

paras.en: In that match, current England Test and ODI opener Ben Duckett plundered 220 not out from 131 balls and Kent's Daniel Bell-Drummond 171 from 139 after Dawid Malan had fallen for 23.
paras.zh: 在那场比赛中，目前英格兰测试和ODI揭幕战的本·达克特(Ben Duckett)从131个球中掠夺了220个球，而肯特大学的丹尼尔·贝尔-德拉蒙德(Daniel Bell-Drummond)在大卫·马兰(Dawid Malan)落入23个球之后，从139个球中掠夺了171个球。

paras.en: Ten years on, McKinney and Rew were the stars, with the former smoking 15 fours and 10 sixes and the latter - who made his Test debut against New Zealand at The Kia Oval in June, keeping wicket with Jamie Smith on paternity leave - struck 15 fours and two sixes.
paras.zh: 十年后，麦金尼和鲁成为了明星，前者打出了 15 个四分球和 10 个六分球，后者于 6 月在起亚椭圆形球场对阵新西兰队的测试赛中首次亮相，与休陪产假的杰米·史密斯一起保持三柱门，打出了 15 个四分球和两个六分球。

paras.en: McKinney was linked with a Test call-up earlier this summer when it became clear that England were going to drop Zak Crawley but the spot as Duckett's partner at the top of the order went to the youngster's Durham team-mate Emilio Gay instead.
paras.zh: 今年夏天早些时候，麦金尼与测试征召联系在一起，当时英格兰队显然将放弃扎克·克劳利，但达克特搭档的第一名位置却被这位年轻球员的达勒姆队友埃米利奥·盖伊取代。

paras.en: McKinney and Rew flogged a bowling attack that included full West Indies international Oshane Thomas - the seamer has played 46 white-ball games for his nation, most recently in February 2024.
paras.zh: 麦金尼和鲁发起了一场保龄球进攻，其中包括西印度群岛国家队球员奥沙恩·托马斯（Oshane Thomas）——这位接缝者已经为他的国家队打了 46 场白球比赛，最近一次是在 2024 年 2 月。

paras.en: The Lions won the match by 276 runs after skittling their hosts for 211 in reply in Basseterre, thanks chiefly to a five-wicket haul from Hampshire quick Eddie Jack, who has been included in England's T20I squad to take on Australia later this month.
paras.zh: 雄狮队在巴斯特尔以 211 分击败东道主后，以 276 分的优势赢得了比赛，这主要归功于来自汉普郡的快手埃迪·杰克 (Eddie Jack) 的五个三柱门，他已被纳入英格兰 T20I 阵容，将于本月晚些时候对阵澳大利亚。

paras.en: Glamorgan leg-spinner Mason Crane bagged three wickets.
paras.zh: 格拉摩根旋转腿球员梅森·克莱恩 (Mason Crane) 攻入三个三柱门。

paras.en: Earlier on with the bat, Lions captain Dan Lawrence - in England's Test squad for the winter trip to South Africa - chipped in with 76 from 56 deliveries and Hampshire youngster Ben Mayes notched an unbeaten 58 from 46.
paras.zh: 早些时候，雄狮队队长丹·劳伦斯（参加冬季南非之旅的英格兰测试队成员）在 56 次投球中投出 76 球，而汉普郡年轻球员本·梅耶斯则在 46 次投球中取得不败的 58 分。

paras.en: The Lions have won all five of their matches on the tour so far, following a 3-0 sweep in the T20 series by taking a 2-0 lead in the five-match one-day international leg.
paras.zh: 雄狮队在 T20 系列赛中以 3-0 横扫对手后，迄今为止已经赢得了巡回赛的所有五场比赛，并在五场比赛的一日国际赛中以 2-0 领先。

paras.en: The remaining 50-over matches are also in St Kitts, on Wednesday, Saturday and next Monday.
paras.zh: 剩余的 50 场以上比赛也将于周三、周六和下周一在圣基茨举行。

paras.en: Jack, Rew's younger brother Thomas - who made 22 in Monday's run-fest - and James Coles are the uncapped players in the senior England T20 international squad to battle Australia in five matches from November 21, with the opening fixture in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 杰克、卢的弟弟托马斯（在周一的跑步比赛中打进22分）和詹姆斯·科尔斯是英格兰T20国际成年队中未上场的球员，他们将从11月21日起与澳大利亚队进行五场比赛，首场比赛将在墨尔本举行。

paras.zh: 扩大后的 48 名选手阵容不再是 8 组，每组 4 人，而是分为 16 组，每组 3 人。

paras.en: Rather than the top two in each group progressing like in previous editions, only the top player from each group will progress.
paras.zh: 与之前版本不同的是，每组中的前两名选手都会晋级，只有每组中的顶尖选手才会晋级。

paras.en: That means each player only has two group stage matches rather than three, so every match will carry A LOT of weight.
paras.zh: 这意味着每个球员只有两场小组赛比赛，而不是三场，所以每场比赛都会有很大的分量。

paras.en: Effectively, each group is a round-robin format.
paras.zh: 实际上，每个组都是循环赛制。

paras.en: In the group stage, two points will be awarded for a win, and no points are awarded for a defeat.
paras.zh: 小组赛，胜者得两分，败者不得分。

paras.en: Should there be a three-way points tie in any group after the round-robin games have been played, these would be split as follows:
paras.zh: 如果循环赛结束后任何一组出现三路积分相同的情况，则按如下方式分配：

paras.en: Highest total tournament average (to two decimal places)
paras.zh: 最高锦标赛平均分（精确到小数点后两位）

paras.en: Highest winning match average (to two decimal places)
paras.zh: 最高获胜比赛平均数（精确到小数点后两位）

paras.en: If players cannot be split after the above criteria, a play-off will be organised between the players at the end of the session in which the final group game is played and will be a two or three-way nine-dart shootout in which the player scoring the most points is deemed the winner.
paras.zh: 如果按照上述标准仍无法分配选手，则将在最后一场小组赛结束时在选手之间进行附加赛，采用二人或三人九镖点球赛，得分最高的选手获胜。

paras.en: The order of throw would be determined by PDC ranking, with the highest ranked player having the option to throw first, second, or third.
paras.zh: 投掷顺序将由 PDC 排名决定，排名最高的玩家可以选择投第一、第二或第三。

paras.en: Following the completion of the Group Stage, each group winner will progress to the knockout stage from the last 16 onwards, and the tournament will proceed in bracket order as follows:
paras.zh: 小组赛结束后，各小组获胜者将从16强开始晋级淘汰赛，比赛按分组顺序进行如下：

paras.en: When and where is the Grand Slam of Darts?
paras.zh: 飞镖大满贯何时何地举行？

paras.en: The event takes place from Saturday November 14 through until Sunday November 22, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 该赛事将于 11 月 14 日星期六至 11 月 22 日星期日举行，由天空体育直播。

paras.en: The tournament is held at the WV Active Aldersley, Wolverhampton, with bumper crowds expected at every session.
paras.zh: 比赛在伍尔弗汉普顿的 WV Active Aldersley 举行，预计每场比赛都会迎来大量观众。

paras.en: Last year, Luke Littler came through with a 16-11 victory over Luke Humphries to go back-to-back in the major. In 2026, he will be going for his third Grand Slam title in a row.
paras.zh: 去年，卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 以 16-11 战胜卢克·汉弗里斯 (Luke Humphries)，连续两年获得大满贯赛冠军。 2026年，他将连续第三次夺得大满贯冠军。

paras.en: The money has gone up! The prize pot has increased from £650,000 in 2025 to a whopping £1,000,000 in 2026 thanks to the expanded field.
paras.zh: 钱涨了！由于参赛范围扩大，奖金从 2025 年的 65 万英镑增加到 2026 年的 100 万英镑。

paras.en: It means that the winner of the major will now take home £200,000, the runner-up clinching £100,000.
paras.zh: 这意味着大满贯冠军现在将获得 20 万英镑，亚军将获得 10 万英镑。

paras.en: The semi-finalists will secure £60,000 and the quarter-finalists will leave Wolverhampton with £35,000.
paras.zh: 半决赛选手将获得 60,000 英镑，四分之一决赛选手将获得 35,000 英镑离开狼队。

paras.en: If you make it to the last 16, £20,000 is the prize, while finishing second in a group means £12,500.
paras.zh: 如果你进入最后 16 强，奖金为 20,000 英镑，而小组第二则意味着 12,500 英镑。

paras.en: If you finish bottom in your group, you leave with £5,000.
paras.zh: 如果您在小组中排名垫底，您将获得 5,000 英镑离开。

paras.en: Littler is the most recent winner in 2024 and 2025, with Humphries claiming glory before him in 2023.
paras.zh: 利特勒是 2024 年和 2025 年最近的获胜者，汉弗莱斯在 2023 年在他之前获得了荣耀。

paras.en: Michael Smith ended his PDC major jinx in 2022 as he held the Eric Bristow Trophy aloft following his convincing 16-5 win over Nathan Aspinall.
paras.zh: 2022 年，迈克尔·史密斯 (Michael Smith) 以 16-5 令人信服地击败内森·阿斯皮纳尔 (Nathan Aspinall)，高举埃里克·布里斯托奖杯 (Eric Bristow Trophy)，结束了他在 PDC 的重大厄运。

paras.en: Since 2007, there have been just nine different winners of the Grand Slam of Darts. Phil Taylor is the most successful in the tournament with six victories, Van Gerwen and Gerwyn Price in joint second with three apiece.
paras.zh: 自2007年以来，飞镖大满贯只有九位不同的获胜者。菲尔·泰勒 (Phil Taylor) 获得六场胜利，成为本届锦标赛中最成功的选手，范·格文 (Van Gerwen) 和格文·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price) 各赢得三场胜利，并列第二。

paras.en: Littler could join that list with a third win in three straight years.
paras.zh: 利特勒可能会以连续三年第三次获胜的方式加入这一名单。

paras.en: Although there have only been eight winners, 19 different players have competed in the final with the likes of James Wade, Peter Wright and Anderson unable to pick up the trophy. Martin Lukeman was the latest to join that list in 2024.
paras.zh: 虽然获胜者只有8人，但决赛中有19名不同的球员角逐，其中詹姆斯·韦德、彼得·赖特和安德森等人都未能捧起奖杯。马丁·卢克曼 (Martin Lukeman) 于 2024 年最新加入该名单。

paras.en: Luke Humphries became the seventh player to throw a nine-darter in Grand Slam of Darts history during his victory over Michael Smith in Group A back in 2025.
paras.zh: 卢克·汉弗莱斯 (Luke Humphries) 在 2025 年 A 组比赛中击败迈克尔·史密斯 (Michael Smith)，成为飞镖大满贯历史上第七位投出九镖的选手。

paras.en: Humphries took out 144 to complete his third nine-darter of 2025 and wrap up a 5-3 victory, his second win of the tournament, with the 'perfect leg' the first at the event since Ryan Searle hit a nine-darter to win his Group D match against Nathan Rafferty in 2023.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯以 144 杆的成绩完成了他 2025 年的第三次九镖，并以 5-3 获胜，这是他在锦标赛中的第二场胜利，这是自瑞恩·塞尔 (Ryan Searle) 在 2023 年 D 组对阵内森·拉弗蒂 (Nathan Rafferty) 的比赛中瑞安·塞尔 (Ryan Searle) 击出九镖赢得胜利以来，他在赛事中的第一次“完美腿”。

paras.en: The first came from Wade back in 2008, with Josh Rock, Dmitri Van den Bergh, Dave Chisnall and Kim Huybrechts the others to do so. No player has previously fired a nine-dart leg at the Grand Slam of Darts and gone on to win the tournament that same year.
paras.zh: 第一个是韦德在 2008 年做出的，其他人还有乔什·洛克、德米特里·范登伯格、戴夫·奇斯纳尔和金·休布莱希茨。此前还没有哪位选手在飞镖大满贯赛上发射过九镖腿并在同年赢得了比赛。

paras.en: Sky Sports remains the home of darts with the Grand Slam of Darts (November 14-22) and World Darts Championship (December 11-January 3) all live. Stream darts and more through NOW with no contract.
paras.zh: 天空体育仍然是飞镖运动的主场，飞镖大满贯（11 月 14 日至 22 日）和世界飞镖锦标赛（12 月 11 日至 1 月 3 日）均进行现场直播。通过 NOW 流式传输飞镖等内容，无需签订合同。

articles.title: Nvidia opens investigation after CEO’s affair with alleged Chinese spy
articles.author: Dan De Luce

paras.en: Nvidia’s board of directors said Sunday that it is opening an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.
paras.zh: 英伟达董事会周日表示，在首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报机构的目标后，该公司正在展开独立调查。

paras.en: The announcement followed recent reporting by The New York Times and the Financial Times about Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman who the newspapers reported had been recruited to spy for China. The two are not related.
paras.zh: 此前，《纽约时报》和《金融时报》最近报道了黄与中国女商人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的关系，报纸报道说，黄爱丽被招募为中国从事间谍活动。两者没有关系。

paras.en: A person familiar with the matter told NBC News late Sunday that U.S. intelligence agencies had determined that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy and had a relationship with Nvidia’s Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士周日晚间告诉 NBC 新闻，美国情报机构已确定 Alice Huang 是中国间谍，并与 Nvidia 的 Jensen Huang 有关系。

paras.en: “The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort,” the company said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份声明中表示：“鉴于最近有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋已成为外国情报机构的目标，NVIDIA 董事会正在启动独立调查。”

paras.en: “A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders.”
paras.zh: “一个由独立董事组成的委员会将在外部独立顾问的协助下监督调查。董事会优先考虑美国国家和经济安全，这对 NVIDIA 及其股东的利益至关重要。”

paras.en: The company added that while it “has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board’s inquiry will examine all available information.”
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，虽然“没有理由相信国家安全或 NVIDIA 机密受到损害，但董事会的调查将检查所有可用信息。”

paras.en: In a memo to Nvidia employees that the company shared with NBC News, Huang said: “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did.”
paras.zh: 在该公司向 NBC 新闻分享的一份给 Nvidia 员工的备忘录中，黄仁勋表示：“我对我的妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的行为没有任何借口。”

paras.en: The New York Times and the Financial Times reported that Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen whose Singapore-based company was buying Nvidia’s advanced chips, had been under surveillance by U.S. intelligence agencies. Those agencies, the reports said, found that she had been recruited to spy by China’s top intelligence agency.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》和《金融时报》报道称，中国公民黄爱丽（Alice Huang）的新加坡公司正在购买英伟达的先进芯片，她一直受到美国情报机构的监视。报道称，这些机构发现她被中国最高情报机构招募从事间谍活动。

paras.en: Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun said Monday that “the so-called Chinese spy allegation is unsubstantiated. It is nothing but smears against China.”
paras.zh: 中国外交部发言人郭家琨周一表示，“所谓中国间谍指控毫无根据，完全是对中国的抹黑”。

paras.en: Jensen Huang and Nvidia, for years, have been at the forefront of the artificial intelligence boom. Nvidia’s products are the most highly sought-after chips in the world; however its top-tier products are mostly restricted from being sold to customers in China because of national security fears.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋和英伟达多年来一直处于人工智能热潮的前沿。 Nvidia 的产品是全球最受欢迎的芯片；然而，由于国家安全担忧，其顶级产品大多被限制出售给中国客户。

paras.en: China has long sought to become a global leader in AI. President Xi Jinping set a 2030 deadline to surpass the capabilities of American AI systems.
paras.zh: 长期以来，中国一直致力于成为人工智能领域的全球领导者。习近平主席设定了 2030 年超越美国人工智能系统能力的最后期限。

paras.en: Huang, 63, essentially serves as an ambassador for the industry, regularly appearing alongside the likes of President Donald Trump and King Charles III of Great Britain and at conferences to tout his company and what he says will be immense payoff in the future from AI.
paras.zh: 63 岁的黄仁勋本质上是该行业的大使，经常与唐纳德·特朗普总统和英国国王查尔斯三世等人一起出现在会议上，宣传他的公司以及他所说的人工智能未来将带来的巨大回报。

paras.en: In October, Trump awarded Huang the National Medal of Science, one of the nation’s highest honors for achievement in science and technology.
paras.zh: 十月，特朗普授予黄国家科学奖章，这是美国奖励科学技术成就的最高荣誉之一。

paras.en: Nvidia is the world’s second-largest publicly traded company as of Friday, worth nearly $4.5 trillion. Its shares are up more than 500% over the last five years.
paras.zh: 截至周五，Nvidia 是全球第二大上市公司，市值近 4.5 万亿美元。过去五年其股价上涨超过 500%。

paras.en: Nvidia shares fell more than 4% , erasing almost $200 billion in value. But the drop did not immediately spill over into other major tech stocks or to Nvidia’s peers, all of which appeared largely unaffected.
paras.zh: Nvidia 股价下跌超过 4%，市值蒸发近 2000 亿美元。但下跌并没有立即波及其他主要科技股或英伟达的同行，所有这些股票似乎基本上没有受到影响。

paras.en: The broader stock market, as tracked by the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, were sharply higher for the day.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数追踪的大盘当天大幅走高。

paras.en: “Given Huang’s central role in Nvidia’s success and the wider AI investment narrative, even speculation about leadership uncertainty could unsettle investors,” wrote Capital.com senior market analyst Daniela Hathorn in a note.
paras.zh: Capital.com 高级市场分析师 Daniela Hathorn 在一份报告中写道：“鉴于黄仁勋在英伟达的成功和更广泛的人工智能投资叙述中发挥的核心作用，即使是关于领导层不确定性的猜测也可能让投资者感到不安。”

paras.en: Huang’s wealth has also ballooned as he has led the company. His net worth has soared from around $25 billion at the start of 2022 to almost $160 billion, making him the world’s 10th-richest person, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index.
paras.zh: 在领导公司的过程中，黄的财富也不断膨胀。根据彭博亿万富翁指数，他的净资产从 2022 年初的约 250 亿美元飙升至近 1600 亿美元，成为全球第十大富豪。

paras.en: In the latest series of reports, published Sunday afternoon, The New York Times reported that concerns inside the U.S. government about Alice Huang and Jensen Huang rose as high as Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
paras.zh: 在周日下午发布的最新系列报道中，《纽约时报》报道称，美国政府内部对爱丽丝·黄和黄仁勋的担忧与国务卿马可·卢比奥一样高。

paras.en: Speaking Sunday to reporters in Florida shortly after Nvidia’s announcement, Rubio said, “I just can’t comment because of the nature of it, and I also can’t comment on an internal corporate matter that’s going on with Nvidia.”
paras.zh: 在英伟达宣布这一消息后不久，卢比奥周日在佛罗里达州对记者表示，“由于事情的性质，我无法发表评论，而且我也无法对英伟达正在发生的公司内部问题发表评论。”

paras.en: A short time later, Trump gave Huang his complete support, telling reporters that he thinks Huang is a “fine person” who should remain CEO of Nvidia. “I think he’s an honorable guy,” the president said.
paras.zh: 不久之后，特朗普对黄仁勋给予了全力支持，他对记者表示，他认为黄仁勋是一个“好人”，应该继续担任英伟达首席执行官。 “我认为他是一个值得尊敬的人，”总统说。

paras.en: “He’s done an amazing job for our country,” Trump added, while touting recent stock market gains. The president also said he would support bringing Huang on his upcoming trip through Asia.
paras.zh: “他为我们的国家做了一项了不起的工作，”特朗普在吹捧最近股市上涨的同时补充道。总统还表示，他将支持带黄参加他即将到来的亚洲之行。

paras.en: Asked by reporters if Trump wished that he had acted on intelligence about Alice Huang, he said, “no, I don’t think so.”
paras.zh: 当记者问特朗普是否希望他根据有关爱丽丝黄的情报采取行动时，他说：“不，我不这么认为。”

paras.en: On Friday, the FT reported that the U.S. government believed Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang. In response to the article, the FT reported that Nvidia declined to comment and said Jensen Huang meets “thousands of customer executives every year,” as any CEO normally does.
paras.zh: 周五，英国《金融时报》报道称，美国政府认为黄仁勋与黄爱丽丝有恋爱关系。作为对这篇文章的回应，英国《金融时报》报道称，英伟达拒绝置评，并表示黄仁勋每年都会与“数千名客户高管”会面，就像任何首席执行官通常所做的那样。

paras.en: Huang previously defended his interactions with Alice Huang, describing them as business-related in a recent statement: “Our relationship, our interactions, have been related to Megaspeed, and it was all completely normal and not unusual.”
paras.zh: 黄此前曾为自己与 Alice Huang 的互动进行了辩护，并在最近的一份声明中将其描述为与业务相关：“我们的关系、我们的互动都与 Megaspeed 有关，这完全是正常的，并不罕见。”

paras.en: In Sunday’s memo, Huang wrote: “To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust.”
paras.zh: 黄在周日的备忘录中写道：“致我的妻子和家人：我爱你们。我知道道歉无法挽回我所做的一切。我希望我们的家人能够痊愈，随着时间的推移，我可以重新赢得你们的信任。”

paras.en: The email to employees continued: “To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me. Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life. My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust. I have fallen short of that responsibility. I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence.”
paras.zh: 发给员工的电子邮件继续说道：“致 NVIDIA 的同事，包括那些与我共事数十年的同事，以及我们的董事会、全球各地的合作伙伴和股东：你们值得从我这里得到更好的待遇。领导 NVIDIA 是我一生的荣幸。我的责任是为你们服务并值得你们的信任。我没有履行这一责任。我完全致力于 NVIDIA，并将努力赢回你们的信任。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for Nvidia told NBC News that “today’s news will not slow” the company and that Huang is “committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption.”
paras.zh: 英伟达发言人告诉 NBC 新闻，“今天的消息不会让公司放慢脚步”，黄仁勋“致力于继续以首席执行官身份不间断地领导英伟达”。

paras.en: Before Sunday’s announcement, Nvidia and Huang were already facing congressional scrutiny over the reports about Megaspeed and its executive. On Thursday, top House Republicans requested a briefing from Huang about the reports.
paras.zh: 在周日宣布这一消息之前，英伟达和黄仁勋已经因有关 Megaspeed 及其高管的报道而面临国会审查。周四，众议院共和党高层要求黄蜂就这些报道进行简报。

paras.en: “Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC’s access to sensitive U.S. technology and information,” said Rep. John Moolenaar, R-Mich., who is also chairman of the House Select Committee on China. “PRC” is shorthand for the People’s Republic of China.
paras.zh: “最近的报告引发了有关中国获取美国敏感技术和信息的重大国家安全担忧，”兼任众议院中国问题特别委员会主席、密歇根州共和党众议员约翰·穆勒纳尔 (John Moolenaar) 表示。 “PRC”是中华人民共和国的简称。

paras.en: “It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk,” a letter to Nvidia read.
paras.zh: “国会必须确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度，这一点至关重要，”致英伟达的一封信中写道。

articles.title: Lifeguard in tears as she recalls drowning of nine-year-old boy
articles.author: Jackson Byrne

paras.en: Court hears family did not know boy who drowned in Waikerie pool had re-entered the water
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，家人并不知道在威凯里泳池溺水的男孩已重新入水

paras.en: An inquest is underway into the death of a nine-year-old-boy who drowned at the Waikerie Swimming Pool in 2022.
paras.zh: 一名 9 岁男孩于 2022 年在威凯里游泳池溺水身亡，目前正在进行调查。

paras.en: A 17-year-old lifeguard on duty at the time, who had only been working for two weeks, told the inquest she went into "shock" in the aftermath of the incident.
paras.zh: 当时值班的一名 17 岁救生员只工作了两周，她在调查中表示，事件发生后她感到“震惊”。

paras.en: The inquest will focus on the supervision and response of the lifeguards on duty.
paras.zh: 调查将重点关注值班救生员的监督和应对情况。

articles.title: Man jailed for performing Nazi salute during court hearing

paras.en: Man jailed for performing Nazi salute at police and during Hobart court hearing
paras.zh: 男子因在警察和霍巴特法庭听证会上行纳粹礼而入狱

paras.en: Tasmania Police arrested a man in August, who they said performed a Nazi salute while being taken into custody for disorderly conduct.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚州警方在8月份逮捕了一名男子，他们说他在因行为不检而被拘留时向纳粹致敬。

paras.en: The man later repeated the salute several times via video link during a Hobart court hearing, while also abusing a magistrate.
paras.zh: 该男子后来在霍巴特法庭听证会上通过视频连线多次重复敬礼，同时还辱骂了一名治安法官。

paras.en: The magistrate said the custodial sentence needed to act as a deterrent against such acts.
paras.zh: 治安法官表示，监禁刑罚需要对此类行为起到威慑作用。

articles.title: Wind farm approval will see 300-metre turbines erected in southern NSW
articles.author: Jess Scully

paras.en: The NSW Independent Planning Commission (IPC) has given Goldwind Capital the green light for the 1400-megawatt Baldon Wind Farm near Hay in southern NSW.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州独立规划委员会 (IPC) 已为金风资本在新南威尔士州南部海伊附近建设 1400 兆瓦 Baldon 风电场开了绿灯。

paras.en: The state-significant project was referred to the IPC due to substantial community opposition.
paras.zh: 由于社区的强烈反对，该国家重大项目被提交给 IPC。

paras.en: Goldwind Capital will need to adhere to conditions, including road upgrades and maintenance.
paras.zh: 金风资本需要遵守条件，包括道路升级和维护。

paras.en: One of the largest wind farm projects in NSW has been approved by the Independent Planning Commission (IPC) despite extensive community opposition.
paras.zh: 尽管遭到社区的广泛反对，新南威尔士州最大的风电场项目之一还是获得了独立规划委员会 (IPC) 的批准。

paras.en: The Baldon Wind Farm will feature 175 turbines up to 300 metres tall, which is 100 metres higher than any currently operating in NSW.
paras.zh: Baldon 风电场将配备 175 台高达 300 米的涡轮机，比新南威尔士州目前运营的任何涡轮机高 100 米。

paras.en: The state-significant development will be located in the South West Renewable Energy Zone [SW REZ] approximately 64 kilometres south-west of Hay.
paras.zh: 该州级重大开发项目将位于海伊西南约 64 公里处的西南可再生能源区 [SW REZ]。

paras.en: It is expected to generate a capacity of 1,400 megawatts, making it the second-largest in the state after the Bullawah Wind Farm and battery energy storage system was approved in October.
paras.zh: 预计发电量将达到1,400兆瓦，成为继10月份批准布拉瓦风电场和电池储能系统之后该州第二大发电站。

paras.en: Baldon's maximum turbine height of 300 metres, about 30 metres shy of the tip of the Eiffel Tower, would make them the tallest in the state by more than 100 metres.
paras.zh: Baldon 的涡轮机最大高度为 300 米，距离埃菲尔铁塔顶端约 30 米，这将使它们成为该州最高的涡轮机高度超过 100 米。

paras.en: Of the 80 submissions received during the project's original community consultation period, 72 were opposed to the project, which was referred to the IPC.
paras.zh: 在该项目最初的社区咨询期间收到的 80 份意见书中，有 72 份反对该项目，这些意见被提交给 IPC。

paras.en: Hay Shire Council supported the project.
paras.zh: 海郡议会支持该项目。

paras.en: The three-member IPC panel considered community concerns relating to excess traffic, potential contamination, cumulative impacts as well as decommissioning and rehabilitation.
paras.zh: 由三名成员组成的 IPC 小组考虑了社区对交通过量、潜在污染、累积影响以及退役和修复等问题的担忧。

paras.en: Conditions to mitigate those concerns were imposed as part of the approval.
paras.zh: 作为批准的一部分，还提出了减轻这些担忧的条件。

paras.en: Baldon Wind Farm will need to provide a traffic-management plan, commit to upgrading and maintaining local roads, and make good any development-related damage.
paras.zh: 巴尔登风电场需要提供交通管理计划，致力于升级和维护当地道路，并弥补与开发相关的任何损害。

paras.en: It will also have to develop and implement a decommissioning and rehabilitation plan.
paras.zh: 它还必须制定并实施退役和恢复计划。

paras.en: In December 2025, EnergyCo awarded access rights to transmission line infrastructure in the SW REZ.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，EnergyCo 授予了西南 REZ 输电线路基础设施的使用权。

paras.en: Those rights were awarded to Origin Energy's Yanco Delta Wind Farm (1,460MW), Spark Renewables' Dinawan Energy Hub (1,007MW), Bay WA's Bullwah Wind Farm (262.3MW), and Someva/AGL Energy's Pottinger Wind Farm (831.2 MW).
paras.zh: 这些权利被授予 Origin Energy 的 Yanco Delta 风电场（1,460MW）、Spark Renewables 的 Dinawan Energy Hub（1,007MW）、Bay WA 的 Bullwah 风电场（262.3MW）和 Someva/AGL Energy 的 Pottinger 风电场（831.2 MW）。

paras.en: The Baldon Wind Farm did not receive access.
paras.zh: 巴尔登风电场没有获得访问权限。

paras.en: That means while it will have capacity to produce 1,400 megawatts of power, it will initially only be able to harness a fraction of that.
paras.zh: 这意味着虽然它有能力产生 1,400 兆瓦的电力，但最初只能利用其中的一小部分。

paras.en: On its website, the company states that during stage one of development, 45 turbines will be built and the site will connect to the grid through the 220kV X5 Balranald to Darlington Point transmission line, a line separate from the REZ infrastructure.
paras.zh: 该公司在其网站上表示，在开发的第一阶段，将建造 45 台涡轮机，该站点将通过 220kV X5 Balranald 至 Darlington Point 输电线路（一条与 REZ 基础设施分开的线路）连接到电网。

paras.en: The website also states the project may further seek to gain access rights.
paras.zh: 该网站还指出，该项目可能会进一步寻求获得访问权。

paras.en: Baldon and three projects with access rights to the EnergyCo lines have secured funding from the federal government under the Capacity Investment Scheme, while Someva/AGL's Pottinger Wind farm is yet to receive Commonwealth funding.
paras.zh: Baldon 和三个拥有 EnergyCo 线路使用权的项目已根据容量投资计划从联邦政府获得资金，而 Someva/AGL 的 Pottinger 风电场尚未获得联邦资金。

paras.en: The ABC has contacted Goldwind Pty Ltd for comment.
paras.zh: ABC 已联系金风科技有限公司征求意见。

articles.title: 2026 Booker Prize goes to post-apocalyptic, sci-fi novel The End of Everything

paras.en: 2026 Booker Prize goes to post-apocalyptic, sci-fi novel The End of Everything
paras.zh: 2026 年布克奖颁给后世界末日科幻小说《一切的终结》

paras.en: M. John Harrison is 1st sci-fi writer to win annual U.K. prize that honours best novel written in English
paras.zh: 约翰·哈里森 (M. John Harrison) 是第一位荣获英国年度最佳英文小说奖的科幻作家

paras.en: English author M. John Harrison has won the 2026 Booker Prize for his novel The End of Everything, a post-apocalyptic adventure that explores what it means to be human in a shifting world.
paras.zh: 英国作家约翰·哈里森 (M. John Harrison) 凭借小说《一切的终结》获得 2026 年布克奖，这是一部后世界末日的冒险小说，探讨了在不断变化的世界中人类的意义。

paras.en: The £50,000 (approx. $94,893 Cdn) prize annually recognizes the best original novel written in the English language and published in the U.K.
paras.zh: 该奖项的奖金为 50,000 英镑（约合 94,893 加元），每年表彰在英国出版的最佳英文原创小说。

paras.en: The End of Everything is set in a slow-collapsing, near-future landscape along the Kent coast of the U.K. Years after an obscure, world-altering crisis, governments across the world barely function and the seas teem with strange new life.
paras.zh: 《一切的终结》以英国肯特郡海岸缓慢崩溃的近未来场景为背景。一场晦涩难懂、改变世界的危机发生多年后，世界各地的政府几乎无法运转，海洋中却充满了奇怪的新生命。

paras.en: Harrison becomes the first sci-fi author to win the award.
paras.zh: 哈里森成为第一位获得该奖项的科幻小说作家。

paras.en: Harrison is an author and literary critic. He sold his first story in 1965, and in 1969 joined the staff of the U.K. speculative fiction magazine New Worlds, where he edited the books pages until 1978.
paras.zh: 哈里森是一位作家和文学评论家。他于 1965 年售出自己的第一个故事，并于 1969 年加入英国推理小说杂志《新世界》的工作人员，在那里他编辑书籍页面，直到 1978 年。

paras.en: His novels include Climbers, which won the Boardman Tasker Prize for Mountain Literature in 1989; Nova Swing, which won the Arthur C. Clarke Award in 2007; and The Sunken Land Begins to Rise Again, which won the 2020 Goldsmiths Prize for innovation in fiction.
paras.zh: 他的小说包括《攀登者》，该书于 1989 年荣获博德曼·塔斯克山区文学奖； Nova Swing，2007年获得亚瑟·C·克拉克奖；以及荣获 2020 年小说创新金史密斯奖的《沉没的土地开始再次崛起》。

paras.en: A collection of short stories, You Should Come With Me Now, was published in 2017, and a volume of selected stories written between 1970 and 2020 was published under the title Settling the World.
paras.zh: 2017年出版了短篇小说集《你现在应该跟我来》，并出版了1970年至2020年间写的小说选集《安定世界》。

paras.en: This year's Booker Prize jury is comprised of poet, writer and educator Raymond Antrobus, musician, writer and broadcaster Jarvis Cocker, journalist, editor and critic Rebecca Liu and poet and essayist Patricia Lockwood.
paras.zh: 今年的布克奖评审团由诗人、作家和教育家雷蒙德·安特罗布斯、音乐家、作家和广播员贾维斯·科克、记者、编辑和评论家丽贝卡·刘以及诗人和散文家帕特里夏·洛克伍德组成。

paras.en: The jury is chaired by English classicist, writer and broadcaster Mary Beard.
paras.zh: 评审团主席由英国古典学家、作家兼广播员玛丽·比尔德 (Mary Beard) 担任。

paras.en: The shortlist also included Jamaican author Marlon James's The Disappearers, Scottish author Douglas Stuart’s John of John, U.K. poet and writer Luke Kennard's Black Bag, English writer Rebecca Perry's May We Feed the King and American author Elizabeth Strout's The Things We Never Say.
paras.zh: 入围名单还包括牙买加作家马龙·詹姆斯的《消失者》、苏格兰作家道格拉斯·斯图尔特的《约翰的约翰》、英国诗人兼作家卢克·肯纳德的《黑包》、英国作家丽贝卡·佩里的《我们可以喂饱国王》和美国作家伊丽莎白·斯特劳特的《我们从未说过的话》。

paras.en: The six-book shortlist was whittled down from a longlist of 13. Shortlisted writers will receive £2,500 (approx. $4,692 Cdn) and a specially bound copy of their book.
paras.zh: 入围名单有 6 本书，是从 13 本书中筛选出来的。入围作家将获得 2,500 英镑（约 4,692 加元）和一本特别装订的书。

paras.en: There are no Canadians on this year's list.
paras.zh: 今年的名单上没有加拿大人。

paras.en: Since 2013, authors from any nationality have been eligible for the Booker Prize.
paras.zh: 自2013年起，任何国籍的作家都有资格获得布克奖。

paras.en: In 2025, Montreal-born author David Szalay won the Booker prize for his novel Flesh.
paras.zh: 2025 年，出生于蒙特利尔的作家大卫·萨莱 (David Szalay) 凭借小说《肉体》获得布克奖。

paras.en: Two other Canadians have won the prize since its inception in 1969: Michael Ondaatje in 1992 for The English Patient and Yann Martel in 2002 for Life of Pi.
paras.zh: 自 1969 年设立以来，另外两位加拿大人也曾获奖：Michael Ondaatje 于 1992 年凭借《英国病人》获奖，Yann Martel 于 2002 年凭借《少年派的奇幻漂流》获奖。

articles.title: Could Nvidia survive without its ultra-powerful CEO, Jensen Huang?
articles.author: Abby Hughes

paras.en: Could Nvidia survive without its ultra-powerful CEO, Jensen Huang?
paras.zh: 如果没有超级强大的首席执行官黄仁勋，英伟达能否生存？

paras.en: Analysts say change at the top would be a big shakeup, but company would go on
paras.zh: 分析师表示，高层变动将是一次大变动，但公司将继续发展

paras.en: Jensen Huang, the leather-jacket-wearing and autograph-signing co-founder and CEO of Nvidia, has made himself a seemingly inseparable part of the AI chipmaker.
paras.zh: 身穿皮夹克、签名的英伟达联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋似乎已成为这家人工智能芯片制造商不可分割的一部分。

paras.en: But now that an investigation is underway into whether Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort, that tight control at the company's helm is creating worries about whether he could actually be replaced, if such a move were deemed necessary.
paras.zh: 但现在正在调查黄是否是外国情报活动的目标，公司掌舵人的严格控制令人担心如果认为有必要采取这样的举措，他是否真的可以被取代。

paras.en: The investigation comes after the New York Times reported late last week that Huang had a close romantic relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese tech executive who is accused of spying on behalf of China. It's unclear when he met the executive of Singapore-based cloud computing company Megaspeed, but the two were photographed together in 2024.
paras.zh: 此次调查是在《纽约时报》上周晚些时候报道黄与中国科技高管爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）关系密切之后展开的，后者被指控为中国从事间谍活动。目前还不清楚他何时认识了新加坡云计算公司 Megaspeed 的高管，但两人在 2024 年被拍到在一起。

paras.en: Nvidia's board said Sunday it had no reason to believe that state or company secrets were compromised, but was undertaking an independent investigation in light of the reports. U.S. House Republican committee leaders have also called on Jensen Huang to sit for a briefing on his relationship with the woman.
paras.zh: 英伟达董事会周日表示，没有理由相信国家或公司机密遭到泄露，但正在根据这些报告进行独立调查。美国众议院共和党委员会领导人也呼吁黄仁勋出席简报会，介绍他与这名女子的关系。

paras.en: In a message to his staff, Huang admitted to having an affair and apologized to his family and colleagues for breaking their trust.
paras.zh: 在给员工的信息中，黄承认自己有外遇，并向家人和同事道歉，因为他们辜负了他们的信任。

paras.en: "I am fully committed to Nvidia and will work to earn back your confidence," he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“我完全致力于英伟达，并将努力赢回你们的信心。”

paras.en: Huang will stay on as CEO while the investigation takes place. But if the board were to oust him, or if he changed course and stepped down, tech analysts like Dan Ives say finding someone to take his place would be nearly impossible.
paras.zh: 调查期间，黄将继续担任首席执行官。但如果董事会要罢免他，或者如果他改变路线并辞职，丹·艾夫斯等科技分析师表示，找到人来接替他的位置几乎是不可能的。

paras.en: "In my opinion, Jensen is a one of one," said Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co., a New York-based modern merchant bank. "Nvidia is here because of Jensen."
paras.zh: “在我看来，詹森是其中之一，”纽约现代商业银行约克维尔艾夫斯公司的合伙人兼高级董事总经理艾夫斯说。 “Nvidia 之所以能在这里，是因为 Jensen。”

paras.en: Nvidia began as a graphics card maker in 1993 until company leaders — Huang in particular — realized that its graphics processor units could power more than just games. The company pivoted to making chips for supercomputers in the early 2010s, betting on an artificial intelligence boom that wouldn't come for many years.
paras.zh: Nvidia 于 1993 年开始作为一家显卡制造商，直到公司领导人（尤其是黄仁勋）意识到其图形处理器单元不仅仅可以为游戏提供动力。该公司在 2010 年代初期转向生产超级计算机芯片，押注于人工智能的繁荣将在很多年内不会到来。

paras.en: An early partnership with OpenAI led to a long-term relationship with the ChatGPT creator, which still relies on Nvidia's chips to power its technology today. Amazon, Meta, Google and virtually every other company building AI tools rely on the chipmaker's hardware to power their systems.
paras.zh: 与 OpenAI 的早期合作关系导致了与 ChatGPT 创建者的长期合作关系，该创建者至今仍依赖 Nvidia 的芯片来为其技术提供动力。亚马逊、Meta、谷歌和几乎所有其他构建人工智能工具的公司都依赖芯片制造商的硬件来为其系统提供动力。

paras.en: Worth about $4.5 trillion US today, Nvidia is the second most valuable company in the world, and invaluable to the AI ecosystem as a whole, according to Ives.
paras.zh: 艾夫斯表示，Nvidia 目前价值约 4.5 万亿美元，是全球第二大最有价值的公司，对于整个人工智能生态系统来说具有无价的价值。

paras.en: - Nvidia probes whether CEO Jensen Huang targeted by foreign intelligence as he admits affair
paras.zh: - 英伟达调查首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情后是否成为外国情报目标

paras.en: - Can AI be regulated? Why experts say government intervention is needed — but could be tricky
paras.zh: - 人工智能可以被监管吗？为什么专家说需要政府干预——但可能很棘手

paras.en: From his place atop the massive company, Huang became something of a rock star, routinely signing fan autographs at public appearances. One of his signature leather jackets sold for more than $1 million at an auction earlier this year.
paras.zh: 从他在这家大公司的高层开始，黄成为了摇滚明星，经常在公开场合给粉丝签名。他的一件标志性皮夹克在今年早些时候的一次拍卖会上以超过 100 万美元的价格售出。

paras.en: "He's gotten to the point where he's sort of like the king of tech. Everybody listens to what Jensen has to say," said Bob O'Donnell, president and chief analyst at Technalysis Research.
paras.zh: “他已经到了有点像科技之王的地步。每个人都在听詹森说的话，”技术分析研究公司总裁兼首席分析师鲍勃·奥唐纳说。

paras.en: Outside of his own company, Huang has also championed the AI buildout, financially backing companies like cloud computing company CoreWeave and Anthropic, maker of the Claude chatbot. He has also dismissed fears about an AI bubble and challenged apocalyptic warnings about the technology's existential threat to humanity, and has forged a close relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 在自己的公司之外，黄还支持人工智能的建设，为云计算公司 CoreWeave 和 Claude 聊天机器人的制造商 Anthropic 等公司提供财务支持。他还消除了对人工智能泡沫的担忧，挑战了有关该技术对人类生存威胁的世界末日警告，并与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普建立了密切的关系。

paras.en: Ives says the loss of Huang's advocacy would be a major hit to the industry if he had to step away.
paras.zh: 艾夫斯表示，如果黄必须离开，失去他的支持将对该行业造成重大打击。

paras.en: Meanwhile, within the company, Huang created an unusually flat chain of command, with many employees reporting directly to him rather than to high-level executives. On a podcast earlier this year, Huang said as many as 60 people reported to him directly.
paras.zh: 与此同时，黄在公司内部建立了异常扁平的指挥系统，许多员工直接向他汇报，而不是向高层管理人员汇报。在今年早些时候的一个播客中，黄说有多达 60 人直接向他汇报。

paras.en: The company's site lists only a handful of high-ranking executives aside from Huang.
paras.zh: 该公司网站上仅列出了除黄之外的少数高级管理人员。

paras.en: Two of Huang's children are also on staff at the company — his son Spencer is director of product for robotics, while his daughter Madison is senior director of product marketing.
paras.zh: 黄的两个孩子也在该公司工作——他的儿子斯宾塞是机器人产品总监，而他的女儿麦迪逊是产品营销高级总监。

paras.en: With Huang having held control at Nvidia for so long, analysts say there is no clear successor.
paras.zh: 由于黄仁勋在英伟达执掌了很长时间，分析人士表示，目前还没有明确的继任者。

paras.en: "There's no one person or two people or three people that could replace Jensen. And that's a scary thing for investors, given this … black-eye moment that we're seeing," Ives said.
paras.zh: “没有一个人、两个人或三个人可以取代詹森。考虑到我们所看到的……糟糕的时刻，这对投资者来说是一件可怕的事情，”艾夫斯说。

paras.en: If Huang were forced to step down, Ives worries Nvidia would never fully recover from the loss of his leadership, given his integral role in the company's growth.
paras.zh: 如果黄仁勋被迫辞职，艾夫斯担心英伟达将永远无法从失去他的领导地位中完全恢复过来，因为他在公司的发展中发挥着不可或缺的作用。

paras.en: But others say with a firm as big as Nvidia, there are others who could take on the top job.
paras.zh: 但其他人表示，对于像英伟达这样大的公司，还有其他人可以担任最高职位。

paras.en: "You don't create a company that large by yourself, right? It's just not possible. There's a huge team of very strong, smart, capable people," O'Donnell said.
paras.zh: “你不可能自己创建一家这么大的公司，对吧？这是不可能的。有一个由非常强大、聪明、有能力的人组成的庞大团队，”奥唐纳说。

paras.en: While he agrees that Huang's loss would be massive, he says the company's technology roadmap — used to plan the next few years — is already laid out, making any potential successor's job easier.
paras.zh: 虽然他同意黄的损失将会是巨大的，但他表示，公司用于规划未来几年的技术路线图已经制定好了，这使得任何潜在继任者的工作都变得更加容易。

paras.en: O'Donnell expects Nvidia is on track to keep its leadership position among chipmakers for now, and doesn't expect a shakeup at the top would change that.
paras.zh: 奥唐纳预计英伟达目前有望保持其在芯片制造商中的领导地位，并且预计高层的改组不会改变这一点。

paras.en: Furthermore, with the board saying it has confidence in Huang, O'Donnell says he doesn't expect those members would try to oust him.
paras.zh: 此外，董事会表示对黄充满信心，奥唐纳表示，他预计这些成员不会试图罢免他。

paras.en: Still, if Huang does stay on as CEO, his grip on the company likely won't be so tight going forward, O'Donnell says, as other high-ranking executives are likely to take centre stage as spokespeople and dealmakers at least some of the time.
paras.zh: 奥唐纳表示，如果黄真的继续担任首席执行官，他对公司的控制可能不会那么紧，因为其他高级管理人员至少在某些时候可能会作为发言人和交易撮合者占据中心舞台。

paras.en: "It's hard to replace an iconic figure who just lights up a room," he said. But "if the board is smart, and I'm sure they are, they recognize they're going to have to address this so people can regain confidence in the company."
paras.zh: “很难取代一个仅仅照亮整个房间的标志性人物，”他说。但“如果董事会很聪明，我相信他们很聪明，他们就会认识到必须解决这个问题，这样人们才能重拾对公司的信心。”

articles.title: Trump downplays FBI probe into Nvidia chief's affair with alleged spy

paras.en: Trump downplays FBI probe into Nvidia chief's affair with alleged spy
paras.zh: 特朗普淡化联邦调查局对英伟达总裁与涉嫌间谍事件的调查

paras.en: 'I think that he'll be in good shape,' Trump says at White House briefing
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫新闻发布会上表示：“我认为他会保持良好状态”

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday that the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese government agent, but said he doesn't think the executive who has helped to develop artificial intelligence has a reason to worry.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示，联邦调查局正在调查英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国政府特工的关系，但他表示，他认为这位帮助开发人工智能的高管没有理由担心。

paras.en: "I know the FBI is looking into it in terms of something else, and I think that he'll be in good shape," Trump said at a White House briefing.
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫新闻发布会上表示：“我知道联邦调查局正在从其他方面调查此事，我认为他会状况良好。”

paras.en: The sudden emergence of Huang's infidelity has rocked the political class and America's tech sector, creating new concerns about whether China has been able to access the cutting-edge chips designed by Nvidia that are powering the development of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 黄的不忠事件的突然出现震惊了政治阶层和美国科技行业，引发了人们对中国是否能够获得英伟达设计的推动人工智能发展的尖端芯片的新担忧。

paras.en: Trump suggested the extraordinary step of directly involving himself in a counterintelligence investigation, a sign of his friendly relationship with Huang and the possible geopolitical stakes.
paras.zh: 特朗普建议采取非同寻常的步骤，直接参与反情报调查，这是他与黄的友好关系以及可能的地缘政治利益的标志。

paras.en: "I did speak to him today just to see if he's feeling all right, how you're doing," Trump said. "He said he had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy."
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我今天确实和他谈过，只是想看看他是否感觉还好，你过得怎么样。” “他说他完全不知道这个人是间谍。”

paras.en: Huang — a singular figure in the technology landscape and one of the world's wealthiest people — has acknowledged he had an affair, issuing an apology to his wife and to the company in an open letter posted on Nvidia's website. The New York Times reported that U.S. intelligence determined that the woman was gathering information for Beijing.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋是科技界的杰出人物，也是世界上最富有的人之一，他承认自己有外遇，并在英伟达网站上发布的一封公开信中向妻子和公司道歉。 《纽约时报》报道称，美国情报部门确定该女子正在为北京收集信息。

paras.en: "I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America's national security," Huang said in his letter.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋在信中表示：“我支持调查并将全力配合。我热爱我们的国家和我们的公司。我致力于保护 NVIDIA 并支持美国的国家安全。”

paras.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks at an event in London, on Oct. 14. (Kwiyeon Ha/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日，Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋在伦敦举行的一次活动上发表讲话。（Kwiyeon Ha/美联社）

paras.en: Nvidia announced Sunday it was conducting an independent investigation into reports that Huang was the "target of a foreign intelligence effort."
paras.zh: 英伟达周日宣布，正在对有关黄是“外国情报工作目标”的报道进行独立调查。

paras.en: The episode also is attracting congressional scrutiny, with top Democrats Sen. Mark Warner and Rep. Hakeem Jeffries saying Monday they are interested in investigating it further. Jeffries said the Nvidia issue came up during a closed-door session with the CIA director and the director of national intelligence that was primarily about Iran.
paras.zh: 这一事件也引起了国会的审查，民主党参议员马克·沃纳和众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯周一表示，他们有兴趣进一步调查此事。杰弗里斯表示，英伟达的问题是在与中央情报局局长和国家情报总监的一次闭门会议上提出的，会议主要涉及伊朗问题。

paras.en: "We're going to need a full briefing, specifically as it relates to the Nvidia issue, so we can all get to the bottom of what has happened," he said, "and what the implications are in terms of America's national security."
paras.zh: 他说：“我们需要一份完整的简报，特别是与英伟达问题相关的简报，这样我们才能了解到底发生了什么，以及这对美国国家安全的影响。”

paras.en: Trump is slated to meet next week with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China, at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, but he was noncommittal about bringing up the situation with Xi.
paras.zh: 特朗普定于下周在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作峰会上与中国领导人习近平会面，但他对向习近平提及这一情况不置可否。

paras.en: "No, I don't think so," Trump said. "I mean, maybe. I'm sure President XI will ask me about it. I just know Jensen very well. I just think he's a very honourable man."
paras.zh: “不，我不这么认为，”特朗普说。 “我的意思是，也许吧。我确信十一主席会问我这件事。我非常了解詹森。我只是认为他是一个非常值得尊敬的人。”

paras.en: FBI counterintelligence investigations often examine efforts by foreign powers to spy on the United States, whether by surreptitiously stealing technology designed by American companies, covertly waging foreign influence campaigns aimed at shaping public opinion or cultivating relationships with powerful political and industry figures.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局的反情报调查经常审查外国势力对美国进行间谍活动的行为，无论是秘密窃取美国公司设计的技术，还是秘密发起旨在塑造公众舆论的外国影响力活动，或者培养与强大的政治和行业人物的关系。

paras.en: Such investigations can take years and do not necessarily culminate in criminal charges. China has been regarded across presidential administrations of both political parties as a persistent counterintelligence threat.
paras.zh: 此类调查可能需要数年时间，并且不一定最终会导致刑事指控。中国被两党总统政府视为持续的反情报威胁。

paras.en: China denied Monday that it engaged in an attempt to ensnare Huang. "The so-called Chinese spy allegation is unsubstantiated. It is nothing but smears against China," Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson Guo Jiakun said.
paras.zh: 中国周一否认试图诱捕黄。外交部发言人郭家坤表示，所谓中国间谍指控毫无根据，完全是对中国的抹黑。

paras.en: Beijing had earlier had dismissed a New York Times report saying Huang had developed a close relationship with a Chinese citizen named Alice Huang, who ran a company that last year faced claims it was illicitly shipping advanced Nvidia computer chips into China.
paras.zh: 北京早些时候驳回了《纽约时报》的一篇报道，称黄与一位名叫爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)的中国公民建立了密切关系，后者经营着一家公司，该公司去年被指控非法向中国运送先进的英伟达计算机芯片。

paras.en: The Times said she was a former executive of a Singapore-based data centre company called Megaspeed International, whose website prominently touts its partnership with Nvidia, and that U.S. intelligence had determined she was gathering information for Beijing.
paras.zh: 《泰晤士报》称，她是一家名为 Megaspeed International 的新加坡数据中心公司的前高管，该公司的网站大力宣传其与 Nvidia 的合作关系，美国情报部门已确定她正在为北京收集信息。

paras.en: Many offices in Singapore were closed on Monday for a holiday. Megaspeed and the Singapore Ministry of Home Affairs did not immediately reply to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 新加坡的许多办事处周一因假期而关闭。 Megaspeed 和新加坡内政部没有立即回复置评请求。

paras.en: Nvidia is one of the world's most valuable publicly traded companies, alongside Apple and Microsoft. Its sales of computer chips to China have at times been targeted by U.S. regulators seeking to limit Beijing's access to such technology.
paras.zh: 英伟达是世界上最有价值的上市公司之一，与苹果和微软齐名。该公司向中国销售计算机芯片的行为有时会成为美国监管机构的目标，试图限制北京获取此类技术。

paras.en: The Nvidia logo is displayed at the Computex Taipei expo in Taipei, Taiwan, on June 3. (Chiang Ying-ying/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 6 月 3 日，Nvidia 徽标在台湾台北国际电脑展上展示。（Chiang Ying-ying/美联社）

paras.en: "The key questions are whether he was aware of any espionage activities and whether any confidential or strategically sensitive information was compromised," said George Chen, a partner and chair of digital practice at The Asia Group, a Washington-based consultancy.
paras.zh: 华盛顿咨询公司亚洲集团 (The Asia Group) 合伙人兼数字业务主席乔治·陈 (George Chen) 表示：“关键问题是他是否了解任何间谍活动，以及任何机密或战略敏感信息是否遭到泄露。”

paras.en: "Those questions require evidence rather than speculation," he added in a text message to reporters.
paras.zh: “这些问题需要证据而不是猜测，”他在给记者的短信中补充道。

paras.en: Chinese media have largely focused on Huang admitting to the affair and state media outlets have mainly echoed the official government line. Some have said the New York Times report was aimed at destabilizing U.S.-China relations.
paras.zh: 中国媒体主要关注黄承认此事，官方媒体主要回应政府官方路线。一些人表示，《纽约时报》的报道旨在破坏美中关系稳定。

paras.en: "Whenever China-U.S. relations begin to improve, there are often those firing shots from the shadows," the state-owned Global Times said.
paras.zh: “每当中美关系开始改善时，往往就会有人在暗处开枪，”国有媒体《环球时报》称。

articles.title: Macrons file new defamation lawsuit against US podcaster over transgender rumours
articles.author: FRANCE 24

paras.en: Macrons file new defamation lawsuit against US podcaster over transgender rumours
paras.zh: 马克龙就跨性别谣言对美国播客提起新的诽谤诉讼

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte filed a second lawsuit against US right-wing podcaster Candace Owens over false claims on her gender, accusing her of continuing to spread the allegations and profiting from them despite earlier legal action.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和他的妻子布丽吉特对美国右翼播客坎迪斯·欧文斯提起第二次诉讼，指控她不顾之前的法律行动，继续散布这些指控并从中获利。

paras.en: Emmanuel and Brigitte Macron filed a new defamation lawsuit in the United States last week against right-wing influencer Candace Owens, who claims the French president's wife is a transgender woman.
paras.zh: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和布丽吉特·马克龙上周在​​美国对右翼影响者坎迪斯·欧文斯提起新的诽谤诉讼，欧文斯声称法国总统的妻子是一名跨性别女性。

paras.en: The Macrons filed suit in a federal court in the southern state of Tennessee, where Owens resides, arguing that the conservative podcaster has "used this false statement to promote her independent platform, gain notoriety, and make money".
paras.zh: 马克龙夫妇向欧文斯居住的南部田纳西州联邦法院提起诉讼，称这位保守派播客“利用这一虚假声明来宣传她的独立平台，获得恶名并赚钱”。

paras.en: Owens confirmed the lawsuit Monday, writing on X, that the "Macrons have indeed filed a NEW set of claims against me".
paras.zh: 欧文斯周一证实了这起诉讼，他在 X 上写道，“马克龙家族确实对我提出了一系列新的索赔”。

paras.en: The latest filing comes after a judge limited the scope of their previous complaint at the end of October, for a case that was filed in Delaware in 2025.
paras.zh: 在提交最新文件之前，法官于 10 月底限制了他们之前针对 2025 年在特拉华州提起的案件的投诉范围。

paras.en: In the Delaware case, the judge dismissed the case against Owens, as an individual, on jurisdictional grounds but allowed proceedings against her companies to continue.
paras.zh: 在特拉华州案件中，法官以管辖权为由驳回了针对欧文斯个人的案件，但允许继续针对她的公司的诉讼。

paras.en: In the latest suit, the Macrons accuse Owens of "unequivocally" doubling down after the first lawsuit was filed.
paras.zh: 在最新的诉讼中，马克龙夫妇指责欧文斯在第一次诉讼提起后“明确”加倍下注。

paras.en: "She has continued to use her podcast to expand her lies about the Macrons, sell merchandise making fun of the Macrons, and collect donations based on her 'reporting' on the Macrons," according to the 411-page complaint.
paras.zh: 这份长达 411 页的起诉书称，“她继续利用播客来散布关于马克龙家族的谎言，出售取笑马克龙家族的商品，并根据她对马克龙家族的‘报道’收集捐款。”

paras.en: While the Macrons called Owen's content "verifiably false and devastating lies", they noted "there is nothing shameful or defamatory about being a man, being transgender, or being gay. Owens' statements are defamatory because they accuse the Macrons of lying to France and to the world, for decades, about who Mrs. Macron is – and of committing crimes to conceal that supposed lie."
paras.zh: 虽然马克龙夫妇称欧文的内容是“可证实的虚假和毁灭性谎言”，但他们指出“作为一个男人、变性人或同性恋，并没有什么可耻或诽谤性的。欧文斯的言论具有诽谤性，因为他们指责马克龙夫妇几十年来在马克龙夫人是谁的问题上向法国和全世界撒谎，并为掩盖这个所谓的谎言而犯下罪行。”

paras.en: Brigitte Macron, 73, has also taken to the courts in France to combat claims she was born a man.
paras.zh: 73 岁的布丽吉特·马克龙 (Brigitte Macron) 也向法国法院提起诉讼，驳斥她生为男性的说法。

paras.en: Two women were convicted in September 2024 of spreading false claims after they posted a YouTube video in December 2021 alleging that Brigitte Macron had once been a man named Jean-Michel Trogneux – who is actually her brother.
paras.zh: 两名妇女于 2021 年 12 月在 YouTube 上发布一段视频，指控布丽吉特·马克龙曾经是一个名叫让-米歇尔·特罗涅克斯 (Jean-Michel Trogneux) 的男子（实际上是她的兄弟），两名妇女于 2024 年 9 月因传播虚假信息而被定罪。

paras.en: The fake news about Brigitte Macron has regularly resurfaced on French social media since her husband's first election in 2017.
paras.zh: 自布丽吉特·马克龙 (Brigitte Macron) 2017 年首次当选以来，有关布丽吉特·马克龙 (Brigitte Macron) 的假新闻经常在法国社交媒体上出现。

paras.en: But it flourished abroad and particularly in the United States after Owens seized on it in March 2024, creating social media content and a video series titled "Becoming Brigitte".
paras.zh: 但在欧文斯于 2024 年 3 月抓住这一机会，创作了社交媒体内容和名为“成为布丽吉特”的视频系列后，它在国外，尤其是在美国蓬勃发展。

paras.en: "These claims are demonstrably false, and Owens knew they were false when she published them," the court filing said.
paras.zh: 法庭文件称：“这些说法显然是错误的，欧文斯在发表这些说法时就知道这些说法是错误的。”

paras.en: "These lies have caused tremendous damage to the Macrons. Defendant has subjected the Macrons to a campaign of global humiliation."
paras.zh: “这些谎言给马克龙家族造成了巨大的伤害。被告让马克龙家族遭受了一场全球性的羞辱。”

articles.title: EU aims to pick new ECB chief by year-end

paras.en: The European Union (EU) wants to name the next head of the European Central Bank by the end of the year, Eurogroup chief Kyriakos Pierrakakis said Monday.
paras.zh: 欧元集团主席基里亚科斯·皮耶拉卡基斯周一表示，欧盟希望在今年年底前任命下一任欧洲央行行长。

paras.en: Christine Lagarde, who has headed the ECB for seven years, announced on October 29 that she is stepping down from the position prematurely, nine months before the end of her term.
paras.zh: 担任欧洲央行行长七年的克里斯蒂娜·拉加德于 10 月 29 日宣布，她将在任期结束前 9 个月提前辞去职务。

paras.en: Lagarde's decision to step down early makes the schedule tight for EU leaders because they must also fill two other seats on the ECB's Executive Board within months.
paras.zh: 拉加德提前辞职的决定使欧盟领导人的日程安排变得紧张，因为他们还必须在几个月内填补欧洲央行执行委员会的另外两个席位。

paras.en: "The ambition here is that the whole process would have completed itself by the end of the year," Pierrakakis said before a Eurogroup meeting of eurozone finance ministers.
paras.zh: 皮拉卡基斯在欧元区财长欧元集团会议上表示：“我们的目标是整个过程将在今年年底前完成。”

paras.en: "We understand that we need to move fast. But what has traditionally happened in the past is that this was a decision driven by the leaders. Today it will be primarily an information point and the discussion," he said.
paras.zh: “我们知道我们需要快速行动。但过去发生的传统情况是，这是由领导人推动的决定。今天这将主要是一个信息点和讨论，”他说。

paras.en: The two candidates to replace Lagarde are former Dutch Central Bank Governor Klaas Knot and the head of the Bank for International Settlements, Pablo Hernandez de Cos from Spain.
paras.zh: 接替拉加德的两名候选人是前荷兰央行行长克拉斯·诺特和国际清算银行行长、西班牙人巴勃罗·埃尔南德斯·德科斯。

paras.en: Pierrakakis said that Dutch and Spanish ministers would present their candidates and that later on Monday he would meet with Antonio Costa, head of the European Council, which represents EU governments' heads.
