paras.en: Paolone discusses how Magnaflow’s long-term approach to investment, vertical integration and market expansion is positioning the company for continued growth across the aftermarket and OE channels.
paras.zh: Paolone 讨论了 Magnaflow 的长期投资、垂直整合和市场扩张方法如何使公司在售后市场和原厂渠道上实现持续增长。

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Dan Paolone, president, Magnaflow.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 Magnaflow 总裁 Dan Paolone。

paras.en: Paolone said Magnaflow’s family-owned heritage has shaped both its culture and its long-term approach to the market. Founded in 1981 by his uncle, Jerry Paolone, the company has operated around a “build it and stand by it” philosophy while emphasizing lasting relationships and accountability from design through manufacturing. While Magnaflow is widely associated with performance exhaust, Paolone emphasized that the company is fundamentally an emissions and exhaust business, with approximately 10,000 SKUs across catalytic converters and BRExhaust. That breadth, combined with its premium performance brands, gives Magnaflow a much broader aftermarket presence than its performance reputation alone might suggest, he explained.
paras.zh: Paolone 表示，Magnaflow 的家族传统塑造了其文化和长期市场策略。该公司由他的叔叔 Jerry Paolone 于 1981 年创立，围绕“打造并坚持”的理念运营，同时强调从设计到制造的持久关系和责任。虽然 Magnaflow 与高性能排气有着广泛的联系，但 Paolone 强调，该公司本质上是一家排放和排气业务，在催化转换器和 BRExhaust 方面拥有大约 10,000 个 SKU。他解释说，这种广度，加上其优质的性能品牌，使 Magnaflow 拥有比其性能声誉本身所暗示的更广泛的售后市场影响力。

articles.title: Collision Industry Asked to Support SkillsUSA Students Through Sulkala Family Fund
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Sulkala Family Fund is calling on collision repair shops, insurers, suppliers and industry professionals to sponsor one or more students so skill — not travel costs — determines who competes at the SkillsUSA National Leadership & Skills Conference.
paras.zh: 苏卡拉家庭基金呼吁碰撞维修店、保险公司、供应商和行业专业人士赞助一名或多名学生，以便技能（而不是旅行费用）决定谁能参加 SkillsUSA 全国领导力和技能大会。

paras.en: Charles S. “Chuck” Sulkala spent more than half a century shaping the collision repair industry, leading the family business Acme Body & Paint in the Boston area and co-founding the National Auto Body Council, which he led as executive director until his retirement at the end of 2017. With that organization, he launched many initiatives including Camp Mak-A-Dream, Hurricane Katrina Relief, Recycled Rides and First Responder Emergency Extrication (F.R.E.E). He also chaired I-CAR, the Society of Collision Repair Specialists and the Collision Industry Conference (CIC), and his honors include I-CAR’s Lifetime Contribution Award and induction into the Hall of Eagles.
paras.zh: Charles S.“Chuck”Sulkala 花了半个多世纪的时间塑造碰撞修复行业，领导波士顿地区的家族企业 Acme Body & Paint，并与他人共同创立了国家汽车车身委员会，并担任执行董事直至 2017 年底退休。在该组织中，他发起了许多举措，包括麦梦营 (Camp Mak-A-Dream)、卡特里娜飓风救援、回收游乐设施和急救人员紧急救援（免费）。他还担任 I-CAR、碰撞修复专家协会和碰撞行业会议 (CIC) 的主席，他获得的荣誉包括 I-CAR 的终身贡献奖和入选老鹰厅。

paras.en: His son, Charles Edward “Chad” Sulkala, carried the family’s commitment forward. After joining Acme Body and Paint in 1998, he worked at Allstate, Esurance and CCC Information Services and held leadership roles with SCRS, I-CAR, NABC and CIECA, which recognized him with its Outstanding Leadership Award in 2017. He chaired CIC committees and helped develop the “Gap Statement” standard. Chad passed away unexpectedly on May 31, 2025 at age 54.
paras.zh: His son, Charles Edward “Chad” Sulkala, carried the family’s commitment forward. 1998 年加入 Acme Body and Paint 后，他曾在 Allstate、Esurance 和 CCC Information Services 工作，并在 SCRS、I-CAR、NABC 和 CIECA 担任领导职务，并于 2017 年荣获杰出领导奖。他担任 CIC 委员会主席并帮助制定“差距声明”标准。 Chad passed away unexpectedly on May 31, 2025 at age 54.

paras.en: The Sulkala Family Fund continues that multi-generational legacy. It provides travel grants to qualified SkillsUSA state winners in collision repair-related competitions who may otherwise be unable to afford the costs of attending the national competition. A $2,500 sponsorship covers travel, lodging and contest-related expenses so a state winner can showcase their talents on the national stage.
paras.zh: 苏卡拉家庭基金延续了这一多代人的遗产。它为碰撞修复相关比赛中合格的 SkillsUSA 州获胜者提供旅行补助，否则他们可能无法承担参加全国比赛的费用。 2,500 美元的赞助包括旅行、住宿和比赛相关费用，以便州获胜者可以在国家舞台上展示他们的才华。

paras.en: “When a collision repair student wins at the state SkillsUSA competition, the next step is nationals, and your sponsorship helps cover a travel grant so skill — not expenses — decides who competes,” said Chuck Sulkala.
paras.zh: “当一名碰撞修复学生在美国技能大赛中获胜时，下一步就是全国比赛，而您的赞助将有助于支付旅行补助金，因此决定谁参加比赛的是技能，而不是费用，”查克·苏卡拉说。

paras.en: Industry professionals are invited to join “Team Chad” by sponsoring a student and helping ensure the best students are visible to the industry.
paras.zh: 邀请行业专业人士加入“Chad 团队”，赞助一名学生并帮助确保最优秀的学生能够被行业看到。

paras.en: To donate and help support a student, visit sulkalafamilyfund.org or e-mail [email protected].
paras.zh: 要捐赠并帮助支持学生，请访问 sulkalafamilyfund.org 或发送电子邮件 [email protected]。

articles.title: AirPro + Revv Launch Four New Products at First SEMA Show as Combined Company
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: AirPro + Revv announced four new solutions at the SEMA Show, their first public appearance as a joint company. Built on the combined company’s software and diagnostic expertise, the new solutions are designed to simplify ADAS repairs for shops and their technicians. The new suite includes Identify, Wheel & Tire, the Side-by-Side Chrome Extension and Auggie Air. Each addresses a different stage of the repair process and works alongside the solutions shops already use.
paras.zh: AirPro + Revv 在 SEMA 展会上宣布了四款新解决方案，这是他们作为联合公司首次公开亮相。新解决方案以合并后公司的软件和诊断专业知识为基础，旨在简化商店及其技术人员的 ADAS 维修。新套件包括Identify、Wheel & Tire、Side-by-Side Chrome Extension 和 Auggie Air。每个解决方案都针对维修过程的不同阶段，并与商店已经使用的解决方案一起使用。

paras.en: ADAS is now standard in nearly every new vehicle, yet shops still have to handle calibrations across fragmented systems and providers. With software and diagnostic services now under one roof, AirPro + Revv are connecting calibration identification, diagnostic services and repair documentation in one workflow. The joint company now processes more than one million vehicles a year and covers 98% of vehicle brands on the road.
paras.zh: ADAS 现在几乎是每辆新车的标准配置，但商店仍然必须处理分散的系统和供应商之间的校准。现在，软件和诊断服务集中在一个平台上，AirPro + Revv 将校准识别、诊断服务和维修文档连接到一个工作流程中。该合资公司目前每年处理超过 100 万辆汽车，覆盖道路上 98% 的汽车品牌。

paras.en: “AirPro and Revv merged to create a seamless, end-to-end platform,” said Driaan du Toit, CEO of AirPro + Revv. “We’re helping shops identify what the OEM requires, perform the work correctly and accurately document what was done to support reimbursement. These four new solutions support and build on this larger mission.”
paras.zh: AirPro + Revv 首席执行官 Driaan du Toit 表示：“AirPro 和 Revv 合并创建了一个无缝的端到端平台。” “我们正在帮助商店确定 OEM 的要求，正确执行工作并准确记录为支持报销所做的工作。这四种新解决方案支持并建立在这一更大的使命之上。”

paras.en: The four new solutions extend the platform across key stages of the ADAS workflow:
paras.zh: 这四种新解决方案将平台扩展到 ADAS 工作流程的关键阶段：

paras.en: - Identify: Reviews OEM requirements, the repair estimate and the vehicle’s scan to identify OEM-required calibrations. It also asks targeted follow-up questions to confirm details that scans and estimates don’t show, so technicians can verify what’s required while the vehicle is in the bay. Those answers help determine which required calibrations apply and document why the work is needed.
paras.zh: - 识别：审查 OEM 要求、维修估算和车辆扫描，以识别 OEM 要求的校准。它还会提出有针对性的后续问题，以确认扫描和估计未显示的细节，以便技术人员可以在车辆停泊时验证所需的内容。这些答案有助于确定适用哪些所需的校准并记录为什么需要进行这项工作。

paras.en: - Wheel & Tire: Shows shops which calibrations are needed for tire and alignment jobs before work begins. Shops can share the OEM documentation with customers to explain why the work matters and then schedule it through their shop management system.
paras.zh: - 车轮和轮胎：在工作开始之前向商店展示轮胎和定位工作需要进行哪些校准。商店可以与客户共享 OEM 文档，以解释工作的重要性，然后通过商店管理系统进行安排。

paras.en: - Side-by-Side Chrome Extension: Puts AirPro’s diagnostic scans alongside Revv’s calibration reports and work orders on one screen. Technicians can see what each vehicle needs and where the job stands without switching between systems, and request a remote diagnostic technician directly from Revv.
paras.zh: - 并排 Chrome 扩展：将 AirPro 的诊断扫描与 Revv 的校准报告和工作订单放在一个屏幕上。技术人员无需在系统之间切换即可查看每辆车的需求和工作位置，并直接从 Revv 请求远程诊断技术人员。

paras.en: - Auggie Air: One-of-a-kind front-facing camera calibration tool that fits directly onto the vehicle’s windshield and enables glass repairers to perform calibrations accurately and efficiently at their client’s location. It works both indoors and outdoors and folds down to about the size of a briefcase.
paras.zh: - Auggie Air：独一无二的前置摄像头校准工具，可直接安装在车辆的挡风玻璃上，使玻璃维修人员能够在客户所在地准确高效地进行校准。它可以在室内和室外使用，并且可以折叠成公文包大小。

paras.en: Together, the four solutions offer a first look at the combined company’s vision for simplifying ADAS repairs and helping shops identify required work, coordinate services and build the documentation that supports reimbursement.
paras.zh: 这四种解决方案共同展现了合并后公司简化 ADAS 维修、帮助商店确定所需工作、协调服务和构建支持报销的文档的愿景。

paras.en: For more information on Revv, visit revvhq.com.
paras.zh: 有关Revv的更多信息，请访问revvhq.com。

paras.en: For more information on AirPro Diagnostics, visit airprodiagnostics.com.
paras.zh: 有关 AirPro 诊断的更多信息，请访问 airprodiagnostics.com。

articles.title: On Target continues taking a look at SRS repair procedures
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Bronco SRS information from Volumes 2 and 3 is found in “Section 501-20B: Supplemental Restraint System, Description and Operation” of the Ford Workshop Manual (WSM).
paras.zh: 第 2 卷和第 3 卷中的 Bronco SRS 信息可在福特维修手册 (WSM) 的“第 501-20B 节：补充约束系统、描述和操作”中找到。

paras.en: On Target warns that incorrect repair techniques or actions can cause SRS to deploy accidentally.
paras.zh: On Target 警告不正确的修复技术或操作可能会导致 SRS 意外部署。

paras.en: “Never compromise or depart from these instructions,” On Target states. “Failure to precisely follow all instructions could result in serious personal injury from an accidental deployment.”
paras.zh: “永远不要妥协或背离这些指示，” On Target说。“不严格遵守所有说明可能会导致意外部署造成严重的人身伤害。”

paras.en: Before installing a safety canopy or side air curtain assembly, repairers should inspect the roofline for any damage because sheet metal may need to be reworked to its original condition and structural integrity. Repairers need to inspect fasteners for damage. If damaged, replace them and remove any foreign material.
paras.zh: 在安装安全顶篷或侧气帘组件之前，维修人员应检查车顶线是否有任何损坏，因为金属板可能需要重新加工至其原始状态和结构完整性。维修人员需要检查紧固件是否损坏。 If damaged, replace them and remove any foreign material.

paras.en: “Failure to follow these instructions may result in the safety canopy or side air curtain deploying incorrectly, which increases the risk of serious personal injury or death in a crash,” On Target states.
paras.zh: On Target 表示：“不遵守这些说明可能会导致安全顶篷或侧气帘展开不正确，从而增加碰撞中严重人身伤害或死亡的风险。”

paras.en: How SRS is repowered depends on whether a fault was present at the beginning of the repair. If it is, reinstall the body control module (BCM) power fuse(s).
paras.zh: SRS 如何重新供电取决于维修开始时是否存在故障。如果是，请重新安装车身控制模块 (BCM) 电源保险丝。

paras.en: To determine whether a fault is present, verify that all airbags are installed and connected and the ignition is off. Then, wait 10 seconds and start the car. The airbag warning indicator should continuously illuminate for 6 seconds, then turn off. It’ll take about another 3o seconds from that point for the restraints control module (RCM) to complete SRS testing.
paras.zh: 要确定是否存在故障，请验证所有安全气囊是否已安装和连接以及点火开关是否已关闭。然后，等待 10 秒钟并启动汽车。安全气囊警告指示灯应持续亮起 6 秒，然后熄灭。从那时起，约束控制模块 (RCM) 还需要大约 3 秒才能完成 SRS 测试。

paras.en: After 30 seconds, if the indicator fails to light, remains lit continuously, or flashes, an SRS fault exists.
paras.zh: 30秒后，如果指示灯不亮、长亮或闪烁，则表示SRS故障。

paras.en: More detail on both scenarios is available in Volume 3. Ford said additional SRS diagrams and repair details will be provided in future
paras.zh: 有关这两种情况的更多详细信息，请参见第 3 卷。福特表示，未来将提供更多 SRS 图和维修详细信息

paras.en: volumes of On Target, focusing on pyrotechnic device disposal and more.
paras.zh: 大量的《目标》，重点关注烟火装置处置等。

paras.en: Previous installments on this repair are found in On Target’s 2025 volumes 3 and 4 and 2026 volume 1.
paras.zh: 有关此修复的前几期内容可在 On Target 的 2025 年第 3 卷和第 4 卷以及 2026 年第 1 卷中找到。

paras.en: For more in-depth repair information on this and other Ford and Lincoln vehicles, refer to the WSM at FordServiceInfo.com, and check back often as repair procedures can be updated without notice.
paras.zh: 有关此车以及其他福特和林肯车辆的更深入的维修信息，请参阅 FordServiceInfo.com 上的 WSM，并经常回来查看，因为维修程序可能会更新，恕不另行通知。

paras.en: Volume 3 also wraps up a series on rear-rail sectioning and includes the second article of a new “focus series” on seatbelt system inspections.
paras.zh: 第 3 卷还总结了有关后轨剖切的系列文章，并包括有关安全带系统检查的新“焦点系列”的第二篇文章。

paras.en: Specific steps are provided for Ford Explorer rear-rail sectioning as demonstrated in the I-CAR Repairers Realm video series. Previous installments are available in On Target 2025, Volume 4, and 2026 Volumes 1 and 2.
paras.zh: I-CAR Repairers Realm 视频系列中演示了福特探险者后轨分段的具体步骤。前几期可在《On Target 2025》第 4 卷以及《2026》第 1 卷和第 2 卷中找到。

paras.en: For the seatbelt series, On Target states that each article includes overviews of numerous WSM subsections on the topic, using the 2026 Expedition as an example vehicle. Volume 3 covers additional system operation and component descriptions from Section 501-20A.
paras.zh: 对于安全带系列，On Target 指出每篇文章都包含有关该主题的众多 WSM 小节的概述，并以 2026 Expedition 作为示例车辆。第 3 卷涵盖了第 501-20A 节中的附加系统操作和组件描述。

paras.en: Featured image: 2026 Ford Bronco (Provided by Ford)
paras.zh: 特色图片：2026 福特 Bronco（由福特提供）

articles.title: Jane Kim declares victory in California Insurance Commissioner race
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Jane Kim has declared victory in the California Insurance Commissioner race after a tight race delayed final results.
paras.zh: 在紧张的比赛推迟了最终结果后，简·金宣布在加州保险专员竞选中获胜。

paras.en: As of Sunday, Kim had 53.1% of the votes. Her opponent, Ben Allen, had 46.9%, with some precincts still reporting.
paras.zh: 截至周日，金正恩拥有 53.1% 的选票。她的对手本·艾伦 (Ben Allen) 得票率为 46.9%，部分选区仍在报告中。

paras.en: “California, thank you,” Kim said on an Instagram post Friday. “ I am so honored to be your next Insurance Commissioner. We ran against millions of dollars, the entire political establishment, and the odds. And we won. For working families, and to make insurance affordable, available, and fair. I can’t wait to get started.”
paras.zh: “加州，谢谢你，”金周五在 Instagram 上发帖说。 “我很荣幸成为你们的下一任保险专员。我们与数百万美元、整个政治机构和可能性进行了竞争。我们赢了。为了工薪家庭，并让保险负担得起、可用且公平。我迫不及待地想开始。”

paras.en: “Jane ran a strong race and it appears that she has run,” Allen says. “I desperately want her to succeed, because if she succeeds, the state succeeds.
paras.zh: “简跑了一场强劲的比赛，看来她已经跑了，”艾伦说。 “我迫切希望她成功，因为如果她成功，国家就会成功。

paras.en: Political Action Committees (PACs) have contributed a record $6 million in campaign donations to the California Insurance Commission race, according to a CalMatters report.
paras.zh: 根据 CalMatters 的一份报告，政治行动委员会 (PAC) 为加州保险委员会竞选提供了创纪录的 600 万美元竞选捐款。

paras.en: The article says this includes $3.2 million to support Allen and $1.5 million to oppose Kim.
paras.zh: 文章称，这其中包括支持艾伦的 320 万美元和反对金正恩的 150 万美元。

paras.en: Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
paras.zh: 据她的竞选网站称，金此前曾在旧金山监事会任职，担任伯尼·桑德斯的加州政治主任，以及工作家庭党的加州主任。

paras.en: Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
paras.zh: 该网站称，她的首要任务是“为所有人提供负担得起的、可用的保险”。她提议为州居民提供单一付款人灾难保险政策。

paras.en: The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.
paras.zh: 该网站还表示，她将确保保费覆盖索赔，或降低保费。

paras.en: “Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
paras.zh: 该网站指出：“保险公司应该将保费用于其预期目的：保护保单持有人。” “如果公司收取的金额超出了他们支付索赔和合理利润所需的金额，那么这笔钱应该返还给保单持有人或投资于全州的恢复力，而不是由我们承担巨额支出——就像去年向一位保险公司首席执行官支付的 2700 万美元的薪水一样。”

paras.en: Georgia, Oklahoma and Kansas also elected new insurance commissioners during the mid-term election.
paras.zh: 佐治亚州、俄克拉荷马州和堪萨斯州也在中期选举中选出了新的保险专员。

articles.title: Federal Reserve senior policy advisor: Collision shops at front lines of auto industry changes
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: As the U.S. auto industry faces multiple disruptions, collision repairers are on the front lines of observing how consumers respond to changes in a sector critical to the nation’s gross domestic product (GDP), Kristen Dziczek, senior policy advisor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, said during The Industry Exchange at the Collision Industry Conference in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 芝加哥联邦储备银行高级政策顾问 Kristen Dziczek 在拉斯维加斯碰撞行业会议的行业交流会上表示，由于美国汽车行业面临多重干扰，碰撞修复商处于第一线，观察消费者如何应对这个对美国国内生产总值 (GDP) 至关重要的行业的变化。

paras.en: “I think your shop is really where this broad economy meets people’s pocketbooks,” Dziczek said. “You’re seeing that decision made right on the front lines.”
paras.zh: “我认为你们的商店确实是这个广泛的经济与人们的钱包相遇的地方，”季切克说。 “你会看到这个决定是在前线做出的。”

paras.en: Dziczek says those collision shop experiences will tell a story about the economy before data shows it.
paras.zh: 齐切克表示，这些碰撞车间的经历将在数据显示之前讲述一个关于经济的故事。

paras.en: “You’re seeing how trade increases the price of the part shipping,” Dziczek said. “You’re seeing how technology changes the things you have to do for calibration and the arguments you have to have about paying for those sorts of things. You’re seeing how finances change to higher deductibles; how the loss per mile is lower, but the loss per collision is higher.”
paras.zh: “你会看到贸易如何提高零件运输的价格，”季切克说。 “你会看到技术如何改变你必须做的校准工作，以及你必须为此类事情付费的争论。你会看到财务如何改变为更高的免赔额；每英里的损失如何降低，但每次碰撞的损失却更高。”

paras.en: Part of Dziczek’s job is to have conversations with those throughout the auto industry, including collision repair businesses, about what they are seeing in the economy, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，季切克的部分工作是与整个汽车行业的人士（包括碰撞修复企业）进行对话，了解他们对经济的看法。

paras.en: “There’s a bunch of really smart people who are doing very complicated mathematical models of the economy, and we listen to all of that, and then they say, ‘And now, what’s really going on in the economy?’” she said.
paras.zh: “有一群非常聪明的人正在研究非常复杂的经济数学模型，我们倾听所有这些，然后他们说，‘现在，经济到底发生了什么？’”她说。

paras.en: Dziczek has been working at the Federal Reserve for about five years. Previously, she worked at General Motors, the UAW, in various auto industry roles for Congress, and at a nonprofit auto industry think tank.
paras.zh: 季切克已经在美联储工作了大约五年。此前，她曾在通用汽车公司、美国汽车工人联合会、国会的各种汽车行业职位以及一家非营利性汽车行业智囊团工作过。

paras.en: “I think I have the coolest job in the auto industry,” she added.
paras.zh: “我认为我拥有汽车行业中最酷的工作，”她补充道。

paras.en: Auto makes up about 5% of the U.S. GDP and employs more than 1 million people, Dziczek explained. She added that the industry touches all the “big moving parts,” like steel, aluminum, copper, microchips, oil, critical minerals, and magnets.
paras.zh: Dziczek 解释说，汽车业约占美国 GDP 的 5%，雇用了超过 100 万人。她补充说，该行业涉及所有“大型移动部件”，如钢、铝、铜、微芯片、石油、关键矿物和磁铁。

paras.en: “We’ve got lenders, we’ve got insurers, we’ve got repair, we’ve got customers,” Dziczek said. “We’re [Federal Reserve] looking at consumer behavior, we’re looking at banking behavior, we’re looking at all sorts of things through the lens of the auto industry. It’s super duper important, and there are very few other segments of the economy that are 5% of the GDP.”
paras.zh: “我们有贷款人，我们有保险公司，我们有维修，我们有客户，”季切克说。 “我们（美联储）正在研究消费者行为，我们正在研究银行行为，我们正在通过汽车行业的视角来研究各种各样的事情。这是非常重要的，而且很少有其他经济领域占 GDP 的 5%。”

paras.en: During the Industry Exchange, Aaron Schulenburg, executive director of the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS), asked Dziczek about the current and possible future pressures on the auto industry.
paras.zh: 在行业交流会上，碰撞修复专家协会（SCRS）执行董事Aaron Schulenburg向Dziczek询问了汽车行业当前和未来可能面临的压力。

paras.en: In 2026, gas prices, vehicle sales, tariffs, EVs, and technologies were some of the developments that the Federal Reserve paid attention to, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，2026 年，汽油价格、汽车销售、关税、电动汽车和技术是美联储关注的一些发展。

paras.en: “I’ll say this isn’t the highest gas prices have ever been, but it is the highest they’ve ever been this time of year,” Dziczek said as she ran through the list. “Sales have been remarkably resilient, coming in around $16 million this year. Consumers keep buying, so there’s been not really any kind of pullback with that. We’ve seen a few little blips from supply chain disruptions here and there, and then of course tariffs and how tariffs have played out.”
paras.zh: “我想说，这不是有史以来最高的汽油价格，但它是每年这个时候的最高价格，”季切克在浏览清单时说道。 “销售额一直非常有弹性，今年的销售额约为 1600 万美元。消费者继续购买，因此实际上并没有出现任何形式的回落。我们已经看到了供应链中断带来的一些小波动，当然还有关税以及关税的影响。”

paras.en: When discussing consumer spending, she said buyers seem to “be fine.” However, she added that new car buyers tend to make six-figure incomes. She added that there are some troubling signs with auto delinquencies, adding that they are at the highest level since 2010.
paras.zh: 在讨论消费者支出时，她表示买家似乎“没问题”。不过，她补充说，新车购买者往往能获得六位数的收入。她补充说，汽车拖欠贷款出现了一些令人不安的迹象，并补充说，这些迹象已达到 2010 年以来的最高水平。

paras.en: Dziczek said the EV reset has shifted focus to hybrids. Currently, about 16.7% of the vehicle market is hybrid, and some vehicles only have a hybrid configuration.
paras.zh: Dziczek 表示，电动汽车的重置已将重点转向混合动力汽车。目前，大约16.7%的汽车市场是混合动力，并且一些车辆只有混合动力配置。

paras.en: Electrified vehicles overall are about 24% of the market.
paras.zh: 电动汽车总体市场份额约为 24%。

paras.en: “That EV reset, however, burned about $100 billion in capital for the automakers,” Dziczek said. “A huge, huge turnaround, while the rest of the world continues on in electrification.”
paras.zh: “然而，电动汽车的重置为汽车制造商烧掉了约 1000 亿美元的资本，”季切克说。 “这是一个巨大的转变，而世界其他地区仍在继续电气化。”

paras.en: Schulenburg asked if there are other vehicle technologies that the Federal Reserve is watching.
paras.zh: 舒伦伯格询问美联储是否正在关注其他汽车技术。

paras.en: In response, Dziczek said two technologies that are most important to the collision repair industry: manufacturing changes to fewer parts and ADAS/automation.
paras.zh: 对此，Dziczek 表示，对于碰撞修复行业来说最重要的两项技术是：减少零件的制造变革以及 ADAS/自动化。

paras.en: Automakers are following Tesla’s lead on gigacasting to make vehicles less expensive, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，汽车制造商正在效仿特斯拉在千兆广播方面的领先地位，以降低车辆的成本。

paras.en: This year, Ford has been at the forefront of the conversation about gigacasting (or megacasting as Ford refers to it).
paras.zh: 今年，福特一直处于有关千兆广播（或福特所说的巨型广播）讨论的最前沿。

paras.en: The automaker announced it would invest $5 billion to change how it makes electric vehicles to lower its EV prices. The target starting price for a mid-sized EV truck is $30,000 compared to the average EV cost of $56,000, according to CBS News.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商宣布将投资 50 亿美元改变电动汽车的制造方式，以降低电动汽车的价格。据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，中型电动卡车的目标起始价格为 30,000 美元，而电动汽车的平均成本为 56,000 美元。

paras.en: The shift includes changing how the assembly line operates and a reduction in the total number of parts used in the vehicle. For example, a Ford press release says the wiring harness will be 4,000 feet shorter.
paras.zh: 这种转变包括改变装配线的运行方式和减少车辆中使用的零件总数。例如，福特新闻稿称线束将缩短4,000英尺。

paras.en: Dziczek said replacing many parts with fewer parts does make vehicles easier to manufacture but “maybe not easier to repair.”
paras.zh: 齐切克表示，用更少的零件替换许多零件确实使车辆更容易制造，但“可能并不容易维修”。

paras.en: It also could have implications for the companies that make the parts being reduced by the automakers.
paras.zh: 这也可能对汽车制造商减少生产零部件的公司产生影响。

paras.en: ADAS and automation are changing the industry in other ways, she said. This includes federal regulatory actions and conversation.
paras.zh: 她说，ADAS 和自动化正在以其他方式改变这个行业。这包括联邦监管行动和对话。

paras.en: In September, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) announced an agreement with SAE to expedite the development of data-driven AV performance standards.
paras.zh: 9 月，美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 宣布与 SAE 达成协议，加快制定数据驱动的自动驾驶性能标准。

paras.en: In March, NHTSA also announced plans to research ways to update its autonomous driving regulations.
paras.zh: 三月份，NHTSA 还宣布计划研究更新其自动驾驶法规的方法。

paras.en: The agency also mandated automatic emergency brakes as standard in vehicles by 2029.
paras.zh: 该机构还强制要求到 2029 年将自动紧急制动装置作为车辆的标准配置。

paras.en: ADAS features do come with a cost, Dziczek said.
paras.zh: Dziczek 表示，ADAS 功能确实需要付出代价。

paras.en: “Sure, my car can’t crash, but when the car that can crash runs into it, that bumper is very expensive,” she said.
paras.zh: “当然，我的车不会撞车，但当能撞车的车撞上它时，那个保险杠就非常贵了，”她说。

paras.en: For collision repairers, this means calibrations, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，对于碰撞修复人员来说，这意味着校准。

paras.en: Dziczek also said technology is changing how vehicles are manufactured.
paras.zh: 齐切克还表示，技术正在改变汽车的制造方式。

paras.en: Automakers are using AI from beginning to end, she said. This includes product design, supply chains, engineering, manufacturing quality, safety, and in the product itself, she added.
paras.zh: 她说，汽车制造商从始至终都在使用人工智能。她补充说，这包括产品设计、供应链、工程、制造质量、安全以及产品本身。

paras.en: She shared an example of an automaker building a check engine light that tells consumers the vehicle is trending out of spec. It then sets up an appointment and can order parts with a push of the button on the dashboard.
paras.zh: 她分享了一个汽车制造商制造检查发动机灯的例子，该灯告诉消费者车辆正在超出规格。然后它会设置一个约会，并可以通过按下仪表板上的按钮来订购零件。

paras.en: There are parts of the manufacturing process that are already lights out, Dziczek said.
paras.zh: Dziczek 说，制造过程的某些部分已经停止。

paras.en: A recent federal study found that manufacturing is slightly lower in AI use than other business sectors but that it is rapidly increasing its use, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，最近的一项联邦研究发现，制造业对人工智能的使用略低于其他商业部门，但其使用正在迅速增加。

paras.en: “The rate of change is about double that of the overall economy,” Dziczek adds.
paras.zh: “变化率大约是整体经济变化率的两倍，”季切克补充道。

paras.en: Schulenburg asked whether technology could change productivity and cost of producing vehicles.
paras.zh: 舒伦堡询问技术是否可以改变车辆生产的生产率和成本。

paras.en: “I think some of that’s up to consumers,” She replied. “If you get greater productivity, which technology should bring you, you have scale, which means you’re not just making a few cars that way. You are changing really quickly and can lower costs, but savings come about through market forces, policy, and consumer decisions.”
paras.zh: “我认为其中一些取决于消费者，”她回答道。 “如果你获得了更高的生产力（这项技术应该给你带来），你就拥有了规模，这意味着你不仅仅是以这种方式制造几辆车。你的变化非常快，可以降低成本，但节省是通过市场力量、政策和消费者决策来实现的。”

paras.en: Consumers are choosing vehicles with more features.
paras.zh: 消费者正在选择具有更多功能的车辆。

paras.en: “You’re still spending more dollars because you’re loading it up with features,” she added.
paras.zh: “你仍然要花更多的钱，因为你要为其添加更多功能，”她补充道。

paras.en: Other costs can also show up after purchasing a vehicle, including insurance, maintenance, and repair.
paras.zh: 购买车辆后还会出现其他费用，包括保险、维护和修理。

paras.en: Labor costs and labor availability are part of driving repair costs, she added. The rates can change for different brands, repair types, and the cost of the parts.
paras.zh: 她补充说，劳动力成本和劳动力可用性是推动维修成本的一部分。费率可能会因品牌、维修类型和零件成本的不同而变化。

paras.en: Insurance is also a complicated set of constructs, she said. Consumers sometimes don’t realize the consequences of lowering their insurance costs.
paras.zh: 她说，保险也是一套复杂的结构。消费者有时没有意识到降低保险费用的后果。

paras.en: Schulenburg asked how the Federal Reserve distinguishes an underlying product that becomes more complex and expensive from the broader inflationary pressure.
paras.zh: 舒伦伯格询问美联储如何区分变得更加复杂和昂贵的基础产品与更广泛的通胀压力。

paras.en: Dziczek replied that the Federal Reserve looks at things that are inflationary or products that are risking costs over time. One-time shocks, such as increased prices post-COVID, are seen as transitory, she added.
paras.zh: 齐切克回答说，美联储会关注通货膨胀的事物或随着时间的推移而带来成本风险的产品。她补充说，一次性冲击，例如新冠疫情后价格上涨，被认为是暂时的。

paras.en: “We’re looking at things that build a sustained growth,” Dziczek said.
paras.zh: “我们正在寻找能够实现持续增长的事情，”齐切克说。

paras.en: Fuel costs aren’t necessarily inflationary right now, but that could change because of all the places it comes through the economy, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，目前燃料成本不一定会引发通货膨胀，但这种情况可能会发生变化，因为它贯穿于经济的各个方面。

paras.en: The closing of the Strait of Hormuz is an event that could cause a one-time shock or create an inflationary event that ripples through multiple industries, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，霍尔木兹海峡的关闭是一件可能引起一次性冲击或引发波及多个行业的通胀事件的事件。

paras.en: Aluminum, which currently has a 50% tariff, passes through the strait, she said. She added that helium also comes from the region, which is used to make microchips.
paras.zh: 她说，铝目前经过该海峡，关税为 50%。她补充说，氦气也来自该地区，用于制造微芯片。

paras.en: “We take fuel, obviously, which goes into our gas tanks, but also goes into the plastics that we use in the vehicle, and then it goes into the diesel trucks that bring the parts to the factory and the ships and runs factories in other countries that don’t have big energy emergency supplies,” Dziczek said. “Taiwan, for example, there’s only limited supply or places to store energy on the island of Taiwan. So if you get an energy shock to Taiwan and you can’t make chips, big problem.”
paras.zh: “显然，我们使用的燃料会进入我们的油箱，但也会进入我们在车辆中使用的塑料，然后进入柴油卡车，将零件运送到工厂和船舶，并在没有大量能源应急供应的其他国家运营工厂，”季切克说。 “以台湾为例，台湾岛上的能源供应或储存空间有限。因此，如果台湾受到能源冲击而无法制造芯片，那就是大问题了。”

paras.en: However, right now, auto price increases have remained modest, up 1.5% last month. This is down from overall inflation at about 3.7%, she said.
paras.zh: 然而，目前汽车价格涨幅仍然不大，上个月上涨了 1.5%。她说，这低于约 3.7% 的总体通胀率。

paras.en: Tariffs so far have only created a one-time shock rather than an inflationary event, Dziczek said.
paras.zh: 季切克表示，到目前为止，关税只造成了一次性冲击，而不是通胀事件。

paras.en: “The tariffs didn’t keep going up month after month,” she said. “They went up once, and actually they kind of got negotiated down over time, or there were exceptions to the rules that came into place, so there was a spike, and then it came back down.”
paras.zh: “关税并没有逐月持续上涨，”她说。 “它们曾上涨过一次，实际上，随着时间的推移，它们被谈判下调了，或者规则出现了例外，所以出现了一个峰值，然后又回落了。”

paras.en: There is a threat that tariffs will be increased to 50% on autos and parts from Canada Jan. 1, she added. That also wouldn’t be inflationary unless it became 75% the next month and 100% the following month.
paras.zh: 她补充说，1 月 1 日起，来自加拿大的汽车和零部件的关税可能会提高到 50%。除非下个月达到 75%，下个月达到 100%，否则也不会造成通货膨胀。

paras.en: Election results were not in while Dziczek spoke on Tuesday; however, she said any changes from the election could affect tariffs and regulations. The changes could also affect budgetary policies, she added.
paras.zh: 季切克周二发表讲话时，选举结果尚未公布。不过，她表示，选举产生的任何变化都可能影响关税和监管。她补充说，这些变化也可能影响预算政策。

paras.en: Schulenburg asked if the competitive position of the automotive industry in the U.S. changed as other countries have expanded their capabilities.
paras.zh: 舒伦伯格询问美国汽车行业的竞争地位是否会随着其他国家扩大产能而发生变化。

paras.en: “China is the number one exporter of vehicles, 7.1 million vehicles last year,” Dziczek said. “But the U.S. is effectively walled off from China and Chinese brands.”
paras.zh: “中国是第一大汽车出口国，去年出口了 710 万辆汽车，”季切克说。 “但美国实际上与中国和中国品牌隔离开来。”

paras.en: Global automakers are competing abroad, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，全球汽车制造商正在海外竞争。

paras.en: For example, Chinese-built vehicles were about 4% of the Mexican market, she added. She explained that not all are Chinese brands. Some Western brands that lost share in China have been exported to other markets.
paras.zh: 她补充道，例如，中国制造的汽车约占墨西哥市场的 4%。她解释说，并非所有品牌都是中国品牌。一些在中国失去份额的西方品牌已出口到其他市场。

paras.en: “They’ve really become a big force in global vehicle production, and even without that direct competition in the U.S. market,” Dziczek said.
paras.zh: “他们确实已经成为全球汽车生产的一支重要力量，即使在美国市场没有直接竞争，”季切克说。

paras.en: She noted that intense competition in China has caused manufacturers to develop vehicles really fast. It’s often believed that the vehicles are lower cost because of subsidies and governments behind them. Yet, she added that a recent study found that when BYD was compared to Tesla, there was only a 5% cost differential from subsidies.
paras.zh: 她指出，中国激烈的竞争导致制造商开发汽车的速度非常快。人们通常认为，由于补贴和政府的支持，这些车辆的成本较低。然而，她补充说，最近的一项研究发现，当比亚迪与特斯拉进行比较时，补贴成本差异仅为 5%。

paras.en: The rest of the cost savings comes from controlling the supply chain from batteries to minerals to cells, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，其余的成本节省来自于控制从电池到矿物再到电池的供应链。

paras.en: “They have immense scale and dominance in batteries,” Dziczek said. “They don’t just make EVs, though; I’ll point out they also have immense vertical integration.”
paras.zh: “他们在电池领域拥有巨大的规模和主导地位，”季切克说。 “不过，他们不仅仅生产电动汽车；我要指出的是，他们还拥有巨大的垂直整合能力。”

paras.en: She added that China also has density in its supply chain. A lot of what is needed to build a vehicle is in China.
paras.zh: 她补充说，中国的供应链也很密集。制造汽车所需的很多东西都在中国。

paras.en: Because of the high competition, Chinese manufacturers are also developing vehicles faster than in the U.S.
paras.zh: 由于竞争激烈，中国制造商开发车辆的速度也比美国更快。

paras.en: “Their development from paper to vehicle on the road is less than two to three years,” she said.
paras.zh: “它们从纸张到道路上的车辆的发展只用了不到两到三年的时间，”她说。

paras.en: It can take five to seven years in the U.S., she said.
paras.zh: 她说，在美国可能需要五到七年的时间。

paras.en: “One thing that’s interesting about two to three years is that your policy environment is probably more stable over the next two to three years,” she added. “Like we know who the president is for the next two years.”
paras.zh: “两到三年内有趣的一件事是，未来两到三年内政策环境可能会更加稳定，”她补充道。 “就像我们知道未来两年的总统是谁一样。”

paras.en: The U.S. automakers can’t make a vehicle 100% in the U.S., she said. For example, Nvidia chips can’t be made in the country.
paras.zh: 她说，美国汽车制造商不可能100%在美国生产汽车。例如，英伟达的芯片无法在国内生产。

paras.en: The country is seeing some shifts in assembly, she said. Multiple automakers, including GM, Stellantis, and Audi, have announced production investments in the U.S.
paras.zh: 她说，该国的集会情况正在发生一些变化。通用汽车、Stellantis 和奥迪等多家汽车制造商已宣布在美国进行生产投资。

paras.en: “Since the tariffs went into effect, we’ve seen an uptick of about 6,500 manufacturing jobs in the motor vehicle assembly sector,” Dziczek said. “The parts sector has lost jobs for 32 straight months, down about 10,400.”
paras.zh: “自关税生效以来，我们看到机动车辆装配行业的制造业就业岗位增加了约 6,500 个，”Dziczek 说。 “零部件行业已连续 32 个月失业，减少约 10,400 人。”

paras.en: As parts companies come back, they are turning to automation and AI, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，随着零部件公司的回归，他们正在转向自动化和人工智能。

paras.en: Schulenburg asked which economic indicators Dziczek will be watching in 2027.
paras.zh: 舒伦堡询问季切克 2027 年将关注哪些经济指标。

paras.en: “The renegotiation of USMCA and whether we’d get to some kind of a trade truce with Canada and Mexico that settles things down and gives some more stability to the investment environment,” Dziczek answered.
paras.zh: “美墨加协定的重新谈判，以及我们是否会与加拿大和墨西哥达成某种贸易休战，以解决问题并为投资环境带来更多稳定性，”季切克回答道。

paras.en: The pace of sales, transaction prices, and employment is always at the top of the list, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，销售速度、交易价格和就业始终位居榜首。

paras.en: Dziczek said another thing to watch is auto credit delinquencies, lending standards, and what is happening to rates.
paras.zh: 季切克表示，另一件值得关注的事情是汽车信贷拖欠、贷款标准以及利率变化。

paras.en: Repair costs versus insurance gaps is also on the list, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，维修成本与保险缺口也在清单上。

paras.en: “Income growth has dropped below the inflation rate, so when wages are growing faster than inflation, that’s good,” Dziczek said. “When wages are growing more slowly than inflation, that might cause people to become more conservative.”
paras.zh: “收入增长已低于通胀率，因此当工资增长快于通胀时，这是件好事，”季切克说。 “当工资增长慢于通胀时，可能会导致人们变得更加保守。”

paras.en: If people stop making big purchases, auto plant workers wouldn’t make cars, she explained.
paras.zh: 她解释说，如果人们停止大宗采购，汽车厂的工人就不会生产汽车。

paras.en: “It starts this spiral downward,” she said.
paras.zh: “它开始螺旋式下降，”她说。

paras.en: The collision repair industry should be looking at its labor pipeline, Dziczek said.
paras.zh: 齐切克说，碰撞修复行业应该关注其劳动力储备。

paras.en: “How you’re going to get people to do this work because this is not offshore work,” she said. “This is work that technology can change, but it’s not going offshore.”
paras.zh: “你将如何让人们去做这项工作，因为这不是离岸工作，”她说。 “这是技术可以改变的工作，但它不会转移到海外。”

paras.en: Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director and Kristen Dziczek, senior policy advisor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, discuss the automotive industry during CIC in Las Vegas Nov. 3, 2026.
paras.zh: SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 和芝加哥联邦储备银行高级政策顾问 Kristen Dziczek 于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在拉斯维加斯举行的 CIC 期间讨论汽车行业。

articles.title: Why 4/32 Could Change Tire Safety Forever
articles.author: David Sickels

paras.en: Some revolutions don’t start with a plan. Sometimes, they begin with a loss that changes everything.
paras.zh: 有些革命并不是从计划开始的。有时，他们从改变一切的损失开始。

paras.en: For Alex Bebiak, Safe Tread Alliance and the Road Ready Foundation began after his 19-year-old son Jackson died. Jackson died in a 2023 crash after his car lost control in the rain. When Alex later saw the vehicle, he noticed nearly worn-out tires. They had worn almost to the legal limit. That moment sent him into a world he never expected to enter: tire safety, tread depth education and the push to rethink the old 2/32-inch standard.
paras.zh: 对于 Alex Bebiak 来说，安全行走联盟和道路就绪基金会是在他 19 岁的儿子杰克逊去世后成立的。杰克逊在 2023 年的一场车祸中丧生，原因是他的汽车在雨中失控。当亚历克斯后来看到这辆车时，他注意到轮胎几乎磨损了。它们几乎已经磨损到了法定限度。那一刻让他进入了一个他从未想过的世界：轮胎安全、胎面深度教育以及重新思考旧的 2/32 英寸标准的推动力。

paras.en: Before this, Alex spent 32 years in the restaurant business. Today, he’s working with safety groups, police departments, driver’s ed programs and tire industry leaders to make tire tread part of a much bigger conversation.
paras.zh: 在此之前，Alex 在餐饮业工作了 32 年。如今，他正在与安全组织、警察部门、驾驶员教育项目和轮胎行业领导者合作，使轮胎胎面成为更大对话的一部分。

paras.en: In this episode of Johnny g & Friends, Alex shares Jackson’s story, explains why 4/32s is so important, and makes the case that tire safety education can save lives.
paras.zh: 在 Johnny g & Friends 的这一集中，Alex 分享了 Jackson 的故事，解释了为什么 4/32 如此重要，并论证了轮胎安全教育可以拯救生命。

articles.title: Northwood University Celebrates 2026 Education Award Honorees
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Northwood University is celebrating four distinguished automotive aftermarket professionals whose leadership, industry achievements and commitment to education are helping shape the next generation of business leaders.
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德大学正在庆祝四位杰出的汽车售后市场专业人士，他们的领导能力、行业成就和对教育的承诺正在帮助塑造下一代商业领袖。

paras.en: The recipients of the 2026 Automotive Aftermarket Management Education Awards were honored Tuesday, Nov. 3, during an awards luncheon at the Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX) in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日星期二，在拉斯维加斯汽车售后市场产品博览会 (AAPEX) 举行的颁奖午宴上，授予了 2026 年汽车售后市场管理教育奖的获奖者。

paras.en: - Robert Roos, president and CEO of The Pronto Network
paras.zh: - Robert Roos，Pronto Network 总裁兼首席执行官

paras.en: - Shawn Senior, chief executive officer of Eastern Warehouse Distributors
paras.zh: - Shawn Senior，Eastern Warehouse Distributors 首席执行官

paras.en: - Jessica Toliuszis, vice president of national accounts at Highline Warren
paras.zh: - Jessica Toliuszis，Highline Warren 国民账户副总裁

paras.en: - Keith Zar, managing partner of Schwartz Advisors and principal of KAZ Enterprises
paras.zh: - Keith Zar，Schwartz Advisors 管理合伙人兼 KAZ Enterprises 负责人

paras.en: Since 1975, Northwood has recognized automotive aftermarket professionals for their significant contributions to education, professional development and industry advancement. This year’s recipients represent decades of leadership across distribution, corporate strategy, sales, operations and business development, with a shared commitment to preparing future generations for success.
paras.zh: 自 1975 年以来，Northwood 一直认可汽车售后市场专业人士对教育、专业发展和行业进步的重大贡献。今年的获奖者代表了数十年来在分销、企业战略、销售、运营和业务发展方面的领导地位，并共同致力于为子孙后代的成功做好准备。

paras.en: “These honorees exemplify the leadership, innovation and entrepreneurial spirit that have long defined the automotive aftermarket,” said Dr. Dave Oventhal, director of the Center for Automotive & Mobility Studies (CAMS) and Subaru of New England Professor of Automotive Strategy at Northwood University. “Their success is impressive, but equally important is their willingness to share their knowledge, mentor emerging professionals and invest in the people who will lead this industry into the future. We are grateful for their contributions and pleased to recognize their achievements.”
paras.zh: “这些获奖者体现了长期以来定义汽车售后市场的领导力、创新和创业精神，”诺斯伍德大学汽车与移动研究中心 (CAMS) 主任、新英格兰斯巴鲁汽车战略教授戴夫·奥文塔尔 (Dave Oventhal) 博士说。 “他们的成功令人印象深刻，但同样重要的是他们愿意分享知识、指导新兴专业人士并投资于将引领这个行业走向未来的人们。我们感谢他们的贡献，并很高兴认可他们的成就。”

articles.title: Celebrating the Women Who Move Our Industry Forward
articles.author: Brandi Gangel

paras.en: There are plenty of reasons to love AAPEX. The innovation, the energy, the business opportunities, and of course, the people. Wednesday morning’s breakfast, the kickoff to Wednesday, Women in Auto Care offered a particularly meaningful reminder of what makes the automotive aftermarket such a special industry to be part of.
paras.zh: 喜爱 AAPEX 的理由有很多。创新、能源、商机，当然还有人才。周三早上的早餐是周三的开始，“女性汽车护理”活动特别有意义地提醒人们，是什么让汽车售后市场成为一个如此特殊的行业。

paras.en: The Women in Auto Care Annual Networking Breakfast and Awards program brought together an incredible community of industry professionals to celebrate the women making a difference in our businesses, our industry, and in the lives of those around them.
paras.zh: 汽车护理行业女性年度网络早餐和颁奖计划汇聚了众多行业专业人士，共同庆祝为我们的企业、行业以及周围人的生活做出贡献的女性。

paras.en: Throughout the morning, as award recipients took the stage, a common theme emerged. Despite their different career paths, experiences, and accomplishments, nearly every woman spoke about the same thing: the people who helped them get where they are today.
paras.zh: 整个上午，当获奖者上台时，出现了一个共同的主题。尽管职业道路、经历和成就不同，但几乎每个女性都会谈论同一件事：帮助她们取得今天成就的人。

paras.en: The mentors who saw potential before they saw it in themselves. The colleagues who became lifelong friends. The families who supported big dreams, long hours, and bold decisions. And the women who opened doors, offered encouragement, and made room for others at the table. It was a powerful reminder that while individual accomplishments deserve to be celebrated, very few of us get where we are entirely on our own.
paras.zh: 这些导师在看到自己的潜力之前就看到了潜力。那些成为终生朋友的同事。这些家庭支持远大的梦想、长时间的工作和大胆的决定。那些打开门、提供鼓励并为餐桌上的其他人腾出空间的女性。这有力地提醒我们，虽然个人成就值得庆祝，但我们中很少有人完全依靠自己取得今天的成就。

paras.en: One particularly touching moment came from a young award recipient who spoke about her three-year-old daughter growing up surrounded by strong women in automotive. To her daughter, the industry isn’t male dominated, it’s simply a place where her mom, her grandmother, and countless other women belong, contribute, and succeed. What an incredible perspective. And what a wonderful reflection of the progress this organization continues to make.
paras.zh: 一个特别感人的时刻来自一位年轻的获奖者，她谈到了她三岁的女儿在汽车行业女强人的包围下长大的故事。对她的女儿来说，这个行业并不是男性主导的，它只是她的妈妈、祖母和无数其他女性归属、贡献和成功的地方。多么令人难以置信的观点。这是该组织不断取得进步的精彩体现。

paras.en: Another recipient shared the story of her grandmother, who helped operate a family service station decades ago but was overlooked when the business received industry recognition. Generations later, today, her granddaughter stood on stage accepting a Shop Owner of the Year Award, dedicating the honor to the woman who helped inspire her.
paras.zh: 另一位获奖者分享了她祖母的故事，她几十年前曾帮助经营一家家庭服务站，但当该业务获得行业认可时，她却被忽视了。几代人之后的今天，她的孙女站在台上接受年度店主奖，将这一荣誉献给那位激励她的女性。

paras.en: And in a memorable moment of audience participation, another honoree distributed tiny pink army women, encouraging attendees to keep one as a reminder of their own strength and give another to someone who could use a little encouragement. A simple gesture with a powerful message: We all have an army behind us, and we have an opportunity to be part of someone else’s.
paras.zh: 在观众参与的一个难忘时刻，另一位获奖者分发了粉红色的小女兵，鼓励与会者保留一个，以提醒自己的力量，并将另一个送给需要一点鼓励的人。一个简单的手势传达了一个强有力的信息：我们背后都有一支军队，我们有机会成为别人军队的一部分。

paras.en: These stories were different, but their message was remarkably consistent. Success isn’t only measured by titles, accomplishments, or recognition, it’s also measured by the opportunities we create, the relationships we build, and the people we help along the way. That’s what makes Women in Auto Care so special.
paras.zh: 这些故事各不相同，但它们传达的信息却非常一致。成功不仅以头衔、成就或认可来衡量，还以我们创造的机会、我们建立的关系以及我们一路帮助的人来衡量。这就是女性汽车护理行业如此特别的原因。

paras.en: It has built a community where women genuinely celebrate one another’s successes, encourage each other’s ambitions, and invest in the next generation of leaders. A big congratulations to all this year’s award winners and finalists. And to the Women in Auto Care organization, its leadership, volunteers, allies and supporters, thank you for creating opportunities to recognize women and champion their contributions to our industry.
paras.zh: 它建立了一个社区，让女性真诚地庆祝彼此的成功，鼓励彼此的抱负，并投资于下一代领导者。热烈祝贺今年所有获奖者和入围者。感谢女性汽车护理组织及其领导层、志愿者、盟友和支持者，感谢你们创造机会来认可女性并支持她们对我们行业的贡献。

articles.title: Momentum USA Launches 77 Brake Part Numbers
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Momentum USA announced that it has introduced 77 new part numbers in August. European, Asian and electric vehicles are among those covered by the new part numbers.
paras.zh: Momentum USA 宣布在 8 月份推出了 77 个新零件号。新零件编号涵盖欧洲、亚洲和电动汽车。

paras.en: - 36 new part numbers in the AmeriStar brake pad line, which cover 28.7 million vehicles in operation. Impact applications include high-volume Hyundai/Kia platforms.
paras.zh: - AmeriStar 刹车片系列新增 36 个零件号，覆盖 2870 万辆运营车辆。影响应用包括大批量现代/起亚平台。

paras.en: - 8 new part numbers covering 8.8 million VIO in the AmeriPlatinum Ceramic line. This line now provides late-model coverage for import cars like the Toyota Corolla/Prius, Hyundai Palisade and Kia Telluride.
paras.zh: - 8 个新零件号，涵盖 AmeriPlatinum Ceramic 系列中的 880 万个 VIO。该线路现在为丰田卡罗拉/普锐斯、现代 Palisade 和起亚 Telluride 等进口汽车提供最新型号的覆盖。

paras.en: - 14 new E-Marked R90 Euro Coated Rotor and fully coated rotor additions in the AmeriPro line. This release covers BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover, Volvo, Genesis and Mini models.
paras.zh: - AmeriPro 系列中增加了 14 个新的 E 标记 R90 Euro 涂层转子和全涂层转子。本次发布涵盖宝马、梅赛德斯-奔驰、路虎、沃尔沃、劳恩斯和Mini车型。

paras.en: - Seven new EPS Friction brake pad SKUs, extending high-performance stopping power to applications like Alfa Romeo, BMW 2/3/4 Series, Maserati, Porsche Cayenne and Jaguar F-Pace.
paras.zh: - 七个新的 EPS 摩擦刹车片 SKU，将高性能制动力扩展到阿尔法罗密欧、宝马 2/3/4 系列、玛莎拉蒂、保时捷卡宴和捷豹 F-Pace 等应用。

paras.en: - New numbers across AmeriPRO and VGX add coverage for electric and late-model crossover models like the Nissan Leaf.
paras.zh: - AmeriPRO 和 VGX 的新数据增加了电动汽车和日产 Leaf 等新型跨界车型的覆盖范围。

articles.title: Worldpac to Open Automated Distribution Center
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Worldpac announced plans to open its first automated distribution center, a new 413,000-square-foot facility in Forest Park, Georgia. Scheduled to begin operations in the first half of 2027, the facility will feature AutoStore robotic storage and retrieval technology.
paras.zh: Worldpac 宣布计划在佐治亚州森林公园开设其第一个自动化配送中心，占地 413,000 平方英尺。该设施计划于 2027 年上半年开始运营，将采用 AutoStore 机器人存储和检索技术。

paras.en: The facility will support Worldpac branches and customers across the Southeast and surrounding markets, while providing more than 250,000 additional square feet compared with the current Norcross distribution center, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，该设施将为 Worldpac 东南部及周边市场的分支机构和客户提供支持，同时与目前的诺克罗斯配送中心相比，额外提供超过 250,000 平方英尺的面积。

paras.en: AutoStore is an automated storage and retrieval system that uses robotics to store, retrieve, and process inventory within a highly efficient storage grid. Rather than team members traveling through warehouse aisles to locate parts, inventory is automatically delivered to workstations for picking, replenishment, and processing.
paras.zh: AutoStore 是一种自动化存储和检索系统，它使用机器人技术在高效存储网格内存储、检索和处理库存。团队成员无需在仓库过道中寻找零件，库存会自动运送到工作站进行拣选、补货和处理。

paras.en: The facility will be located at 2160 Anvil Block Road, Suite 200 Forest Park, GA 30297.
paras.zh: 该设施将位于 2160 Anvil Block Road, Suite 200 Forest Park, GA 30297。

paras.en: “We are excited to expand Worldpac’s distribution presence in the Atlanta metro market and strengthen our ability to serve customers throughout the Southeastern United States. The Forest Park facility represents a major step forward in our use of robotics and automation, helping us improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency,” said Rich Tannenbaum, chief operating officer of Worldpac.
paras.zh: Worldpac 首席运营官 Rich Tannenbaum 表示：“我们很高兴能够扩大 Worldpac 在亚特兰大地铁市场的分销业务，并增强我们为整个美国东南部客户提供服务的能力。森林公园设施代表着我们在使用机器人和自动化方面向前迈出了重要一步，帮助我们提高了速度、准确性和效率。”

articles.title: Advics Offers More Aftermarket Brake Pads, Rotors
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Advics announced the availability of 56 new brake pad kit SKUs and three new disc brake rotor SKUs.
paras.zh: Advics 宣布推出 56 款新刹车片套件 SKU 和 3 款新盘式制动器转子 SKU。

paras.en: The 56 new ultra-premium brake pad kit SKUs provide approximately 62.8 million vehicles in operation (VIO) axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada. The expansion covers Acura, Honda, Infiniti, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Chrysler, Dodge, Ford, GMC, Jeep, Lincoln, Ram, Genesis, Hyundai and Kia applications.
paras.zh: 这 56 个全新超高级刹车片套件 SKU 为美国和加拿大约 6280 万辆运营车辆 (VIO) 提供车轴覆盖。此次扩展涵盖讴歌、本田、英菲尼迪、马自达、三菱、日产、别克、凯迪拉克、雪佛兰、克莱斯勒、道奇、福特、GMC、吉普、林肯、Ram、创世纪、现代和起亚应用。

paras.en: Advics is also expanding its ultra-premium disc brake rotor line with three new SKUs for Toyota and Lexus applications, providing approximately 858,000 VIO axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada.
paras.zh: Advics 还通过适用于丰田和雷克萨斯应用的三个新 SKU 扩展其超优质盘式制动器转子产品线，在美国和加拿大提供约 858,000 个 VIO 车轴覆盖范围。

paras.en: All three rotor SKUs are manufactured in the U.S.
paras.zh: 所有三个转子 SKU 均在美国制造。

articles.title: Niterra President and CEO Mike Schwab on ‘Delivering Trusted Solutions’
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Mike Schwab, president and CEO of Niterra North America, Inc.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 Niterra North America, Inc. 的总裁兼首席执行官 Mike Schwab。

paras.en: Schwab said Niterra has evolved well beyond its roots as an ignition specialist while maintaining the quality and reliability associated with its NGK brand. Today, Niterra’s automotive portfolio extends beyond spark plugs to include ignition coils, wire sets, NTK oxygen and technical sensors and rotating electrical products such as starters and alternators.
paras.zh: Schwab 表示，Niterra 已经远远超越了其作为点火专家的根源，同时保持了 NGK 品牌相关的质量和可靠性。如今，Niterra 的汽车产品组合已不仅仅局限于火花塞，还包括点火线圈、电线组、NTK 氧气和技术传感器以及起动机和交流发电机等旋转电气产品。

paras.en: Schwab emphasized that quality, integrity, teamwork and consistent execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy, even as the industry evolves. These principles, he says, guide how the company serves customers, from delivering dependable products and maintaining transparency to strengthening partnerships and addressing customer challenges. Schwab emphasized that execution means consistently delivering on commitments involving product availability, customer service and new product introductions. While technology and product offerings will continue to change, he believes trust, reliability and strong customer relationships will remain essential to the company’s long-term success.
paras.zh: Schwab 强调，即使行业不断发展，质量、诚信、团队合作和一致执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础。他说，这些原则指导公司如何服务客户，从提供可靠的产品和保持透明度到加强合作伙伴关系和应对客户挑战。施瓦布强调，执行意味着始终如一地兑现涉及产品可用性、客户服务和新产品推出的承诺。尽管技术和产品供应将不断变化，但他相信信任、可靠性和强大的客户关系对于公司的长期成功仍然至关重要。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Schwab said the transition from NGK Spark Plug to Niterra represents a broader transformation rather than simply a name change. While continuing to strengthen its automotive business, the company is pursuing growth in new products, technologies and markets that build on its engineering capabilities. Opportunities in advanced mobility, electric vehicles and other emerging technologies are part of that strategy. Schwab said the Niterra name, derived from Latin words meaning “to shine” and “Earth,” reflects the company’s ambition to contribute to a more sustainable future.
paras.zh: 展望未来，Schwab 表示，从 NGK Spark Plug 到 Niterra 的转变代表着更广泛的转变，而不仅仅是更名。在继续加强汽车业务的同时，该公司正在以其工程能力为基础，寻求新产品、技术和市场的增长。先进移动、电动汽车和其他新兴技术的机会是该战略的一部分。施瓦布表示，Niterra 这个名字源自拉丁语，意思是“闪耀”和“地球”，反映了该公司为更加可持续的未来做出贡献的雄心。

paras.en: To hear more of Schwab’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解更多施瓦布的见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.en: - How Niterra is expanding beyond spark plugs with a broader portfolio of ignition, sensor and rotating electrical products. (4:49)
paras.zh: - Niterra 如何通过更广泛的点火、传感器和旋转电气产品组合扩展到火花塞之外。 （4:49）

paras.en: - Quality, integrity, teamwork and execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy and help strengthen customer relationships and deliver value. (6:17)
paras.zh: - 质量、诚信、团队合作和执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础，有助于加强客户关系并创造价值。 （6:17）

paras.en: - Niterra emphasizes a people-first approach to serving the industry and what that commitment looks like in practice for customers, employees and partners. (9:14)
paras.zh: - Niterra 强调以人为本的方法来服务行业，以及这种承诺在实践中对客户、员工和合作伙伴的影响。 （9:14）

paras.en: - How the Niterra name reflects the company’s evolution and future growth opportunities in advanced mobility and new technologies. (11:06)
paras.zh: - Niterra 名称如何反映公司在先进移动性和新技术方面的发展和未来增长机会。 (11:06)

paras.en: - The story behind Niterra’s name and the employee-driven process that helped create it. (13:23)
paras.zh: - Niterra 名称背后的故事以及帮助创建它的员工驱动流程。 (13:23)

paras.en: - Lightning Round: Schwab shares some personal insights. (14:59)
paras.zh: - 闪电轮：施瓦布分享了一些个人见解。 (14:59)

articles.title: LKQ Accelerates Leadership Transition
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: LKQ Corp. announced that Salvatore A. “Sal” Abbate assumes the roles of president and CEO on Nov. 9, 2026. Abbate also joins the company’s board of directors ahead of his previously announced Dec. 15 start date. Abbate’s arrival ends the interim Office of the CEO, which has overseen company operations since Oct. 23. Chairman John Mendel and Audit Committee Chair Sue Gove led the interim office.
paras.zh: LKQ Corp.宣布Salvatore A. “Sal” Abbate于2026年11月9日担任总裁兼首席执行官。Abbate还在此前宣布的12月15日开始日期之前加入公司董事会。Abbate的到来结束了自10月23日以来一直监督公司运营的临时首席执行官办公室。董事长John Mendel和审计委员会主席Sue Gove领导了临时办公室。

paras.en: “I’m excited to be joining LKQ earlier than planned,” said Abbate. “LKQ has the scale and reach to be the first call for its customers. My job is to make sure we execute at the level that scale should deliver, and I’m looking forward to working with our teams to get there.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴能够比原计划更早加入 LKQ，”Abbate 说道。 “LKQ 的规模和覆盖范围足以成为其客户的第一个电话。我的工作是确保我们按照规模所应达到的水平执行任务，我期待着与我们的团队合作以实现这一目标。”

paras.en: “Sal is a proven operator, and the Board has full confidence in him,” said John Mendel, chairman of the board. “Having him in place earlier gives him more time with our teams and customers heading into 2027. We look forward to supporting Sal as he leads LKQ.”
paras.zh: “Sal is a proven operator, and the Board has full confidence in him,” said John Mendel, chairman of the board. “让他提前就职可以让他在 2027 年有更多时间与我们的团队和客户相处。我们期待在 Sal 领导 LKQ 时为他提供支持。”

articles.title: Goodyear Names Roger Wood Interim CEO
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. announced Roger Wood, a current member of the company’s board of directors, has been appointed interim chief executive officer. Wood will lead the company while the board conducts a search for a permanent successor with a leading executive search firm. Mark Stewart will step down as chief executive officer and president and from the company’s board of directors, effective immediately.
paras.zh: 固特异轮胎橡胶公司宣布，公司现任董事会成员罗杰·伍德 (Roger Wood) 已被任命为临时首席执行官。伍德将领导公司，而董事会则与一家领先的猎头公司寻找永久继任者。马克·斯图尔特 (Mark Stewart) 将辞去首席执行官兼总裁以及公司董事会职务，立即生效。

paras.en: Board Advancing Strategic and Operational Review
paras.zh: 董事会推进战略和运营审查

paras.en: A special committee of the board, formed earlier this year, has been conducting a strategic review of the company’s businesses and operations to identify opportunities to strengthen performance and drive shareholder value. The board and the company are continuing that work by evaluating a broad range of strategic and operational initiatives, including further optimizing the company’s business mix and footprint, improving efficiency and investing in new products and capabilities that support long-term growth.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候成立的董事会特别委员会一直在对公司的业务和运营进行战略审查，以寻找加强业绩和提升股东价值的机会。董事会和公司正在通过评估广泛的战略和运营计划来继续这项工作，包括进一步优化公司的业务组合和足迹、提高效率以及投资于支持长期增长的新产品和能力。

paras.en: The company does not intend to provide further updates unless and until the board determines that additional disclosure is appropriate or required.
paras.zh: 除非董事会确定适当或需要额外披露，否则公司不打算提供进一步的更新。

paras.en: “Goodyear has made meaningful progress in becoming a more efficient and focused company, and the board believes this is the right moment to transition leadership to accelerate that progress and capture additional opportunity,” said Goodyear Board of Directors Chair Joe Hinrichs. “Roger brings extensive automotive and industrial CEO experience, deep operational expertise and strong relationships across OEMs and aftermarket customers. He knows Goodyear, understands the opportunities ahead and has the board’s full confidence to bring heightened focus and urgency to execution while we conduct a thorough search for a permanent CEO. We thank Mark for his contributions to Goodyear.”
paras.zh: 固特异董事会主席 Joe Hinrichs 表示：“固特异在成为一家更高效、更专注的公司方面取得了有意义的进展，董事会认为现在是领导层过渡的最佳时机，以加速这一进展并抓住更多机会。” “罗杰带来了丰富的汽车和工业首席执行官经验、深厚的运营专业知识以及与原始设备制造商和售后市场客户之间的牢固关系。他了解固特异，了解未来的机遇，并且董事会完全有信心在我们彻底寻找永久首席执行官时提高执行的重点和紧迫性。我们感谢马克对固特异的贡献。”

paras.en: “The board formed a special committee earlier this year to conduct a rigorous strategic review of the company to help strengthen performance and create shareholder value,” Hinrichs continued. “The board, together with the Enterprise Transformation Office, is evaluating a broad range of strategic and operational opportunities, and we are committed to taking the right actions to position Goodyear for stronger performance and long-term success. We look forward to providing an update as this work progresses.”
paras.zh: “董事会今年早些时候成立了一个特别委员会，对公司进行严格的战略审查，以帮助增强业绩并创造股东价值，”辛里奇斯继续说道。 “董事会与企业转型办公室正在评估广泛的战略和运营机会，我们致力于采取正确的行动，使固特异获得更强劲的业绩和长期的成功。我们期待着随着这项工作的进展提供最新信息。”

paras.en: “Goodyear has iconic brands, talented people and significant opportunities to improve performance and deliver long-term value,” said Wood. “As I step into this role, my immediate priorities are to support our associates and customers, sharpen execution, and build on the work already underway to advance Goodyear’s transformation. I look forward to working closely with the board, leadership team and the Enterprise Transformation Office to advance the strategic review and translate that work into actions that strengthen performance and position Goodyear for long-term success.”
paras.zh: “固特异拥有标志性品牌、人才以及提高绩效和提供长期价值的重要机会，”伍德说。 “当我担任这一职务时，我的当务之急是支持我们的员工和客户，提高执行力，并在已经开展的工作的基础上推进固特异的转型。我期待着与董事会、领导团队和企业转型办公室密切合作，推进战略审查，并将其转化为行动，以增强业绩，并使固特异取得长期成功。”

paras.en: Wood’s Background in Automotive and Manufacturing
paras.zh: 伍德在汽车和制造业的背景

paras.en: Wood has served on Goodyear’s board since 2023 and brings more than three decades of leadership experience in the automotive and manufacturing industries. He previously served as co-chief executive officer of Tenneco Inc., a global automotive designer, manufacturer and distributor providing clean air, powertrain and ride performance systems for original equipment and aftermarket customers. He also serves on the boards of PHINIA Incorporated and Brunswick Corporation.
paras.zh: 伍德自 2023 年起一直在固特异董事会任职，带来了汽车和制造业三十多年的领导经验。他此前曾担任天纳克公司 (Tenneco Inc.) 的联席首席执行官，该公司是一家全球汽车设计商、制造商和分销商，为原始设备和售后市场客户提供清洁空气、动力总成和乘坐性能系统。他还担任 PHINIA Incorporated 和 Brunswick Corporation 的董事会成员。

articles.title: The Aftermarket’s Overlooked Role in Lower-Emission Transport
articles.author: aftermarketNews Staff

paras.en: The aftermarket’s role in keeping vehicles on the road is well established. Less recognized is its potential to improve the components that keep those vehicles running, using advances in engineering and real-world performance insights to enhance durability, reliability and efficiency, said Dan Griffin, president, aftermarket solutions, at PHINIA.
paras.zh: 售后市场在保持车辆继续行驶方面的作用是众所周知的。 PHINIA 售后解决方案总裁丹·格里芬 (Dan Griffin) 表示，人们不太认识到它有潜力改进使车辆保持运行的组件，利用工程技术的进步和实际性能洞察力来提高耐用性、可靠性和效率。

paras.en: In 2025, the average age of U.S. light vehicles reached 12.8 years, while passenger cars in the EU averaged 12.5 years in 2023. As vehicles remain in service for longer, replacement components can benefit from engineering advances made since they were first manufactured.
paras.zh: 到 2025 年，美国轻型汽车的平均车龄达到 12.8 年，而到 2023 年，欧盟乘用车的平均车龄为 12.5 年。由于车辆的使用寿命更长，更换零部件可以受益于自首次制造以来所取得的工程进步。

paras.en: Alongside continued investment in more efficient propulsion technologies, the aftermarket can contribute through product development, effective repairs, technical support and remanufacturing. Together, these activities can help sustain vehicle performance, extend component life and reduce unnecessary resource consumption. Its contribution to lower-emission transport should therefore be viewed as more than a maintenance function.
paras.zh: 除了持续投资更高效的推进技术外，售后市场还可以通过产品开发、有效维修、技术支持和再制造做出贡献。这些活动共同有助于维持车辆性能、延长部件寿命并减少不必要的资源消耗。因此，它对低排放交通的贡献不应被视为不仅仅是一种维护功能。

paras.en: Engineering advances can improve replacement components, but their contribution to vehicle efficiency also depends on how effectively they are selected, installed and maintained throughout a vehicle’s life, PHINIA‘s Griffin continued.
paras.zh: PHINIA 的 Griffin 继续说道，工程进步可以改进替换部件，但它们对车辆效率的贡献还取决于它们在车辆整个生命周期中的选择、安装和维护的有效性。

paras.en: Modern fuel systems, sensors and engine controls work together to manage combustion and emissions. As components wear or develop faults, that coordination can be affected. A vehicle may remain operational while no longer delivering the performance its systems were designed to achieve.
paras.zh: 现代燃油系统、传感器和发动机控制装置协同工作来管理燃烧和排放。当部件磨损或出现故障时，协调性可能会受到影响。车辆可能会保持运行，但不再提供其系统设计要达到的性能。

paras.en: The quality of a repair therefore matters beyond getting a vehicle moving again. The right component must be selected, the underlying fault understood and the installation completed correctly. For common rail fuel injectors, for example, this can include coding the replacement to ensure the engine control unit accounts for its individual characteristics and controls fuel delivery accurately.
paras.zh: 因此，维修质量比让车辆重新行驶更重要。必须选择正确的组件，了解潜在的故障并正确完成安装。例如，对于共轨燃油喷射器，这可以包括对替换件进行编码，以确保发动机控制单元考虑其各自的特性并准确地控制燃油输送。

paras.en: This is where parts quality, technical expertise and shop capability become inseparable. Even a well-engineered component needs reliable diagnostics, accurate application information and technicians who understand the system. Distributors and parts professionals also play an important role in ensuring shops have access to the correct components, while trusted sourcing and traceability help support repair quality.
paras.zh: 这就是零件质量、技术专长和车间能力密不可分的地方。即使是设计精良的组件也需要可靠的诊断、准确的应用信息和了解系统的技术人员。经销商和零部件专业人员在确保商店获得正确的零部件方面也发挥着重要作用，而可信的采购和可追溯性则有助于支持维修质量。

paras.en: For aftermarket suppliers and shops, the challenge is not simply to keep aging vehicles operational, but to help maintain reliability, manage fuel costs and sustain emissions performance.
paras.zh: 对于售后市场供应商和商店来说，面临的挑战不仅仅是保持老化车辆的运行，而是帮助保持可靠性、管理燃料成本和维持排放性能。

paras.en: Advancing Performance Through Aftermarket Engineering
paras.zh: 通过售后工程提高性能

paras.en: Maintaining a vehicle’s original performance is essential, but aftermarket engineering can go further than simply replicating the components fitted when a vehicle was built. Years of real-world use, combined with advances in materials, manufacturing and engineering, can reveal opportunities to improve component durability and serviceability.
paras.zh: 保持车辆的原始性能至关重要，但售后工程可以比简单地复制车辆制造时安装的组件更进一步。多年的实际使用，加上材料、制造和工程的进步，可以揭示提高部件耐用性和可维护性的机会。

paras.en: Shop feedback can also reveal recurring faults. Returned components can help engineers understand wear patterns. Experience across different climates and duty cycles can show where a design faces its greatest demands. This knowledge gives the aftermarket an opportunity to improve durability and serviceability while maintaining compatibility with the vehicle.
paras.zh: 商店反馈还可以揭示反复出现的故障。返回的组件可以帮助工程师了解磨损模式。不同气候和工作周期的经验可以显示设计面临最大需求的地方。这些知识使售后市场有机会提高耐用性和可维护性，同时保持与车辆的兼容性。

paras.en: A revised material or improved protection against corrosion, for example, may help a component withstand its operating environment for longer. Addressing a known failure mechanism can reduce repeat repairs and the need to manufacture, transport and install further replacements.
paras.zh: 例如，改进的材料或改进的防腐蚀保护可以帮助组件更长时间地承受其工作环境。解决已知的故障机制可以减少重复维修以及制造、运输和安装更多替换件的需要。

paras.en: These improvements must be validated against the requirements of the application. Better durability does not automatically mean lower fuel consumption, and emissions claims need specific evidence. Nevertheless, the principle matters: engineering can continue to improve a product after the vehicle’s original development program has ended.
paras.zh: 这些改进必须根据应用程序的要求进行验证。更好的耐用性并不自动意味着更低的油耗，排放声明需要具体的证据。然而，原则很重要：在车辆的原始开发计划结束后，工程人员可以继续改进产品。

paras.en: Suppliers with both original equipment expertise and close aftermarket relationships are well positioned to connect system knowledge with experience from the shop. That connection should be treated as an ongoing driver of product development.
paras.zh: 拥有原始设备专业知识和密切的售后市场关系的供应商能够很好地将系统知识与车间经验联系起来。这种联系应该被视为产品开发的持续驱动力。

paras.en: Improving component durability is only part of extending a vehicle’s useful life. Access to the right parts, technical information and diagnostic tools is equally important. Gaps in that support can delay repairs, increase costs and lead to equipment being retired prematurely.
paras.zh: 提高部件耐用性只是延长车辆使用寿命的一部分。获得正确的零件、技术信息和诊断工具同样重要。支持方面的差距可能会延迟维修、增加成本并导致设备过早退役。

paras.en: Repairability and remanufacturing should therefore be considered early in product development, alongside durability and performance. Where suitable, recovering and restoring components through controlled processes can preserve useful materials and reduce demand for new resources. Inspection and testing remain essential to ensuring the finished product meets defined standards.
paras.zh: 因此，在产品开发的早期就应考虑可修复性和再制造，以及耐用性和性能。在适当的情况下，通过受控流程回收和恢复组件可以保留有用的材料并减少对新资源的需求。检查和测试对于确保成品符合规定的标准仍然至关重要。

paras.en: The wider environmental benefits of extending vehicle life depend on both the materials it preserves and how efficiently the vehicle or machine continues to operate. Extending its working life should go hand in hand with maintaining safety, reliability and emissions performance.
paras.zh: 延长车辆寿命所带来的更广泛的环境效益取决于其保留的材料以及车辆或机器持续运行的效率。延长其工作寿命应与保持安全性、可靠性和排放性能齐头并进。

paras.en: Ultimately, reducing vehicle emissions requires progress across the entire lifecycle. By combining original equipment expertise with real-world aftermarket insights, the industry can continue improving components long after a vehicle leaves the factory. This ability to maintain performance, address known weaknesses and extend useful life should be recognized as an important part of the transition to lower-emission transport.
paras.zh: 最终，减少车辆排放需要在整个生命周期取得进展。通过将原始设备专业知识与现实世界的售后市场洞察相结合，该行业可以在车辆出厂后很长时间内继续改进零部件。这种保持性能、解决已知弱点和延长使用寿命的能力应被视为向低排放运输过渡的重要组成部分。

articles.title: Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education Given to Corey Bartlett
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented the 2026 Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education, to Corey Bartlett, CEO of Auto Parts Headquarters (APH) based in St. Cloud, Minnesota. The award was presented on November 1st by AWDA Vice Chair Young Suhr at AWDA’s 2026 Annual Conference in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 向位于明尼苏达州圣克劳德的汽车零部件总部 (APH) 首席执行官科里·巴特利特 (Corey Bartlett) 颁发了 2026 年 Art Fisher 卓越教育奖。该奖项于 11 月 1 日由 AWDA 副主席 Young Suhr 在拉斯维加斯举行的 AWDA 2026 年年会上颁发。

paras.en: AWDA’s Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education is presented annually to an aftermarket company or individual that demonstrates outstanding commitment to education and training, either within their organization or throughout the industry. Given in memory of former AWDA Chairman Art Fisher, the award grants scholarships in the name of the award winner to two students enrolled in the automotive aftermarket management program at Northwood University. AWDA Vice Chair Young Suhr presented the award.
paras.zh: AWDA 的 Art Fisher 卓越教育奖每年颁发给在其组织内或整个行业内表现出对教育和培训做出杰出承诺的售后公司或个人。为了纪念 AWDA 前主席 Art Fisher，该奖项以获奖者的名义向诺斯伍德大学汽车售后市场管理项目的两名学生提供奖学金。 AWDA 副主席 Young Suhr 颁奖。

paras.en: Bartlett has prioritized education throughout his career at APH. Within his first 10 years, he reorganized staff and expanded employee training. He completed the University of the Aftermarket’s Leadership 2010 program and earned Automotive Aftermarket Professional and Master Automotive Aftermarket Professional designations in 2002 and 2009.
paras.zh: 巴特利特在 APH 的整个职业生涯中都将教育放在首位。在他上任的头十年里，他重组了员工并扩大了员工培训。他完成了售后市场大学 2010 年领导力课程，并于 2002 年和 2009 年获得汽车售后市场专业人士和汽车售后市场专业硕士称号。

paras.en: “Corey has shown incredible initiative in supporting training and continuing education,” said John R. Washbish, president and CEO, Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. “Through his leadership roles and example, he has consistently improved the education and standards of his staff, the Alliance, and the industry as a whole.”
paras.zh: 售后汽车零部件联盟总裁兼首席执行官 John R. Washbish 表示：“科里在支持培训和继续教育方面表现出了令人难以置信的主动性。通过他的领导作用和榜样，他不断提高员工、联盟以及整个行业的教育和标准。”

paras.en: As CEO, Bartlett and his managers developed a 101-level course to help employees understand APH’s expansion into medium-duty, heavy-duty and agricultural segments. A partnership with a local technical college added hands-on experience, with nearly 100% participation among the company’s 1,200 employees. Corey also helped oversee the Alliance scholarship program and create its Technician of the Year program.
paras.zh: 作为首席执行官，巴特利特和他的经理们开发了 101 级课程，帮助员工了解 APH 向中型、重型和农业领域的扩张。与当地一所技术学院的合作增加了实践经验，公司 1,200 名员工几乎 100% 参与。科里还帮助监督联盟奖学金计划并创建了年度技术员计划。

paras.en: His industry service includes chairing the AWDA Board of Governors, mentoring through the Young Auto Care Networking Group and supporting the Auto Care Political Action Committee. He was the 2017 AWDA Pursuit of Excellence honoree and supports WACOSA and other local nonprofits.
paras.zh: 他的行业服务包括担任 AWDA 理事会主席、通过 Young Auto Care Networking Group 提供指导以及支持 Auto Care 政治行动委员会。他是 2017 年 AWDA 追求卓越奖得主，并支持 WACOSA 和其他当地非营利组织。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens First Store in Richboro, Pa.
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 1039 2nd Street Pike with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Middle Bucks Institute of Technology who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: 以及为当地司机和汽车专业人士提供的专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 2nd Street Pike 1039 号的商店开业举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和中雄鹿理工学院的代表在现场接受了对该校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training, and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “Opening our first store in Richboro is an exciting milestone for our team,” said Eli Rosa, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “We’re grateful for the opportunity to serve this community and proud to support students at Middle Bucks Institute of Technology as they pursue hands-on learning and explore careers in the automotive field.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Eli Rosa 表示：“在 Richboro 开设第一家商店对于我们的团队来说是一个令人兴奋的里程碑。” “我们很高兴有机会为这个社区服务，并很自豪能够支持中雄鹿理工学院的学生追求实践学习并探索汽车领域的职业生涯。”

paras.en: “We appreciate Advance Auto Parts‘ support of our automotive technology program,” said Dr. Mark Covelle, administrative director at Middle Bucks Institute of Technology. “Donations like this help support hands-on learning opportunities for our students as they build skills and prepare for future careers in the industry.”
paras.zh: “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 对我们汽车技术项目的支持，”中巴克斯理工学院行政主任 Mark Covelle 博士说。 “这样的捐赠有助于为我们的学生提供实践学习机会，帮助他们培养技能并为未来的行业职业做好准备。”

articles.title: GSP Launches All-New, Core-Free Brake Caliper Line
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: GSP North America announced the GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program, an all-new caliper range that frees distributors from the cost and hassle of managing cores. It’s on display at AAPEX, booth #F14611.
paras.zh: GSP North America 宣布了 GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划，这是一个全新的卡钳系列，可让经销商免于管理核心的成本和麻烦。它在 AAPEX 上展出，展位号：F14611。

paras.en: Every caliper is entirely new, distributors no longer need to handle, store, sort and ship cores back to the supplier, GSP said.
paras.zh: GSP 表示，每个卡钳都是全新的，经销商不再需要处理、存储、分类并将卡钳运回供应商。

paras.en: Every unit is built from the ground up with OE-matched components:
paras.zh: 每个单元均采用与原厂设备匹配的组件从头开始构建：

paras.en: - Precision-cast ductile iron or aluminum bodies and carrier brackets, with precision-machined surfaces and threads
paras.zh: - 精密铸造球墨铸铁或铝主体和托架，具有精密加工的表面和螺纹

paras.en: - OE-specified phenolic or steel pistons to match each braking system
paras.zh: - OE 指定的酚醛或钢活塞，以匹配每个制动系统

paras.en: - OE-grade EPDM seals and boots that hold piston pressure and keep contaminants out
paras.zh: - OE 级 EPDM 密封件和防尘套可保持活塞压力并防止污染物进入

paras.en: - Installation hardware included: copper washers, new banjo bolt and abutment clips
paras.zh: - 安装硬件包括：铜垫圈、新的班卓琴螺栓和基台夹

paras.en: - 100% end-of-line pressure and leak validated before leaving the factory
paras.zh: - 出厂前经过 100% 终端压力和泄漏验证

paras.en: The initial range covers more than 80% of category demand and is expected to reach 95% within 12 months of its formal launch at AAPEX.
paras.zh: 最初的产品系列覆盖了80%以上的品类需求，预计在AAPEX正式推出后12个月内将达到95%。

paras.en: The range is produced at GSP’s new manufacturing facility in Malaysia. GSP’s distribution partners can expect the same high-level quality and execution they have experienced in all GSP lines, the company said.
paras.zh: 该系列产品在 GSP 位于马来西亚的新制造工厂生产。该公司表示，GSP 的分销合作伙伴可以期待与所有 GSP 系列产品相同的高水平质量和执行力。

paras.en: “The GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program is designed to improve distributors’ operational performance, increase bay throughput through enhanced quality and, ultimately, give customers restored and reliable braking performance,” said Tom Galla, director of new products for GSP North America.
paras.zh: GSP 北美新产品总监 Tom Galla 表示：“GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划旨在提高经销商的运营绩效，通过提高质量来增加海湾吞吐量，并最终为客户提供恢复且可靠的制动性能。”

articles.title: 'Life is too brief to leave this planet': Live Science readers share whether they'd go to Mars, despite health risks
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: For centuries, Mars has been seen as a potential place for future human settlements. But long-duration space travel comes with serious risks to astronauts' health, including those resulting from cosmic radiation and the effects of microgravity.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，火星一直被视为未来人类定居的潜在地点。但长时间的太空旅行会给宇航员的健康带来严重风险，包括宇宙辐射和微重力影响造成的风险。

paras.en: A new study found that rats that were exposed to radiation similar to what astronauts might encounter during a Mars mission developed more scar tissue around their hearts' small blood vessels compared with a control group. Although the findings haven't been validated in humans, the results contribute to growing concerns about the potential effects of long-haul space missions on astronauts' health.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，与对照组相比，暴露于类似于宇航员在火星任务中可能遇到的辐射的老鼠，其心脏小血管周围会形成更多的疤痕组织。尽管这些发现尚未在人体中得到验证，但这些结果引发了人们对长途太空任务对宇航员健康潜在影响的日益担忧。

paras.en: Given these new findings, Live Science asked its readers whether they'd travel to the Red Planet, despite these potential health risks. Over 240 readers weighed in, with 65% picking "No, I don't think the risks are worth it."
paras.zh: 鉴于这些新发现，《生活科学》询问读者是否愿意前往这颗红色星球，尽管存在这些潜在的健康风险。超过 240 名读者发表了意见，其中 65% 的人选择“不，我认为冒险不值得”。

paras.en: Interestingly enough, the comments reflect a slightly different trend. One reader wrote, "Any pioneers who travel to Mars will be facing the prospect of death and never coming back. Even if they make it back, there are any number of health issues that could come up. These risks have not stopped people from exploring throughout human history. The bigger question is who to send?"
paras.zh: 有趣的是，评论反映了略有不同的趋势。一位读者写道：“任何前往火星的先驱者都将面临死亡并且永远不会回来的前景。即使他们回来了，也可能会出现许多健康问题。这些风险并没有阻止人们在整个人类历史上进行探索。更大的问题是派谁去？”

paras.en: - Chinese lander reveals giant 'cavity' of radiation between Earth and the moon — and it could change how lunar exploration is done
paras.zh: - 中国着陆器揭示了地球和月球之间巨大的辐射“空腔” - 它可能会改变月球探索的方式

paras.en: - 'Everything we know about space travel is going to change within a decade': The fusion breakthrough that could unlock a path to the stars
paras.zh: -“我们所知道的关于太空旅行的一切都将在十年内发生变化”：聚变突破可以开启通往恒星的道路

paras.en: - Scientists finally know why astronauts struggle to poop in space — and reveal a hidden risk of long-haul spaceflight
paras.zh: - 科学家们终于知道为什么宇航员在太空中难以排便——并揭示了长途太空飞行的隐藏风险

paras.en: Other commenters echoed this sentiment, with another reader posting, "Explorers in the past have always been exposed to unusual risks; without the risk takers we would still believe the world is flat."
paras.zh: 其他评论者也赞同这种观点，另一位读者发帖称，“过去的探险家总是面临不寻常的风险；如果没有冒险者，我们仍然会相信世界是平的。”

paras.en: Beyond the feelings that Mars will be explored anyway, despite the health risks, other commenters highlighted the cost of these missions, with one reader stating, "Sending flesh water balloons to Mars is ridiculous. For the cost of one human on Mars, we could literally probe the entire solar system and map/sample/rove every planet and every major Moon."
paras.zh: 尽管存在健康风险，但除了认为火星无论如何都会被探索之外，其他评论者还强调了这些任务的成本，一位读者表示，“向火星发送肉水气球是荒谬的。对于一个人在火星上的成本，我们实际上可以探测整个太阳系，并对每颗行星和每颗主要卫星进行地图/采样/漫游。”

paras.en: Others highlighted the mental and emotional cost of a trip to Mars. "As a devoted sci-fi fan for decades, I always wished I could go into space," another reader noted. "Now that I am 77 years old, I realize I would miss the outdoors. The wind and trees, the birdsong and sweet grass under my feet would be a devastating loss. Let the brave explorers go instead. Life is too brief to leave this planet for the uncertainty and dangers of space travel."
paras.zh: 其他人则强调了火星之旅的精神和情感成本。另一位读者指出：“作为几十年来忠实的科幻迷，我一直希望能够进入太空。” “现在我已经 77 岁了，我意识到我会想念户外活动。风和树木、脚下的鸟鸣和甜草将是毁灭性的损失。让勇敢的探险家去吧。生命太短暂，不能因为太空旅行的不确定性和危险而离开这个星球。”

paras.en: Do you agree with these readers? Let us know your thoughts in the comments!
paras.zh: 您同意这些读者的观点吗？请在评论中告诉我们您的想法！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。
