articles.title: Terracotta cockerel vase: A 2,600-year-old Etruscan inkwell featuring 26 letters of the undeciphered ancient language
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: What it is: A bird-shaped ceramic inkwell
paras.zh: 它是什么：鸟形陶瓷墨水池

paras.en: This small terra-cotta vase, which is shaped like a cockerel or young male chicken with human feet, was discovered in central Italy and was made by the ancient Etruscans. The potter inscribed the Etruscan alphabet on the body of the chicken, giving modern researchers clues to a language that has never been fully deciphered.
paras.zh: 这种陶制小花瓶的形状像公鸡或人脚的小公鸡，是在意大利中部发现的，由古代伊特鲁里亚人制作。陶工将伊特鲁里亚字母刻在鸡身上，为现代研究人员提供了研究这种从未被完全破译的语言的线索。

paras.en: The vase stands just over 4 inches (10 centimeters) tall and is in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City. The dark-black ceramic, known as bucchero, was made through a unique firing method that prevented the kiln from getting enough oxygen, which caused the clay to absorb carbon. Bucchero is considered the trademark Etruscan ceramic, and it was produced from the seventh to the fourth centuries B.C. by this pre-Roman society. It is unclear where the cockerel vase was originally found, but it may have been discovered in a grave in one of the many cemeteries that surround Viterbo, which was originally an Etruscan town about 50 miles (80 kilometers) northwest of modern-day Rome.
paras.zh: 该花瓶高 4 英寸（10 厘米）多一点，现收藏于纽约市大都会艺术博物馆。这种被称为“bucchero”的深黑色陶瓷是通过一种独特的烧制方法制成的，该方法阻止窑炉获得足够的氧气，从而导致粘土吸收碳。 Bucchero 被认为是伊特鲁里亚陶瓷的商标，它生产于公元前七世纪至四世纪。由这个前罗马社会。目前还不清楚公鸡花瓶最初是在哪里发现的，但它可能是在维泰博周围众多墓地之一的坟墓中发现的，维泰博最初是一个伊特鲁里亚小镇，位于现代罗马西北约 50 英里（80 公里）处。

paras.en: According to The Met, the vase may have been a portable inkwell used by an ancient Etruscan who was learning how to write. The cockerel's head was the stopper, and it was loosely attached to the body by a cord through a set of loops. The inscription on the body of the vase is known as an abecedarium — the sequential list of letters in an alphabet.
paras.zh: 据大都会博物馆称，这个花瓶可能是古代伊特鲁里亚人学习书写时使用的便携式墨水瓶。公鸡的头就是塞子，它通过穿过一组环的绳索松散地连接到身体上。花瓶身上的铭文被称为“abecedarium”——字母表中字母的顺序列表。

paras.en: The Etruscan alphabet is well known, since it was adopted from a regional version of the Greek alphabet in the early eighth century B.C. There were 26 letters in the Etruscan alphabet, but one of them in this abecedarium is incorrect. A close look at the end of the alphabet shows that someone inscribed an S twice; the second one should look more like an X, according to The Met.
paras.zh: 伊特鲁里亚字母广为人知，因为它是在公元前八世纪早期从希腊字母的区域版本中采用的。伊特鲁里亚字母表中有 26 个字母，但本教程中的其中一个字母不正确。仔细观察字母表的末尾，可以发现有人刻了两次 S；根据大都会博物馆的说法，第二个应该看起来更像一个 X。

paras.en: The terracotta cockerel vase was one of several ancient Etruscan artifacts that helped experts partially decode the mysterious ancient language, as it preserved the order of the letters in the early alphabet, archaeologist Gisela Richter wrote in a 1930 catalog of The Met's classical artifacts.
paras.zh: 考古学家吉塞拉·里克特 (Gisela Richter) 在 1930 年大都会博物馆古典文物目录中写道，陶土公鸡花瓶是几件古代伊特鲁里亚文物之一，它保留了早期字母表中字母的顺序，帮助专家部分解读了这种神秘的古代语言。

paras.en: Thanks to the adoption of the Greek alphabet, it's possible to fully sound out the Etruscan language. But although more than 10,000 Etruscan inscriptions have been found, the language is still only partially understood because those inscriptions are short and any lengthy Etruscan literature that once existed has been lost.
paras.zh: 由于采用了希腊字母，因此可以完整地发音伊特鲁里亚语。尽管已经发现了一万多个伊特鲁里亚铭文，但这种语言仍然只能被部分理解，因为这些铭文很短，而且曾经存在的任何冗长的伊特鲁里亚文献都已经丢失。

paras.zh: 如需更多令人惊叹的考古发现，请查看我们的惊人文物档案。

paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.zh: 你能把上周的惊人神器放在一起吗？

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Did human sacrifice help lower violence? New research in Peru leaves intriguing question
articles.author: Owen Jarus

paras.en: Despite engaging in human sacrifice, the people who lived in the Lambayeque Valley of northern Peru had low levels of violence, a new study of their remains finds.
paras.zh: 一项针对秘鲁北部兰巴耶克山谷居民遗骸的最新研究发现，尽管存在活人祭祀，但他们的暴力程度较低。

paras.en: Human sacrifice occurred in the valley over the millennia. It's thought that at least some of these mass sacrifices were attempts to appease the gods in the wake of El Niño, a periodic weather phenomenon that can lead to intense rains and flooding in Peru and droughts in other parts of South and Central America.
paras.zh: 数千年来，山谷里一直存在活人祭祀的情况。人们认为，至少其中一些大规模祭祀是为了在厄尔尼诺现象之后安抚众神，厄尔尼诺现象是一种周期性的天气现象，可能导致秘鲁的强降雨和洪水以及南美洲和中美洲其他地区的干旱。

paras.en: "We have one example at the site of Sicán where around [A.D.] 1050/1100, around 200 individuals were killed and ritualistically buried during an intense El Niño event," study co-author Haagen Klaus, an anthropology professor at George Mason University in Virginia, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “我们在西坎遗址有一个例子，大约在公元 1050/1100 年，在一次强烈的厄尔尼诺事件中，大约 200 人被杀害并被仪式化地埋葬，”该研究的合著者、弗吉尼亚州乔治梅森大学的人类学教授哈根·克劳斯在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: Other human sacrifice findings include more than 200 children found near the modern-day town of Huanchaco who were sacrificed sometime between 600 and 800 years ago, possibly during an El Niño.
paras.zh: 其他人祭发现包括在现代万查科镇附近发现的 200 多名儿童，他们是在 600 至 800 年前的某个时间（可能是在厄尔尼诺现象期间）被献祭的。

paras.en: However, despite the occurrence of human sacrifice, levels of violence unrelated to sacrifice were actually quite low in the Lambayeque Valley. In the study, scientists analyzed the skeletal remains of 1,519 people from the Lambayeque Valley who lived between roughly 1500 B.C. and A.D. 1800, and whose remains were preserved enough to detect signs of violent trauma, including interpersonal violence.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管存在活人献祭的情况，但兰巴耶克山谷与献祭无关的暴力事件的发生率实际上相当低。在这项研究中，科学家分析了兰巴耶克山谷 1,519 名生活在公元前 1500 年左右的人的骨骼遗骸。公元 1800 年，其遗骸保存得足以检测到暴力创伤的迹象，包括人际暴力。

paras.en: Of these skeletons, "only 25 (1.6%) exhibited traumatic lesions consistent with interpersonal conflict, and 77 exhibited post-cranial traumatic lesions consistent with accidental trauma (5.1%)," Klaus and co-author Thomas Snyder, a bioarchaeologist at New York University, wrote in the paper, which was published Nov. 8 in the journal Frontiers in Environmental Archaeology.
paras.zh: 在这些骨骼中，“只有 25 具 (1.6%) 表现出与人际冲突相符的创伤性病变，77 具表现出与意外创伤相符的颅后创伤性病变 (5.1%)，”克劳斯和合著者、纽约大学生物考古学家托马斯·斯奈德 (Thomas Snyder) 在 11 月 8 日发表在《环境考古学前沿》杂志上的论文中写道。

paras.en: The team didn't find any link between a person's sex and violence, they noted. The findings mean that despite the presence of human sacrifice, the amount of violence unrelated to sacrifice was low. This leaves a question: Why?
paras.zh: 他们指出，研究小组没有发现一个人的性别和暴力之间有任何联系。研究结果意味着，尽管存在活人祭祀，但与祭祀无关的暴力事件数量却很低。这就留下了一个问题：为什么？

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Ritual violence may have alleviated non-ritual violence by creating spaces where social tensions could get worked out in a few different ways," Klaus said.
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“仪式暴力可能通过创造可以通过几种不同方式解决社会紧张局势的空间来减轻非仪式暴力。”

paras.en: It's important to remember that other areas of Peru also practiced human sacrifice but didn't have the same low levels of interpersonal violence. Klaus noted that areas in the Peruvian highlands sometimes had higher rates of interpersonal violence. In their paper, Klaus and Snyder noted that societies that originated in the highlands, such as the Tiwanaku, Wari and Inca had to grapple with poorer soils and cold temperatures, and these challenges may have been a factor in increasing the levels of interpersonal violence.
paras.zh: 重要的是要记住，秘鲁其他地区也实行活人祭祀，但人际暴力的程度并不那么低。克劳斯指出，秘鲁高地地区有时人际暴力发生率较高。克劳斯和斯奈德在论文中指出，蒂瓦纳库、瓦里和印加等起源于高地的社会必须应对贫瘠的土壤和寒冷的气温，而这些挑战可能是人际暴力水平增加的一个因素。

paras.en: The "evidence of sub-lethal and lethal violence forceful enough to break bone is significantly higher in some areas of Peru's highlands," Klaus said. He and Snyder noted in their paper that the inhabitants of the Lambayeque Valley may have had better access to marine and water resources, such as seafood and rivers that could be used for agricultural irrigation, than those who lived in highland areas. Access to these resources may have helped alleviate interpersonal violence in the valley by providing more food resources, they wrote.
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“在秘鲁高地的一些地区，足以折断骨头的亚致命和致命暴力的证据明显增多。”他和斯奈德在论文中指出，兰巴耶克山谷的居民可能比居住在高地地区的居民更容易获得海洋和水资源，例如可用于农业灌溉的海鲜和河流。他们写道，获得这些资源可能通过提供更多的食物资源来帮助减轻山谷中的人际暴力。

paras.en: Aside from practicing human sacrifice, people in the valley may have engaged in other practices that helped lower levels of interpersonal violence, researchers who were not involved in the new study told Live Science.
paras.zh: 未参与这项新研究的研究人员告诉《生活科学》杂志，除了进行活人祭祀之外，山谷中的人们可能还从事其他有助于降低人际暴力水平的做法。

paras.en: Environmental conditions may have helped reduce conflict or there could be "really unusual cultural practices in this region of avoiding or mediating conflict — both between and within groups," Elizabeth Arkush, an anthropology professor at the University of Pittsburgh, said in an email.
paras.zh: 匹兹堡大学人类学教授伊丽莎白·阿库什在一封电子邮件中表示，环境条件可能有助于减少冲突，或者“该地区可能存在非常不寻常的避免或调解冲突的文化习俗——无论是群体之间还是群体内部”。

paras.en: Constanza Ceruti, an anthropologist and explorer with the National Geographic Society, said in an email that she's glad that researchers are studying human sacrifices "after decades of being ignored as a taboo topic in academic discussion." She praised the study’s large sample size and noted that human sacrifice is a "phenomenon primarily associated [with] the manipulation and concentration of power by elites."
paras.zh: 国家地理学会的人类学家和探险家康斯坦萨·塞鲁蒂（Constanza Ceruti）在一封电子邮件中表示，她很高兴研究人员正在研究活人祭祀，“几十年来，人类祭祀在学术讨论中一直被视为禁忌话题而被忽视”。她赞扬了这项研究的大样本量，并指出活人祭祀是一种“主要与精英操纵和集中权力有关的现象”。

paras.en: Jordi Rivera Prince, an anthropology professor at Tulane University, said that the findings dovetail with her excavations in the region, where she has "found little evidence of violent trauma during the Salinar (400-200 BCE), a period of great social change in the Andes."
paras.zh: 杜兰大学人类学教授乔迪·里维拉·普林斯 (Jordi Rivera Prince) 表示，这些发现与她在该地区的发掘相吻合，她“几乎没有发现萨利纳尔时期（公元前 400-200 年）暴力创伤的证据，这是安第斯山脉发生巨大社会变革的时期。”

paras.en: Weston McCool, an archaeology professor at Cal Poly, said in an email that the newly published paper "is an interesting study that provides additional evidence for a sharp break in patterns of violence between the Andean coast and highlands." He noted that it "supports the hypothesis that coastal populations were buffered from terrestrial environmental downturns in ways that highland populations were not. The nature of that resilience, however, remains an important question for future research."
paras.zh: 加州理工大学考古学教授韦斯顿·麦库尔在一封电子邮件中表示，这篇新发表的论文“是一项有趣的研究，为安第斯海岸和高地之间暴力模式的急剧转变提供了额外的证据。”他指出，它“支持了这样的假设，即沿海人口能够以高地人口所没有的方式缓冲陆地环境衰退的影响。然而，这种恢复力的本质仍然是未来研究的一个重要问题。”

paras.en: Snyder, T. J., & Klaus, H. D. (2026). Pax Lambayeque? Trauma, interpersonal violence, and environment over 3,000 years in the Lambayeque Valley Complex, Peru. Frontiers in Environmental Archaeology, 5, 1889466. https://doi.org/10.3389/fearc.2026.1889466
paras.zh: 斯奈德 T. J. 和克劳斯 H. D. (2026)。帕克斯·兰巴耶克？秘鲁兰巴耶克山谷建筑群 3000 多年来的创伤、人际暴力和环境。环境考古学前沿，5, 1889466。https://doi.org/10.3389/fearc.2026.1889466

paras.en: Owen Jarus is a regular contributor to Live Science who writes about archaeology and humans' past. He has also written for The Independent (UK), The Canadian Press (CP) and The Associated Press (AP), among others. Owen has a bachelor of arts degree from the University of Toronto and a journalism degree from Ryerson University.
paras.zh: 欧文·贾鲁斯 (Owen Jarus) 是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，撰写有关考古学和人类过去的文章。他还为《独立报》（英国）、加拿大通讯社 (CP) 和美联社 (AP) 等撰稿。欧文拥有多伦多大学文学学士学位和瑞尔森大学新闻学学位。

articles.title: The Great Pacific Garbage Patch Has Accumulated So Many Microplastics They Might Be Changing the Color of the Ocean

paras.en: Out in the Pacific Ocean, halfway between California and Hawaii, lies a massive collection of human-made debris that spans an area roughly twice the size of Texas. Known as the Great Pacific Garbage Patch, its accumulation of microplastics has now grown so large that it seems to be changing the color of the ocean.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州和夏威夷州之间的太平洋上，散布着大量人造碎片，其面积大约是德克萨斯州面积的两倍。被称为“大太平洋垃圾带”的微塑料堆积物现已变得如此之大，以至于似乎正在改变海洋的颜色。

paras.en: Twenty years of satellite data suggests that the water in and around the trash pile has become more blue-green. Though the researchers couldn’t confirm microplastics are behind the color shift, computer simulations hint that that is likely the case. The findings, published in the journal Communications Earth & Environment on November 5, could help experts identify the most heavily polluted areas of the ocean to guide cleanup efforts.
paras.zh: 二十年的卫星数据表明，垃圾堆内部和周围的水变得更加蓝绿色。尽管研究人员无法确认微塑料是造成颜色变化的原因，但计算机模拟表明情况很可能如此。该研究结果于 11 月 5 日发表在《通讯地球与环境》杂志上，可以帮助专家确定海洋污染最严重的区域，以指导清理工作。

paras.en: “It’s shocking and worrying,” says Aron Stubbins, a chemist and co-director of Northeastern University’s Plastics Center who wasn’t involved in the work, to Evan Bush at NBC News. “The fact that we can see plastics from space is concerning, as well as that there’s enough plastic out there that it’s changing the optical signal of the ocean, because that means it’s altering the light field in the ocean and potentially the way the ocean warms and cools.”
paras.zh: “这令人震惊和担忧，”化学家兼东北大学塑料中心联席主任阿伦·斯塔宾斯 (Aron Stubbins) 向 NBC 新闻的埃文·布什说道，他没有参与这项工作。 “我们可以从太空看到塑料这一事实令人担忧，而且那里有足够的塑料，它正在改变海洋的光学信号，因为这意味着它正在改变海洋中的光场，并可能改变海洋变暖和冷却的方式。”

paras.en: The color of the ocean reflects whatever is in its upper layer. That’s why it’s usually blue; water absorbs longer, redder wavelengths of light and scatters shorter, bluer wavelengths. Other elements, like sediment and microscopic organisms called phytoplankton, can affect the ocean’s hue, since sunlight interacts with those objects differently. However, there was a “gap” in the research on the effect of microplastics, says study co-author Dan Koestner, an ocean optics scientist at the University of Bergen in Norway, to Laura Paddison at CNN.
paras.zh: 海洋的颜色反映了其上层的一切。这就是为什么它通常是蓝色的；水吸收较长、较红的波长的光，并散射较短、较蓝的波长。其他元素，如沉积物和被称为浮游植物的微生物，也会影响海洋的色调，因为阳光与这些物体的相互作用不同。然而，该研究的合著者、挪威卑尔根大学海洋光学科学家丹·科斯特纳 (Dan Koestner) 向美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的劳拉·帕迪森 (Laura Paddison) 表示，关于微塑料影响的研究存在“差距”。

paras.en: Did you know? Microplastics might be warming the atmosphere
paras.zh: 你可知道？微塑料可能会使大气变暖

paras.en: In May, researchers reported that colorful bits of plastic swirling in the atmosphere might be reflecting sunlight and heating the surrounding air, contributing to climate change.
paras.zh: 五月，研究人员报告说，大气中旋转的彩色塑料碎片可能会反射阳光并加热周围的空气，从而导致气候变化。

paras.en: In previous lab experiments, Koestner had examined how lights and lasers scattered differently in ocean water that contained bits of plastic. Armed with that data, he and colleagues behind the new study examined three sets of satellite data showing one of the places in the ocean with the most plastic pollution: the Great Pacific Garbage Patch. Ocean currents trap piles of trash in this area, where they eventually break down into microplastics.
paras.zh: 在之前的实验室实验中，科斯特纳研究了光和激光在含有塑料碎片的海水中如何以不同的方式散射。有了这些数据，他和这项新研究的同事检查了三组卫星数据，这些数据显示了海洋中塑料污染最严重的地方之一：太平洋垃圾带。洋流将成堆的垃圾困在该地区，最终分解成微塑料。

paras.en: The team found that between 2002 and 2022, parts of the patch became 10 percent bluer and 2 to 4 percent greener, reports NBC News. The researchers then ran hundreds of computer simulations to find possible explanations for the change in color. When microplastics were excluded, only 3 percent of simulations produced the observed shift toward cyan. But including microplastics allowed 13 percent to mimic the real-world observations.
paras.zh: 据 NBC 新闻报道，研究小组发现，从 2002 年到 2022 年，部分区域的颜色变蓝了 10%，绿化了 2% 到 4%。研究人员随后进行了数百次计算机模拟，以寻找颜色变化的可能解释。当排除微塑料时，只有 3% 的模拟产生了观察到的向青色的转变。但加入微塑料后，13% 的人可以模仿现实世界的观察结果。

paras.en: To confirm that microplastics are responsible for the ocean’s altered appearance, however, the researchers need to collect samples from the garbage patch.
paras.zh: 然而，为了确认微塑料是造成海洋外观改变的原因，研究人员需要从垃圾带收集样本。

paras.en: “We’re still one step away from proving definitively that microplastics are causing the shift in color that we’re seeing,” says study co-author Shea Cheatham, also an ocean optics researcher at the University of Bergen, to Jackie Flynn Mogensen at Scientific American. “We just have to get in there [to the garbage patch] to verify.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、卑尔根大学海洋光学研究员谢伊·奇塔姆 (Shea Cheatham) 向《科学美国人》的杰基·弗林·摩根森 (Jackie Flynn Mogensen) 表示：“距离明确证明微塑料正在导致我们所看到的颜色变化，我们还差一步。” “我们只需要进入[垃圾场]进行验证即可。”

paras.en: Richard Thompson, a marine biologist at the University of Plymouth in England who wasn’t involved in the research, tells CNN that the findings are important because detecting ocean microplastics is challenging given their size and tendency to get mixed in with phytoplankton and natural debris. “If we can detect change remotely from satellites it will be faster and less costly than counting debris piece by piece,” he says.
paras.zh: 英国普利茅斯大学的海洋生物学家理查德·汤普森（Richard Thompson）没有参与这项研究，他告诉 CNN，这些发现很重要，因为考虑到海洋微塑料的大小以及与浮游植物和天然碎片混合的趋势，检测海洋微塑料具有挑战性。 “如果我们能够通过卫星远程检测变化，这将比逐块计数碎片更快、成本更低，”他说。

paras.en: If the new study’s method can be verified, it can be used to identify other locations with microplastic accumulation, Koestner tells Scientific American. “That would mean that we have a target area for cleaning up.”
paras.zh: 科斯特纳告诉《科学美国人》，如果新研究的方法能够得到验证，它就可以用来识别其他有微塑料积累的地方。 “这意味着我们有一个清理目标区域。”

articles.title: Neolithic Cannibalism Wasn't an Act of Desperation. Almost 1,000 Skeletal Fragments From Caves in Southern Spain Show How Eating Human Flesh Was a Continual Practice

paras.en: For generations, human cannibalism in prehistoric Europe was viewed as a desperate response to starvation. Now, a forensic re-examination of three prehistoric cave sites in southern Spain reveals that people ate human remains as a ritual for millennia, including after violent clashes or as a standard funeral rite.
paras.zh: 几代人以来，史前欧洲的人类同类相食被视为对饥饿的绝望反应。现在，对西班牙南部三个史前洞穴遗址的法医重新检查表明，人们食用人类遗骸作为一种仪式已有数千年，包括在暴力冲突后或作为标准葬礼。

paras.en: Researchers analyzed 967 skeletal fragments representing at least 60 individuals recovered from the caves of Malalmuerzo, Carigüela and Majolicas in the province of Granada. Using high-resolution microscopy, machine learning and radiocarbon dating, the team discovered that these grisly feasts were not confined to a single crisis, such as war or starvation. Instead, they unfolded in “context-dependent episodes” between roughly 5300 B.C.E. and 3760 B.C.E., according to a recent study published in the Journal of Archaeological Science.
paras.zh: 研究人员分析了从格拉纳达省 Malalmuerzo、Carigüela 和 Majolicas 洞穴中发现的 967 块骨骼碎片，代表至少 60 个人。利用高分辨率显微镜、机器学习和放射性碳测年，研究小组发现这些可怕的盛宴并不局限于战争或饥饿等单一危机。相反，它们在大约公元前 5300 年之间以“依赖于上下文的事件”的形式展开。根据《考古科学杂志》最近发表的一项研究，公元前 3760 年。

paras.en: The bone assemblages were first excavated in the 1970s under the direction of Miguel C. Botella, a forensic anthropologist at the University of Granada. Fifty years later, Botella joined a multi-disciplinary team to subject the historical collection to modern forensic analysis.
paras.zh: 这些骨头组合于 20 世纪 70 年代在格拉纳达大学法医人类学家 Miguel C. Botella 的指导下首次发掘。五十年后，博特拉加入了一个多学科团队，对历史收藏进行现代法医分析。

paras.en: “Returning to these materials with new tools has allowed us to address questions that were impossible to answer at the time,” lead author Palmira Saladié, an archaeologist at the Catalan Institute of Human Paleoecology and Social Evolution, explains in a statement.
paras.zh: “用新工具重新审视这些材料使我们能够解决当时无法回答的问题，”主要作者、加泰罗尼亚人类古生态学和社会进化研究所的考古学家帕尔米拉·萨拉迪在一份声明中解释道。

paras.en: By scrutinizing butchery traces, impact fractures and tooth marks under the microscope, the researchers distinguished between injuries inflicted on fresh bone around the time of death and natural degradation that took place years later. The skeletons bore unmistakable hallmarks of systematic butchery: defleshing cut marks, bones split open to harvest marrow, crushed crania to extract brain tissue and bones rendered translucent from boiling.
paras.zh: 通过在显微镜下仔细观察屠宰痕迹、冲击骨折和牙痕，研究人员区分了死亡前后新鲜骨头所受的伤害和几年后发生的自然退化。这些骷髅带有系统屠宰的明显特征：去肉切痕，骨头劈开以获取骨髓，压碎颅骨以提取脑组织，骨头因煮沸而变得半透明。

paras.en: Despite common processing methods, each cave documented a distinct social reality behind the cannibalistic practices. Remains from Malalmuerzo Cave—which coincidentally translates to “Bad Lunch,” Botella tells Joshua Rapp Learn of the New York Times—likely date to an episode of communal violence around 5000 B.C.E. There, 77 percent of the 714 recovered fragments displayed fractures, Historia National Geographic’s Juan Pedro Chuet-Missé reported in September.
paras.zh: 尽管处理方法很常见，但每个洞穴都记录了食人行为背后的独特社会现实。博特拉告诉《纽约时报》的约书亚·拉普·莱恩，Malalmuerzo Cave 的遗迹——巧合的是“糟糕的午餐”——很可能可以追溯到公元前 5000 年左右的一场社区暴力事件。据《国家地理历史》杂志的胡安·佩德罗·楚埃-米塞 (Juan Pedro Chuet-Missé) 9 月份报道，在回收的 714 块碎片中，77% 有骨折。

paras.en: “At Malalmuerzo … our analyses indicate the presence of remains from all age groups, which would suggest a violent event in which all or almost all the individuals in a group were killed and subsequently consumed,” co-author Antonio Rodríguez-Hidalgo, an archaeologist at the Institute of Archaeology of Mérida, says in the statement.
paras.zh: 梅里达考古研究所的考古学家、合著者安东尼奥·罗德里格斯-伊达尔戈在声明中表示：“在马拉穆尔佐……我们的分析表明存在所有年龄段的遗骸，这表明发生了一场暴力事件，其中一个群体中的所有或几乎所有个体都被杀害并随后被吃掉。”

paras.en: Children’s remains from Malalmuerzo also bore human tooth marks indicative of “very intensive consumption,” co-author Ana Solari, an anthropologist at Argentina’s National Scientific and Technical Research Council, tells the Times.
paras.zh: 阿根廷国家科学技术研究委员会的人类学家、合著者安娜·索拉里（Ana Solari）告诉《泰晤士报》，来自马拉穆埃尔佐的儿童遗骸上还带有人类牙印，表明“非常密集的消费”。

paras.en: In contrast, Carigüela Cave revealed recurrent visits across more than a millennium, from approximately 5470 B.C.E. to 3650 B.C.E. Among its 43 human remains, researchers identified two “skull cups”—craniums from an adult and a child that had been carefully broken and retouched along the edges to function as drinking vessels, a mortuary pattern seen at other European sites like El Mirador in Spain and Herxheim in Germany.
paras.zh: 相比之下，卡里圭拉洞穴 (Carigüela Cave) 揭示了从大约公元前 5470 年开始的一千年多来的反复访问。至公元前 3650 年在 43 具人类遗骸中，研究人员发现了两个“头骨杯”——一个成人和一个儿童的头盖骨，这些头盖骨被小心地打碎并沿边缘修饰，以用作饮水器皿，这种模式在西班牙的埃尔米拉多和德国的赫克斯海姆等其他欧洲遗址也曾出现过。

paras.en: At Majolicas Cave, occupied between 3950 B.C.E. and 3760 B.C.E., cannibalism was decoupled from evidence of interpersonal violence. The remains, primarily belonging to adults between 18 and 45, were found coated in reddish pigments identified as cinnabar, a rare mineral associated with death rites.
paras.zh: Majolicas 洞穴，公元前 3950 年有人居住。公元前 3760 年，食人行为与人际暴力的证据脱钩。这些遗骸主要属于 18 岁至 45 岁之间的成年人，被发现涂有微红色颜料，被确定为朱砂，这是一种与死亡仪式有关的稀有矿物。

paras.en: Instead of an act of desperation, eating the dead appears to have been an accepted funerary tradition. While other contemporary European communities practiced internment, burial in open-air graves or, starting in fifth millennium B.C.E., burial in communal megalithic tombs, the dwellers of these southern Spanish caves may have bid farewell to their dead by consuming them.
paras.zh: 吃死者似乎不是一种绝望的行为，而是一种公认​​的丧葬传统。虽然其他当代欧洲社区实行拘留、埋葬在露天坟墓中，或者从公元前五千年开始埋葬在公共巨石坟墓中，但这些西班牙南部洞穴的居民可能通过食用死者来告别他们。

paras.en: The absence of any alternative funerary practice such as burial or cremation in the cave further strengthens this explanation. “The great majority of them, they didn’t kill them,” Botella tells the Times. “They just died; and after they died, they ate them.” He speculates that these communities may have consumed deceased relatives or friends to keep them connected to their lives, drawing a parallel to mortuary cannibalism historically recorded in parts of South America.
paras.zh: 洞穴中没有任何其他丧葬习俗，例如土葬或火葬，进一步证实了这一解释。 “他们中的绝大多数人并没有杀死他们，”博特拉告诉《泰晤士报》。 “它们刚刚死了；死后，它们就吃掉了。”他推测，这些社区可能会吃掉已故的亲戚或朋友，以使他们与自己的生活保持联系，这与历史上南美洲部分地区记录的太平间同类相食相似。

paras.en: Silvia Bello, a palaeoanthropologist and an expert in human cannibalism at the Natural History Museum in London who was not involved in the research, tells the Times that the consumption most likely occurred between members of the same group, though marks of blunt-force trauma on skulls from Malalmuerzo still point to occasional episodes of lethal violence.
paras.zh: 伦敦自然历史博物馆的古人类学家兼人类同类相食专家西尔维娅·贝洛（Silvia Bello）没有参与这项研究，她告诉《泰晤士报》，这种吃人行为很可能发生在同一群体的成员之间，尽管马拉穆尔索头骨上的钝器创伤痕迹仍然表明偶尔会发生致命暴力事件。

paras.en: “For decades, prehistoric cannibalism has tended to be interpreted as a single type of behavior,” Rodríguez-Hidalgo adds in the statement. “Our work shows that … similar archaeological evidence may conceal very different social realities.”
paras.zh: “几十年来，史前同类相食往往被解释为单一类型的行为，”罗德里格斯-伊达尔戈在声明中补充道。 “我们的工作表明……类似的考古证据可能掩盖了截然不同的社会现实。”

articles.title: While Cleaning Out Her Aunt's Manhattan Apartment, a Woman Found a Long-Lost Georgia O'Keeffe Painting Buried Beneath Fur Coats in the Closet

paras.en: Most people’s closets are littered with life’s spare change—broken umbrellas, unpaired socks and discarded scraps of elementary school artwork. But while cleaning out her elderly aunt’s New York City apartment, one woman made a staggering discovery in the closet. Underneath a pile of fur coats sat a Georgia O’Keeffe landscape painting that had been tucked away for four decades.
paras.zh: 大多数人的衣柜里堆满了生活中的零钱——破损的雨伞、不成对的袜子和废弃的小学艺术品碎片。但在清理她年迈的姨妈在纽约市的公寓时，一名妇女在衣柜里发现了一个惊人的发现。在一堆毛皮大衣下面，放着一幅乔治亚·欧姬芙的风景画，这幅画已经被藏了四十年了。

paras.en: When she made the discovery, Betsy, who asked to be referred to by only her middle name, was shocked. “I thought, ‘Wow. That’s pretty wild,’” she tells the New York Post’s Natalie O’Neill.
paras.zh: 当贝特西发现这一事实时，她要求只透露她的中间名，她感到震惊。 “我想，‘哇。这太疯狂了，’”她告诉《纽约邮报》的娜塔莉·奥尼尔。

paras.en: The 1930 painting, Near Abiquiu, New Mexico I, is thought to be the first in a series of three paintings depicting Lobo Peak in northern New Mexico. (The second is at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the third is in a private collection.) It will hit the auction block as part of Christie’s 20th Century Evening Sale on November 17. Estimates place the piece’s value between $3 million and $5 million.
paras.zh: 1930 年的画作《新墨西哥州阿比奎附近 I》被认为是描绘新墨西哥州北部洛博峰的三幅画作系列中的第一幅。 （第二件现藏于大都会艺术博物馆，第三件为私人收藏。）这件作品将于 11 月 17 日作为佳士得 20 世纪晚间拍卖会的一部分在拍卖场上拍卖。估价该件作品的价值在 300 万至 500 万美元之间。

paras.en: “To uncover a seminal work—representative of this 20th century master’s deep personal engagement with the landscape, a pillar of her career, which is exquisitely rendered and well preserved—is a once-in-a-lifetime moment and absolutely thrilling,” Tylee Abbott, head of American Art at Christie’s New York, says in a statement.
paras.zh: 纽约佳士得美国艺术部主管泰莉·阿博特 (Tylee Abbott) 在一份声明中表示：“揭开这幅开创性的作品——代表了这位 20 世纪大师对风景的深入个人参与，这是她职业生涯的支柱，其渲染精美且保存完好——是一生一次的时刻，绝对令人兴奋。”

paras.en: The artwork features warm earth tones and soft, rippling hills, an early iteration of the abstracted New Mexico landscapes she would paint throughout her career.
paras.zh: 这件艺术品以温暖的大地色调和柔和、起伏的山丘为特色，这是她在整个职业生涯中绘制的抽象新墨西哥风景的早期迭代。

paras.en: “O’Keeffe goes to New Mexico in 1929, and this picture is from 1930, so it’s the ground floor of her inspiration at that time,” Abbott tells CBS News’ Noelle Lilley. “And she is very vocal about, in her writings and things, about how impactful it was on her. I think you get that in this picture.”
paras.zh: “奥基夫 1929 年去了新墨西哥州，这张照片是 1930 年的，所以这是她当时灵感的基础，”阿博特告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻的诺埃尔·利利。 “她在她的著作和事物中非常直言不讳地表达了这对她的影响。我想你从这张照片中就明白了。”

paras.en: Betsy’s aunt, a career Foreign Service worker and world-ranked bridge master, acquired Near Abiquiu in 1963. It was a graduation gift from her parents, purchased directly from O’Keeffe’s New York dealer for $3,800, roughly $42,000 today.
paras.zh: 贝特西的姨妈是一名职业外交人员，也是世界排名最高的桥牌大师，她于 1963 年买下了近阿比奎 (Near Abiquiu)。这是她父母送给她的毕业礼物，直接从 O’Keeffe 纽约经销商处以 3,800 美元的价格购买，相当于今天的 42,000 美元。

paras.en: She displayed the modernist piece in her New York apartment for decades. But one day in the mid-1980s, in the middle of a bridge game, she noticed a guest eyeing the painting a little too closely. Out of an abundance of caution, she hid the piece in her entry closet, carefully enclosing the 10-by-24-inch painting in its original box and tucking it behind rows of fur coats.
paras.zh: 几十年来，她一直在纽约的公寓里展示这件现代主义作品。但 20 世纪 80 年代中期的一天，在一场桥牌游戏中，她注意到一位客人过于仔细地注视着这幅画。出于谨慎起见，她将这幅作品藏在入口衣柜里，小心地将这幅 10 x 24 英寸的画放入原来的盒子中，然后将其塞在一排毛皮大衣后面。

paras.en: Did you know? A controversial characterization
paras.zh: 你可知道？有争议的表征

paras.en: - Many critics “projected sexual meanings onto the alluring, inward-curving petals” of O’Keeffe’s enlarged flower paintings, Smithsonian magazine’s Jennie Rothenberg Gritz writes.
paras.zh: - 史密森尼杂志的珍妮·罗滕伯格·格里茨 (Jennie Rothenberg Gritz) 写道，许多评论家“将性的含义投射到奥基夫放大的花卉画中诱人的、向内弯曲的花瓣上”。

paras.en: - O’Keeffe disputed those characterizations: “When you took time to really notice my flower, you hung all your associations with flowers on my flower and you write about my flower as if I think and see what you think and see of the flower—and I don’t.”
paras.zh: - 欧姬芙对这些描述提出了质疑：“当你花时间真正注意到我的花时，你就把你与花的所有联系都挂在了我的花上，你写下我的花，就好像我在思考和看到你对花的想法和看到的一样——而我却没有。”

paras.en: “I think she was fully aware of its value,” Betsy explains to the Post. “She recognized that it was an expression of her financial position. … She disliked drawing attention to herself.”
paras.zh: “我认为她完全意识到它的价值，”贝特西向《华盛顿邮报》解释道。 “她认识到这是她财务状况的体现。……她不喜欢引起别人的注意。”

paras.en: That meant keeping Near Abiquiu away from all curious eyes, even family members. Betsy had no knowledge of the treasure hidden in her aunt’s closet until 2022, when the pair were preparing the apartment for the arrival home health aides. “That’s when she mentioned, ‘Oh, by the way, there’s a Georgia O’Keeffe in the hall closet,” she tells the Post.
paras.zh: 这意味着尼尔·阿比奎远离所有好奇的目光，甚至是家人。直到 2022 年，贝特西才知道姨妈衣柜里藏着宝藏，当时两人正在为抵达的家庭健康助手准备公寓。 “就在那时，她提到，‘哦，顺便说一下，大厅壁橱里有一幅乔治亚·欧姬芙的作品，’她告诉《华盛顿邮报》。

paras.en: But it wasn’t until a few weeks ago, when Betsy returned to help her since-deceased aunt prepare for hospice, that she finally laid eyes on the artwork itself.
paras.zh: 但直到几周前，当贝特西回来帮助她已故的姨妈准备临终关怀时，她才终于看到了艺术品本身。

paras.en: Until its rediscovery, the painting was known to the art world from a sole 1931 photograph, taken by O’Keeffe’s husband, Alfred Stieglitz. Christie’s was able to identify the work using the photograph and O’Keeffe’s distinctive, looping signature in a star-shaped design on the back.
paras.zh: 在这幅画被重新发现之前，艺术界仅通过一张 1931 年由欧姬芙的丈夫阿尔弗雷德·施蒂格利茨 (Alfred Stieglitz) 拍摄的照片而为人所知。佳士得能够通过照片和背面星形设计中奥姬芙独特的环形签名来识别这件作品。

paras.en: “We certainly use just a visual analysis of looking at the painting, looking at the styles, how the brush strokes may match, how other O’Keeffes appear that we’ve known that we’ve sold,” Abbott tells CBS News. “But also, O’Keeffe is very well-documented with a [catalogue raisonné] that published all [her] known works ... This work, of course, appears in the addendum of that as ... ‘unlocated.’”
paras.zh: “我们当然只是使用视觉分析来观察这幅画，观察风格，笔触如何匹配，我们知道我们已经售出的其他奥基夫作品的外观如何，”阿博特告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻。 “而且，欧姬芙的[目录全集]记录得非常详细，其中出版了[她]所有已知的作品……当然，这部作品出现在该作品的附录中……‘未定位’。”

paras.en: After decades languishing as “unlocated,” concealed among piles of fur, the painting is now on public view at Christie’s New York through November 17, ahead of its auction.
paras.zh: 几十年来，这幅画被隐藏在成堆的毛皮中，“下落不明”，如今在纽约佳士得公开展出，直至 11 月 17 日拍卖之前。

articles.title: These WIRED-Tested Standing Desks Are Already on Sale for Black Friday
articles.author: Kat Merck

paras.en: Standing desks alone may not be a panacea for reducing health risks from sitting all day, but throwing a walking pad underneath and getting some steps in while attending to brainless tasks certainly can’t hurt. If your New Year’s resolution has anything to do with health, you might want to consider grabbing a standing desk now, while many of our WIRED-tested and recommended brands are on sale. A walking pad we recommend is also discounted ahead of Black Friday, if you want to complete your setup.
paras.zh: 单独使用站立式办公桌可能并不是减少整天坐着带来的健康风险的灵丹妙药，但在下面放一个步行垫，在处理不需要动脑筋的任务时走几步肯定不会有什么坏处。如果您的新年决心与健康有关，您可能需要考虑现在就购买一张站立式办公桌，而我们的许多经过《连线》测试和推荐的品牌都在打折。如果您想完成设置，我们推荐的步行垫在黑色星期五之前也会打折。

paras.en: Be sure to also check out our main Best Black Friday Deals, as well as early deals on headphones, TVs, and hot tech at Best Buy.
paras.zh: 请务必查看我们的主要黑色星期五优惠，以及百思买的耳机、电视和热门科技产品的早期优惠。

paras.en: Save 20 Percent on the Best Compact Standing Desk
paras.zh: 购买最佳紧凑型站立式办公桌可节省 20%

paras.en: If you’re short on space, this is the desk WIRED Gear editor Julian Chokkattu recommends. It supports a variety of add-ons, like a desk tray and cable organizer; the motor is quiet; and the paddle control panel is simple to use.
paras.zh: 如果您空间有限，《连线》杂志编辑朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 推荐您使用这款办公桌。它支持各种附加组件，例如桌面托盘和电缆整理器；电机安静；桨控制面板使用起来很简单。

paras.en: Save 20 Percent on an Editor’s Personal Favorite
paras.zh: 购买编辑个人最爱的商品可节省 20%

paras.en: Branch makes our longtime top-pick office chair (also 10 percent off), but it turns out the brand’s standing desks aren’t too shabby either. This is WIRED Gear editor Julian Chokkattu’s favorite standing desk, with a classic, four-legged form that looks like regular office furniture. He found it simple to set up and liked that there are two wood-grain desk and two leg color options to choose from (shown is cognac with black legs).
paras.zh: Branch 生产我们长期以来的首选办公椅（也有 10% 的折扣），但事实证明该品牌的站立式办公桌也不算太破旧。这是 WIRED Gear 编辑 Julian Chokkattu 最喜欢的站立式办公桌，具有经典的四腿形状，看起来像普通的办公家具。他发现设置很简单，并且喜欢有两个木纹桌子和两个腿颜色可供选择（所示为带有黑色腿的干邑白兰地）。

paras.en: Both former WIRED director Martin Cizmar and former WIRED reviewer Matthew Korfhage loved Vari’s ComfortEdge, saying it offers the greatest adjustability, easiest assembly, and longest warranty (lifetime) of any desk in this price range. They also praised the sloped front edge, which lets you rest your forearms comfortably, and the unusually wide height range that accommodates people well over 6 feet (and/or a walking pad).
paras.zh: 前《连线》总监 Martin Cizmar 和前《连线》评论员 Matthew Korfhage 都喜欢 Vari 的 ComfortEdge，称其在同价位的任何办公桌中提供了最大的可调节性、最简单的组装和最长的保修（生命周期）。他们还称赞了倾斜的前缘，可以让您舒适地休息前臂，以及异常宽广的高度范围，可以容纳超过 6 英尺的人（和/或步行垫）。

paras.en: I had this basic FlexiSpot model for years before upgrading to the larger Uplift QuadZen below. Assembly was a bit tricky, but I otherwise had no complaints—the generously sized worktop was easy to clean, the steel base adjusted smoothly, and it easily accommodated my 5'6" height while on a walking pad.
paras.zh: 在升级到下面更大的 Uplift QuadZen 之前，我已经使用了这个基本的 FlexiSpot 型号很多年了。组装有点棘手，但除此之外我没有任何抱怨——宽大的工作台面很容易清洁，钢制底座调节顺畅，而且在步行垫上它可以轻松适应我 5 英尺 6 英寸的身高。

paras.en: This handsome 60 x 30-inch walnut-top desk offers plenty of space for a monitor, speakers, and just about anything else you’d need, but my favorite part is the sheer breadth of available accessories that allow you to customize it into your perfect standing desk. Many of these add-ons are on sale as well, including the mountable surge protector; DuoMount power strip, which puts outlets and USB inputs right on the desk itself; and cable sleeves, which zip all your cords into one organized package.
paras.zh: 这款漂亮的 60 x 30 英寸胡桃木桌面办公桌为显示器、扬声器和几乎所有您需要的其他物品提供了充足的空间，但我最喜欢的部分是丰富的可用配件，让您可以将其定制为完美的站立式办公桌。其中许多附加组件也在销售，包括可安装的电涌保护器； DuoMount 电源板，将插座和 USB 输入直接放在桌面上；和电缆套管，可将所有电线压缩到一个有序的包装中。

paras.en: The Best Early Black Friday Walking Pad Deal
paras.zh: 黑色星期五早期最佳步行垫优惠

paras.en: This is the Most Versatile pick from our guide to the Best Walking Pads, and it has the biggest discount of any walking pad we recommend. WIRED contributing reviewer Kristen Canning loved its easy-to-use app and that it doubled as a stable treadmill with a handlebar that could handle even running at top speed.
paras.zh: 这是我们最佳步行垫指南中最通用的选择，它在我们推荐的所有步行垫中具有最大的折扣。 《连线》特约评论员克里斯汀·坎宁 (Kristen Canning) 非常喜欢它易于使用的应用程序，而且它还可以作为一款稳定的跑步机，带有把手，甚至可以以最快的速度跑步。

articles.title: Waymo Said It Fixed Its School Bus Problem. The US Government Says It Didn’t Work
articles.author: Aarian Marshall

paras.en: The US government is examining whether Waymo’s recall of software involved with a series of school bus passing incidents last fall actually fixed the safety issue.
paras.zh: 美国政府正在调查 Waymo 召回去年秋天涉及一系列校车超车事件的软件是否真正解决了安全问题。

paras.en: The formal investigation by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) will determine whether the company’s supposed software fix succeeded in preventing its robotaxis from improperly passing stopped school buses with red lights on and their stop arms extended—indicators that the buses were picking up and dropping off students. It is illegal to pass these stopped school buses in all 50 states.
paras.zh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 的正式调查将确定该公司所谓的软件修复是否成功阻止其机器人出租车不当通过停着的校车，校车红灯亮起，停车臂伸出——这表明校车正在接送学生。在所有 50 个州，通过这些停止的校车都是违法的。

paras.en: According to a filing, Waymo issued a fix for the software issue in mid-November, and an official voluntary recall a month later. But the government says that the majority of school bus issues occurred after that date.
paras.zh: 根据一份文件，Waymo 于 11 月中旬发布了软件问题的修复程序，并在一个月后正式主动召回。但政府表示，大多数校车问题都发生在该日期之后。

paras.en: Earlier this year, a report from the National Transportation Safety Board, the US’ independent safety agency, found that another school bus passing incident occurred in mid-January, several weeks after the supposed software fix. The NTSB is also investigating the school bus passing issue.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，美国独立安全机构国家运输安全委员会的一份报告发现，一月中旬又发生了另一起校车超车事件，距所谓的软件修复几周后。 NTSB 也在调查校车超车问题。

paras.en: In a written statement, Waymo spokesperson Dana Gallagher said the company has “made significant improvements to vehicle behavior around school buses,” and that it has not been cited for passing school buses since last March—months after the mid-December software recall. She wrote that Waymo looks “forward to continuing our engagement on recall processes for AV software that continues to learn and improve.”
paras.zh: Waymo 发言人达纳·加拉格尔 (Dana Gallagher) 在一份书面声明中表示，该公司“对校车周围的车辆行为做出了重大改进”，并且自去年 3 月（12 月中旬软件召回几个月后）以来，该公司就没有因超过校车而被引用。她写道，Waymo 期待“继续参与自动驾驶软件的召回流程，并不断学习和改进。”

paras.en: Late last year, WIRED has reported, the Austin school district even helped set up a half-day data collection event for Waymo’s vehicles, coordinating with the self-driving vehicle developer to bring school buses and stop-arm signals to an empty parking lot so that the company could collect information to help train their vehicles to avoid the illegal street maneuver. The data collection event occurred after Waymo had issued its software fix and voluntary recall. Still, the incidents continued.
paras.zh: 据《连线》报道，去年年底，奥斯汀学区甚至帮助为 Waymo 的车辆举办了一次为期半天的数据收集活动，与自动驾驶汽车开发商协调，将校车和停车臂信号带到空旷的停车场，以便该公司可以收集信息来帮助训练他们的车辆以避免非法街道操纵。数据收集事件发生在 Waymo 发布软件修复和自愿召回之后。尽管如此，事件仍在继续。

paras.en: In years past, recall queries like this one have led to civil penalties, some of them costing automakers and software developers tens of millions of dollars.
paras.zh: 在过去的几年里，像这样的召回查询已经导致民事处罚，其中一些导致汽车制造商和软件开发商损失数千万美元。

articles.title: GOP Rep. Thomas Massie introduces impeachment articles against Pete Hegseth

paras.en: Nov. 9 (UPI) -- Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., introduced articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Monday over the U.S. war on Iran. A House vote on the articles could happen this week.
paras.zh: 11 月 9 日（UPI）——肯塔基州共和党众议员托马斯·马西 (Thomas Massie) 周一就美国对伊朗战争提出了针对国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 的弹劾条款。众议院可能会在本周对这些条款进行投票。

paras.en: Massie originally introduced impeachment articles against Hegseth in September, but Speaker of the House Mike Johnson dismissed lawmakers early, avoiding a vote on the issue before the midterm elections. Now that they have been reintroduced, Republican leaders have two days to schedule a vote.
paras.zh: 马西最初于 9 月提出针对赫格塞斯的弹劾条款，但众议院议长迈克·约翰逊提前解散了议员，避免在中期选举前就该问题进行投票。既然它们已被重新引入，共和党领导人有两天的时间来安排投票。

paras.en: The updated resolution includes eight charges against Hegseth, some of which accuse him of abusing the powers of the Defense Department and waging war against Iran without congressional approval, an attack on the United States or an imminent threat.
paras.zh: 更新后的决议包括对赫格塞斯的八项指控，其中一些指控他滥用国防部的权力，未经国会批准对伊朗发动战争，对美国进行攻击或构成迫在眉睫的威胁。

paras.en: Charges also include ignoring laws that minimize civilian casualties, presiding over extrajudicial killings (referring to strikes on alleged drug boats), suppressing free speech (in reference to using department authority to threaten Sen. Mark Kelly over his comments on questioning unlawful military orders) and kidnapping of a sovereign foreign leader (referring to the kidnapping of Nicolás Maduro of Venezuela without congressional or legal authority).
paras.zh: 指控还包括无视最大限度减少平民伤亡的法律、主持法外处决（指对涉嫌贩毒船的袭击）、压制言论自由（指利用部门权力威胁参议员马克·凯利质疑非法军事命令的言论）以及绑架外国主权领导人（指未经国会或法律授权绑架委内瑞拉的尼古拉斯·马杜罗）。

paras.en: "By engaging in hostilities in Iran for more than 90 days without congressional authorization, Secretary Hegseth is breaking the law and must be held accountable," Massie said.
paras.zh: 马西说：“未经国会授权，赫格赛斯部长在伊朗境内进行了超过 90 天的敌对行动，这违反了法律，必须追究责任。”

paras.en: "Secretary Hegseth's constitutional violations extend beyond the illegal war in Iran," he said. "He is abusing the power of his office to ignore congressional war powers resolutions, to kidnap foreign leaders and to intimidate critics of the Trump administration by retaliating against them for exercising free speech. If we are to remain true to our oath to 'support and defend the Constitution of the United States,' the House of Representatives must act."
paras.zh: “国务卿赫格塞斯的违宪行为超出了伊朗非法战争的范围，”他说。 “他滥用职权，无视国会战争权力决议，绑架外国领导人，并通过报复特朗普政府的批评者行使言论自由来恐吓他们。如果我们要恪守‘支持和捍卫美国宪法’的誓言，众议院就必须采取行动。”

paras.en: Hegseth said he wasn't worried about the charges and that he plans to hold a press conference on the impeachment effort Tuesday morning. In a social media post last week, he called Massie "a disgruntled, defeated congressman" and said the charges are "all about the politics of personal destruction."
paras.zh: 赫格斯表示，他并不担心这些指控，并计划周二上午就弹劾工作举行新闻发布会。在上周的社交媒体帖子中，他称马西为“一位心怀不满、失败的国会议员”，并表示这些指控“都是关于个人毁灭的政治”。

paras.en: "Didn't work against President Trump and won't work against me," Hegseth said.
paras.zh: 赫格斯说：“不会对特朗普总统不利，也不会对我不利。”

paras.en: Some other Republicans have also questioned Hegseth's actions in Iran, though they've also questioned if he deserves to be impeached.
paras.zh: 其他一些共和党人也质疑赫格塞斯在伊朗的行为，尽管他们也质疑他是否应该被弹劾。

paras.en: "We have no idea what the strategy is moving forward in Iran," said Rep. James Comer, R-Ky., who leads the House Oversight Committee. "No one's happy about Iran. I think the Republican voters are more unhappy about what's going on in Iran than the Democrat voters."
paras.zh: 众议院监督委员会主席、肯塔基州共和党众议员詹姆斯·科默表示：“我们不知道伊朗正在采取什么战略。” “没有人对伊朗感到高兴。我认为共和党选民比民主党选民对伊朗正在发生的事情更不满意。”

paras.en: Hegseth would be the third U.S. Cabinet secretary to be impeached. Neither of the other two, William Belknap in 1876 and Alejandro Majorkas in 2024, was removed from office. Belknap was acquitted by the Senate and the charges against Majorkas were dropped.
paras.zh: 赫格斯将成为第三位被弹劾的美国内阁部长。另外两人——1876 年的威廉·贝尔克纳普（William Belknap）和 2024 年的亚历杭德罗·马约卡斯（Alejandro Majorkas）——都没有被免职。贝尔纳普被参议院宣告无罪，对马乔卡斯的指控也被撤销。

articles.title: 25 California half marathoners treated for mysterious illness

paras.en: Nov. 9 (UPI) -- Police are investigating an incident in which 25 runners in the Santa Barbara, Calif., Half Marathon and 5K were hospitalized with unusual symptoms.
paras.zh: 11 月 9 日（UPI）——警方正在调查一起事件，该事件导致 25 名参加加州圣巴巴拉半程马拉松和 5K 比赛的选手因异常症状入院治疗。

paras.en: The runners fell ill Sunday and were treated at Santa Barbara Cottage Hospital and Goleta Valley Cottage Hospital. Cristina Cortez, Cottage Health public relations manager, said the runners shared "similar symptoms."
paras.zh: 周日，跑步者们生病了，在圣巴巴拉小屋医院和戈利塔谷小屋医院接受治疗。 Cottage Health 公共关系经理克里斯蒂娜·科尔特斯 (Cristina Cortez) 表示，跑步者有“相似的症状”。

paras.en: The hospital is investigating whether the symptoms are due to illness, heat or "other factors."
paras.zh: 医院正在调查这些症状是否是由于疾病、高温或“其他因素”造成的。

paras.en: "We have a larger than expected number of emergency visits that are tracked to participants in this morning's organized run in Santa Barbara," Cortez said in a statement.
paras.zh: 科尔特斯在一份声明中说：“我们对今天早上在圣巴巴拉组织的跑步活动的参与者进行的紧急访问数量超出了预期。”

paras.en: The Santa Barbara Police Department advised participants in the marathon and 5K to seek medical attention if they are feeling ill. The department also asked anyone with information or runners who have experienced unusual symptoms to call Sgt. Andre Miller at 805-897-2330.
paras.zh: 圣巴巴拉警察局建议马拉松和 5K 比赛的参与者如果感到不适，请立即就医。该部门还要求任何有信息的人或出现异常症状的跑步者致电中士。安德烈·米勒，电话：805-897-2330。

paras.en: David Monico, director of the marathon and 5K, said in an interview that the heat and number of participants may be factors.
paras.zh: 马拉松及5K赛事总监大卫·莫尼科在接受采访时表示，气温和参赛人数可能是因素。

paras.en: "In years past, we've had overcast skies or less warm temperatures this time of year, so we have not had this many transports, but there's always a handful," he said. "But this year, it was more than we've had in the past. We also had more runners than we've had in the past as well."
paras.zh: 他说：“在过去的几年里，每年这个时候我们都会遇到阴天或气温较低的情况，所以我们没有这么多的交通工具，但总是有少数。” “但今年，比过去更多。我们的跑步者也比过去更多。”

paras.en: About 7,500 people participated in the event, which started at 7 a.m. PST.
paras.zh: 该活动于太平洋标准时间上午 7 点开始，约有 7,500 人参加。

articles.title: Supreme Court may bar federal inmates from suing over denied medical care

paras.en: Nov. 9 (UPI) -- The U.S. Supreme Court heard arguments Monday in the case of a former federal prison inmate who says he was denied medical treatment after he was beaten by other prisoners.
paras.zh: 11 月 9 日（UPI）——美国最高法院周一听取了一名前联邦监狱囚犯案件的辩论，该囚犯称自己在遭到其他囚犯殴打后被拒绝接受治疗。

paras.en: The high court appeared likely to rule against plaintiff Kekai Watanabe of Hawaii, in a move that could bar federal inmates from suing those who deny them medical care, NBC News reported. It's the latest in a series of cases that have sought to scale back the ability to hold federal officials accountable for alleged constitutional violations.
paras.zh: 据 NBC 新闻报道，高等法院似乎可能做出对夏威夷原告 Kekai Watanabe 不利的裁决，此举可能会禁止联邦囚犯起诉那些拒绝为他们提供医疗服务的人。这是一系列试图削弱追究联邦官员涉嫌违反宪法责任的案件中的最新一起。

paras.en: Watanabe alleges that other prisoners beat him during a gang riot in July 2021 at a federal facility in Honolulu. He said officers then denied him medical treatment.
paras.zh: 渡边声称，2021 年 7 月檀香山一处联邦设施发生帮派骚乱时，其他囚犯殴打了他。他说，警察随后拒绝为他提供治疗。

paras.en: The case involves the 1971 Supreme Court ruling of Bivens vs.Six Unknown Federal Narcotics Agents. The court decision in that case allowed people to sue federal officials for civil rights violations.
paras.zh: 该案涉及 1971 年最高法院对 Bivens 诉六名身份不明的联邦缉毒人员的裁决。该案的法院判决允许人们起诉联邦官员侵犯公民权利。

paras.en: A 1980 Supreme Court ruling, Carlson vs. Green, expanded on the Bivens case. Justices then said federal inmates can sue officials for deliberate indifference to their medical needs under the Eighth Amendment of the Constitution. That amendment protects against cruel and unusual punishment.
paras.zh: 1980 年最高法院的一项裁决“卡尔森诉格林案”对比文斯案进行了扩展。法官随后表示，根据宪法第八修正案，联邦囚犯可以起诉官员故意漠视他们的医疗需求。该修正案防止残忍和不寻常的惩罚。

paras.en: On Monday, several conservative justices said inmates have other ways to file such claims. These include through internal prison procedures and through the Federal Tort Claims Act, which also limits the amount of damages and prevents inmates from suing individual officers.
paras.zh: 周一，几位保守派法官表示，囚犯还有其他方式提出此类索赔。其中包括通过监狱内部程序和《联邦侵权索赔法》，该法还限制了损害赔偿金额并防止囚犯起诉个别官员。

paras.en: Justice Brett Kavanaugh said Monday that act "does seem to negate the need" for claims under the Bivens ruling.
paras.zh: 法官布雷特·卡瓦诺周一表示，该法案“似乎确实否定了”根据比文斯裁决提出索赔的必要性。

paras.en: In 2022, the high court rolled back Bivens protections in a ruling that said Border Patrol agents could not be used. An NBC News investigation in 2023 found that case later played a role in the dismissal of 195 cases.
paras.zh: 2022 年，高等法院在一项裁决中取消了对比文斯的保护，称不能使用边境巡逻人员。 NBC新闻在2023年的一项调查发现，该案件后来在驳回195起案件中发挥了作用。

articles.title: ROSÉ of BLACKPINK Covers ‘One of My Favorite Songs’ by The Killers at Star-Studded LACMA Gala
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: ROSÉ got out of the APT. on Saturday (Nov. 7), attending the 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala to perform four songs — including a cover of The Killers — and enjoy a star-studded evening celebrating Dune director Denis Villeneuve and artist Vija Celmins.
paras.zh: ROSÉ 离开了 APT。周六（11 月 7 日），出席 2026 年 LACMA 艺术+电影盛典，表演四首歌曲（包括翻唱《The Killers》），并享受一个众星云集的夜晚，庆祝《沙丘》导演 Denis Villeneuve 和艺术家 Vija Celmins。

paras.en: As captured in clips from the night, the BLACKPINK star rocked out to “Read My Mind” from the Brandon Flowers-fronted band’s 2006 Billboard 200 No. 2 album Sam’s Town, her live vocals sounding more powerful than ever as she let the emotion of the lyrics lead the way. “This next song is one of my favorite songs to cover,” she said before the tune. “Please sing along if you know it.”
paras.zh: 从当晚的片段中可以看出，这位 BLACKPINK 明星摇滚地唱着 Brandon Flowers 领衔的乐队 2006 年 Billboard 200 排名第二的专辑《Sam’s Town》中的《Read My Mind》，她的现场歌声听起来比以往任何时候都更有力量，因为她让歌词的情感引领了潮流。 “下一首歌曲是我最喜欢翻唱的歌曲之一，”她在曲子开始前说道。 “如果你知道的话请跟着唱。”

paras.en: The Los Angeles County Museum of Art also shared a video snippet of ROSÉ jumping up and down and whipping her hair while energetically singing “New Trick,” her new solo song released in September. Dressed in a dainty white dress with a pale pink flower decal on the shoulder, the K-pop superstar also played 12-week Billboard Global 200-topping Bruno Mars duet “APT.” as well as “Number One Girl” from her 2024 debut solo album, Rosie, according to Vanity Fair.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶郡艺术博物馆还分享了一段视频片段，其中 ROSÉ 一边跳来跳去、一边甩动头发，一边精力充沛地唱着她 9 月份发行的新独唱歌曲《New Trick》。这位韩国流行音乐巨星身着精致的白色连衣裙，肩部饰有淡粉色花朵贴花，还演奏了连续 12 周位列 Billboard 全球 200 强的 Bruno Mars 双人重唱《APT》。据《名利场》报道，还有她 2024 年首张个人专辑《Rosie》中的“Number One Girl”。

paras.en: ROSÉ’s mini-concert was for a high-profile audience, with Hollywood elites including Nicole Kidman, Timothée Chalamet, Anya Taylor-Joy, Monica Barbaro, Salma Hayek, Kim Kardashian, Sarah Paulson, Kylie Jenner and more attending the 2026 event. This year, the gala raised a record-breaking sum of nearly $7 million for the museum’s programming.
paras.zh: ROSÉ 的迷你音乐会面向高调观众，好莱坞精英包括妮可·基德曼、蒂莫西·柴勒梅德、安雅·泰勒-乔伊、莫妮卡·巴巴罗、萨尔玛·海耶克、金·卡戴珊、莎拉·保尔森、凯莉·詹纳等都参加了 2026 年的活动。今年，晚会为博物馆的节目筹得了近 700 万美元的创纪录资金。

paras.en: Watch ROSÉ perform at the LACMA Art+Film Gala below.
paras.zh: 观看下面 ROSÉ 在 LACMA 艺术+电影盛会上的表演。

articles.title: 15 Great Songs That Use the Wah-Wah Guitar Pedal & Its Funky, Fluid Feel
articles.author: Dan Rys

paras.en: This week, the family of session musician and Gene Autry and Frank Sinatra collaborator Del Casher announced that he had died on Oct. 1 at the age of 88. But Casher was not just a musician who played on several records with iconic artists: he was also the inventor of the wah-wah pedal, one of the most significant technical innovations in electric guitar history.
paras.zh: 本周，吉恩·奥特里 (Gene Autry) 和弗兰克·西纳特拉 (Frank Sinatra) 的合作者德尔·卡舍 (Del Casher) 的音乐家家人宣布他于 10 月 1 日去世，享年 88 岁。但卡舍不仅仅是一位与标志性艺术家一起演奏过多张唱片的音乐家：他还是哇音踏板的发明者，这是电吉他历史上最重要的技术创新之一。

paras.en: The story goes that Cashel, who had created the pedal and its instantly-recognizable tone shifter, showed off the pedal to Frank Zappa during a jam session with the Mothers of Invention in 1966; Zappa subsequently gave one to Jimi Hendrix, who made it the centerpiece of his guitar virtuosity across his short but wildly influential career. And Hendrix was hardly alone. From the late 1960s onward, hundreds, if not thousands, of rock guitarists utilized the pedal, either to craft distinctive riffs or to enhance and distort their solos, creating some of the most iconic recordings in recorded music history along the way.
paras.zh: 故事是这样的：卡舍尔发明了踏板及其立即可识别的变音器，他在 1966 年与发明之母的即兴演奏会上向弗兰克·扎帕展示了踏板；扎帕随后将一把吉他送给了吉米·亨德里克斯 (Jimi Hendrix)，吉米·亨德里克斯 (Jimi Hendrix) 在他短暂但极具影响力的职业生涯中，将这把吉他作为其精湛技艺的核心。亨德里克斯并不孤单。从 20 世纪 60 年代末开始，成百上千的摇滚吉他手使用踏板来创作独特的连复段或增强和扭曲他们的独奏，一路创造出音乐史上一些最具标志性的唱片。

paras.en: And lest anyone think the pedal’s use was limited to the classic rock set, it’s been used across a wide variety of different genres, from blues to funk to soul to heavy metal to hip-hop to hair metal to jam bands to grunge, and just about everything in between, with guitarists such as Eric Clapton, Jimmy Page, Eddie Hazel, Trey Anastasio, Jerry Cantrell, Kirk Hammett, Mike McCready and so many more all using it to twist and turn their tone around. (Famed Motown guitarist Melvin Ragin even earned the nickname “Wah Wah Watson” for — well, you can work that out.)
paras.zh: 为了避免有人认为该踏板的用途仅限于经典摇滚乐，它已被用于各种不同的流派，从布鲁斯到放克到灵魂到重金属到嘻哈到发金属到即兴乐队到垃圾摇滚，以及介于两者之间的几乎所有内容，埃里克·克莱普顿、吉米·佩奇、埃迪·黑兹尔、特雷·阿纳斯塔西奥、杰瑞·坎特雷尔、柯克·哈米特、迈克·麦克雷迪等吉他手都用它来扭转和扭曲。改变他们的语气。 （著名的汽车城吉他手 Melvin Ragin 甚至赢得了“Wah Wah Watson”的绰号——嗯，你可以算出来。）

paras.en: In honor of Cashel’s death and the impact his great invention had, here are 15 great songs that utilized the wah-wah pedal over the years.
paras.zh: 为了纪念卡舍尔的去世和他伟大发明的影响，这里有 15 首多年来使用哇音踏板的伟大歌曲。

paras.en: - Jimi Hendrix, “Voodoo Child (Slight Return)”
paras.zh: ——吉米·亨德里克斯，《巫毒之子（轻微回归）》

paras.en: - Cream, “White Room” Shortly after Hendrix made his grand statement, Eric Clapton — still in his supergroup era before embarking on his solo career — fell in love with the pedal, using it on several classic tracks across Cream’s discography. None stands out as boldly as “White Room,” with its swaggering solo grandstanding its way towards the song’s fade-out finale.
paras.zh: - Cream，“White Room” 在 Hendrix 发表了他的宏伟声明后不久，Eric Clapton（在开始他的独唱生涯之前仍处于超级组合时代）爱上了这个踏板，并在 Cream 唱片中的几首经典曲目中使用了它。没有一首歌曲能像《White Room》那样大胆地脱颖而出，其夸张的独奏以哗众取宠的方式走向歌曲的淡出结局。

paras.en: - Led Zeppelin, “Dazed and Confused” The wah swept its way through all of that era’s iconic guitarists — but rather than use it to push his guitar sound to the absolute limit within his solos, Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page took it to a creepy and haunting place. Page used its tone shimmering effect to create atmosphere on “Dazed and Confused” that almost sounded like a banshee wail at times. And this was separate from what he wound up getting into once he started messing around with theremins.
paras.zh: - Led Zeppelin，“Dazed and Confused” 哇音横扫了那个时代所有标志性吉他手的心，但 Led Zeppelin 吉他手 Jimmy Page 并没有用它来将他的吉他声音推向独奏中的绝对极限，而是将它带到了一个令人毛骨悚然和难以忘怀的地方。佩奇在《Dazed and Confused》中使用了其音调闪烁效果来营造气氛，有时听起来几乎像女妖的哀号。这与他开始摆弄特雷门琴后最终陷入的困境是不同的。

paras.en: - Frank Zappa, “Willie the Pimp” Just over a minute into this snarling, driving track off 1969’s Hot Rats, Zappa starts to go off, leaning into the weird and wiggly side of what a wah can produce — and then he doesn’t really stop for the proceeding eight-plus minutes, exploring up and down his fretboard and stretching what started as a tight band turning the screws into a sprawling adventure that weaves in and out of coherence but manages to stay locked in with his rhythm section all the same. It’s an exercise in the pedal’s versatility, to some degree; to another degree, it’s a mad scientist at work with his tools, following wherever they take him.
paras.zh: - Frank Zappa，“Willie the Pimp” 在 1969 年的《Hot Rats》中，这首咆哮的驾驶曲目刚过一分多钟，Zappa 就开始起步，倾向于哇音所能产生的怪异和摇摆的一面——然后他在接下来的八分多钟里并没有真正停下来，上下探索他的指板并拉伸最初是一支紧密的乐队，将螺丝拧成一个蜿蜒的冒险。连贯性，但仍然设法保持与他的节奏部分的锁定。在某种程度上，这是对踏板多功能性的锻炼；从另一个角度来说，这是一位疯狂的科学家，正在使用他的工具，跟随工具带他去任何地方。

paras.en: - The Temptations, “Papa Was a Rolling Stone” The wah sound here came from the aforementioned Wah Wah Watson, who joined the Motown house band the Funk Brothers in 1968 and brought his favored pedal into the legendary Detroit studio and onto its classic records. The Temptations track is defined by Watson’s slippery, almost juicy-wet wah chording, bringing the wah out of the realm of the solo and into the backbone of the song.
paras.zh: - The Temptations，“Papa Was a Rolling Stone” 这里的哇音来自前面提到的 Wah Wah Watson，他于 1968 年加入摩城乐队 Funk Brothers，并将他最喜欢的踏板带入传奇的底特律录音室并收录在其经典唱片中。 《诱惑》这首歌曲的特色是沃森那滑溜溜、几乎多汁的哇音和弦，将哇音从独奏领域带入了歌曲的主干。

paras.en: - Marvin Gaye, “Let’s Get It On” Is there a more iconic opening triplet than the wah-wah’d notes that open this Marvin Gaye classic? The very thought of it turns the romance of a room right up, and even though the wah doesn’t play much of a further role in the song — Gaye’s voice, as well as the horn and rhythm sections, really take over — it’s a statement of an opening. Commonly thought to be another Wah Wah Watson lick — he did play on the track — some say it was actually played on the record by Don Peake, a Motown session man. It’s unclear who actually it is on the record itself.
paras.zh: - 马文·盖伊 (Marvin Gaye)，《Let’s Get It On》 还有比马文·盖伊 (Marvin Gaye) 这部经典作品开头的哇哇音符更具标志性的开场三连音吗？一想到它就让整个房间的浪漫气氛变得扑面而来，尽管哇音在歌曲中并没有发挥太大的作用——盖伊的声音、喇叭和节奏部分真正占据了主导地位——但它是一个开场的声明。人们普遍认为这是另一首华华·沃森的歌曲——他确实在这首歌中演奏过——有人说这实际上是由摩城唱片公司的唐·皮克(Don Peake)在唱片上演奏的。目前还不清楚记录中的人到底是谁。

paras.en: - James Brown, “Funky President” There is so much about a wah pedal that informs various aspects of funk that it’s almost hard to keep track of it all — and you could argue that the wah here isn’t even the funkiest part of the song, or even the most essential piece of guitar work on it. (The metronomic rhythm guitar has as much to do with the feel.) But it’s another example of how it wormed its way into that particular art form given its wobbly affect — perfect for shaking the booty. Much like Curtis Mayfield’s “Freddie’s Dead,” the wah guitar is secondary here, though no less essential.
paras.zh: - James Brown，“Funky President” 哇音踏板涉及放克的各个方面，几乎很难跟踪所有内容 - 您可能会说，这里的哇音甚至不是歌曲中最放克的部分，甚至不是其中最重要的吉他作品。 （节拍节奏吉他与感觉也有很大关系。）但这也是它如何融入特定艺术形式的另一个例子，因为它的摇摆效果非常适合摇晃战利品。就像柯蒂斯·梅菲尔德的《弗雷迪之死》一样，哇音吉他在这里是次要的，但同样重要。

paras.en: - Funkadelic, “Maggot Brain” Funkadelic is one of the great funk bands of all time, being, alongside its sister act Parliament, the brainchild of Dr. Funkenstein himself George Clinton. But this track, one of Funkadelic’s most enduring, isn’t much of a funk song at all. Instead, it’s a clear-out showcase for guitarist Eddie Hazel, who was told — while on acid in the studio, as the story goes — to imagine that his mother had died; the result is him using the wah pedal to almost literally make his guitar sound like it was weeping for the better part of 10 minutes, one of the most emotional uses of the pedal in history.
paras.zh: - Funkadelic，“蛆脑” Funkadelic 是有史以来最伟大的放克乐队之一，与它的姊妹乐队Parliament 一样，都是Funkenstein 博士本人乔治·克林顿的创意。但这首歌曲是 Funkadelic 最经久不衰的歌曲之一，它根本算不上一首放克歌曲。相反，这对吉他手埃迪·哈泽尔来说是一个清晰的展示，正如故事所说，他在录音室里吸迷幻药时被告知想象他的母亲已经去世；他的母亲去世了。结果是他使用哇音踏板几乎让他的吉他听起来像是在哭泣，长达 10 分钟，这是历史上最情绪化的踏板使用之一。

paras.en: - Chicago, “25 or 6 to 4” Chicago is known for a lot of things, but this one is probably the band’s most famous song — and one of its most famous elements is the extended solo by lead guitarist Terry Kath, which starts off with a distorted rampage and then halfway through shifts into a wah-fevered whirling dervish as Kath climbs the fretboard. It stands out for its tone, and how much the pedal warps his guitar when he steps on it, showcasing clearly how its effect can border on the delirious.
paras.zh: - 芝加哥，“25 or 6 to 4” 芝加哥因很多事情而闻名，但这首歌可能是乐队最著名的歌曲 - 其中最著名的元素之一是主音吉他手特里·凯斯 (Terry Kath) 的延长独奏，这首歌曲以扭曲的狂暴开始，然后随着凯斯爬上指板，中途转变为哇音狂热的旋转苦行僧。它的突出之处在于它的音色，以及当他踩下踏板时踏板对吉他的扭曲程度，清楚地展示了它的效果如何近乎疯狂。

paras.en: - Isaac Hayes, “Theme From Shaft” Most might remember the shimmering keys or soaring strings being the standout from the “Shaft” theme song, but it’s the splashy wah that truly drives the song along in the undercurrent. It gave the groove that fluid feel that helped to define the track — and to propel it to No. 1 on the Hot 100, as well as to an Academy Award for best original song. That’d be the work of Charles “Skip” Pitts, who also worked with the Isley Brothers and as a Stax studio man, ultimately getting sampled left and right once hip-hop came along.
paras.zh: - Isaac Hayes，“Theme From Shaft” 大多数人可能还记得《Shaft》主题曲中闪闪发光的琴键或高耸的弦乐是最引人注目的，但真正推动这首歌在暗流中前进的是引人注目的哇音。它赋予了律动流畅的感觉，帮助定义了这首歌曲，并将其推向热门百强单曲榜第一，并获得奥斯卡最佳原创歌曲奖。那是 Charles “Skip” Pitts 的作品，他也曾与 Isley Brothers 合作，并且是 Stax 工作室的工作人员，最终在嘻哈音乐出现后左右采样。

paras.en: - Metallica, “Enter Sandman” There are several different iconic guitar tones on this Metallica classic — and this is far from the only one of their songs where Kirk Hammett uses it — but the wah, first in the background during the signature riff, then as the rocket fuel for Hammett’s solo, is the star of the show. It turns his notes into a primal shriek that is as effective as nightmare fuel as James Hetfield’s vocals or Lars Ulrich’s unforgiving drums.
paras.zh: - Metallica，“Enter Sandman” 在这部 Metallica 经典作品中，有几种不同的标志性吉他音调——这远不是 Kirk Hammett 使用它的唯一一首歌曲——但是哇音，首先在标志性的连复段中出现在背景中，然后作为 Hammett 独奏的火箭燃料，是整场演出的明星。它将他的音符变成了原始的尖叫，就像詹姆斯·海特菲尔德的歌声或拉斯·乌尔里希无情的鼓声一样有效，就像噩梦的燃料一样。

paras.en: - Guns N Roses, “Sweet Child O’ Mine” The riff that did more than anything else to turn Slash into a guitar god is a masterpiece in and of itself, and we mean to take nothing away from it. But his “Sweet Child O’ Mine” guitar solo is almost as famous, depending on who you talk to, and its sing-song lyrical quality comes not just through his flawless tone — a perfect meld of his hands and his Les Paul — but the wah on which he rocks when he kicks things into overdrove halfway through. It’s perfect Slash: always in control, yet seemingly always teetering on the edge of excess. Come to think of it, that encapsulates much of Guns N’ Roses’ first records, too.
paras.zh: - Guns N Roses，“Sweet Child O’ Mine” 这首 riff 比其他任何东西都更能将 Slash 变成吉他之神，它本身就是一件杰作，我们不想从它身上拿走任何东西。但他的“Sweet Child O’ Mine”吉他独奏几乎同样出名，这取决于你和谁交谈，它的歌唱抒情品质不仅来自于他完美的音色——他的双手和他的 Les Paul 的完美融合——还来自于他在中途把东西踢得太过时所发出的哇音。这是完美的 Slash：始终处于控制之中，但似乎总是在过度的边缘摇摇欲坠。想想看，这也概括了枪与玫瑰乐队第一张唱片的大部分内容。

paras.en: - Alice In Chains, “Man in the Box” The wah is often associated with funk, dance, wobble and overdriven solos — but Jerry Cantrell took it to another place entirely on Alice in Chains’ breakthrough hit “Man in the Box.” In his hands, it becomes a monster, distorting his guitar into a stomping, chomping machine with sinister intentions during the heavy riffing on the song’s verses, and then into cries of pain and agony on his subsequent solo. It’s a guitar sound that immediately contorts the face into a scowl, and the vocal-doubling effects he uses to echo Layne Staley’s voice gives it an extra heaviness that makes it extra evocative.
paras.zh: - Alice In Chains 的《Man in the Box》 哇音常常与放克、舞蹈、摇摆和过度驱动的独奏联系在一起，但 Jerry Cantrell 在 Alice in Chains 的突破性热门歌曲《Man in the Box》中完全将它带到了另一个地方。在他手中，它变成了一个怪物，在歌曲歌词的沉重重复中，将他的吉他扭曲成一台带有险恶意图的跺脚、咀嚼机器，然后在他随后的独奏中变成痛苦和痛苦的呼喊。这是一种吉他声音，立即使脸部扭曲成皱眉，他用来呼应 Layne Staley 声音的倍声效果赋予它额外的沉重感，使其更加令人回味。

paras.en: - Pearl Jam, “Go” It is funny to think that Pearl Jam and Alice In Chains are often grouped together, since outside of both being from Seattle the two bands ultimately had very little in common. But one thing that Alice guitarist Cantrell and PJ lead Mike McCready always shared was an enduring love for the wah pedal, and on this track, off Pearl Jam’s sophomore album Vs., is McCready at his most unhinged, using his wah pedal on a solo that goes beyond all concept of actual notes and pushes into almost pure emotion — like a runaway train, or a guttural scream in guitar form, elevating Eddie Vedder’s vocals into the stratosphere.
paras.zh: - Pearl Jam，“Go” 有趣的是，Pearl Jam 和 Alice In Chains 经常被放在一起，因为除了都来自西雅图之外，这两个乐队最终没有什么共同点。但 Alice 吉他手 Cantrell 和 PJ 主唱 Mike McCready 一直共有的一件事是对哇音踏板的持久热爱，在 Pearl Jam 的第二张专辑《Vs.》中，McCready 在独奏中使用了他的哇音踏板，超越了所有实际音符的概念，并推动了几乎纯粹的情感 - 就像失控的火车，或者吉他形式的喉音尖叫，将 Eddie Vedder 的声音提升到了平流层。

paras.en: - Phish, “The Moma Dance” Take your pick of Phish live, of course, because Trey Anastasio always brings out his wah pedal when it’s time to get into the funk no matter what actual song the band is playing — or indeed if they’re playing any recognizable song at all. But very few Phish songs are as defined by his staccato wah style as “The Moma Dance,” a fan favorite that often is used as the launchpad for a full-arena dance party, and that, of course, goes much harder in a live setting. Trey often uses his wah to enhance his solos — “Farmhouse” and “Ghost” are notable examples off the top — but “Moma” is one that is based upon this slippery groove that makes it impossible to stand still.
paras.zh: - Phish，“The Moma Dance” 当然，您可以选择现场的 Phish，因为无论乐队正在演奏什么歌曲，或者实际上他们正在演奏任何可识别的歌曲，当需要进入放克状态时，Trey Anastasio 总是会拿出他的哇音踏板。但很少有 Phish 歌曲能像《The Moma Dance》一样被他的断奏哇音风格所定义，这是一首深受粉丝喜爱的歌曲，经常被用作全场舞会的启动板，当然，这在现场环境中会更加困难。 Trey 经常使用他的哇音来增强他的独奏——“Farmhouse”和“Ghost”是著名的例子——但“Moma”是基于这种让人无法停滞不前的滑溜溜的节奏。

articles.title: Juan Atkins’ Catalog Surges 1,285% on Streaming After Producer’s Death
articles.author: Katie Bain

paras.en: The catalog of techno founder Juan Atkins has seen a massive streaming surge following the producer’s death on Oct. 31.
paras.zh: techno 创始人胡安·阿特金斯 (Juan Atkins) 于 10 月 31 日去世后，他的作品在流媒体上出现了大幅增长。

paras.en: Between Oct. 30 and Nov. 5, U.S. streams of Atkins’ catalog went up by 1,285%, according to Luminate. In the week of Oct. 23-29, Atkins’ catalog received 6,000 U.S. on-demand streams; following his death, the number rose to 86,000 U.S. on-demand streams. Similarly, Atkins’ global streams increased by 1,103% the same week.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，10 月 30 日至 11 月 5 日期间，美国阿特金斯目录的流量增加了 1,285%。 10 月 23 日至 29 日这一周，阿特金斯的目录收到了 6,000 个美国点播流；他去世后，美国点播流媒体数量增至 86,000 条。同样，阿特金斯的全球流量在同一周增长了 1,103%。

paras.en: Two of Atkins’ key side projects also saw significant streaming boosts. In the week of Oct. 30-Nov. 5, Cybotron — composed of Atkins and producer Rik Davis — boasted 84,000 total U.S. on-demand streams. That was up from 26,000 the week prior, representing a 228% increase. Founded in Detroit, Cybotron released its debut album, Enter, in 1983. Its key track, “Clear,” reached No. 52 on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs on Oct. 8, 1983 and was later sampled on Missy Elliott’s Timbaland-produced “Lose Control” in 2005. “Clear” ranked No. 77 on Billboard‘s 2025 list of the 100 Best Dance Songs of All Time.
paras.zh: 阿特金斯的两个关键副业项目也实现了流媒体的显着增长。 10月30日至11月30日这一周5 月 5 日，由 Atkins 和制作人 Rik Davis 组成的 Cybotron 拥有 84,000 个美国点播流媒体。这比前一周的 26,000 人增加了 228%。 Cybotron 成立于底特律，于 1983 年发行了首张专辑《Enter》。其主打歌曲《Clear》于 1983 年 10 月 8 日在热门 R&B/Hip-Hop 歌曲排行榜上排名第 52 位，随后在 2005 年 Missy Elliott 的 Timbaland 制作的《Lose Control》中进行了采样。《Clear》在 Billboard 2025 年最佳歌曲排行榜上排名第 77 位。史上 100 首最佳舞曲。

paras.en: Meanwhile, streams for Model 500, an Atkins solo alias, were up 492% following his death, rising from 8,000 to 46,000 U.S. on-demand streams week over week.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Atkins 的独奏别名 Model 500 的流媒体播放量在他去世后增长了 492%，从 8,000 个美国点播流媒体每周增加到 46,000 个。

paras.en: On Oct. 31, Atkins was found unresponsive in his hotel room in Mexico City before a scheduled performance. He was transported to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead shortly after arriving. No cause of death has been announced.
paras.zh: 10 月 31 日，在预定的演出之前，阿特金斯被发现在墨西哥城的酒店房间里失去了知觉。他被送往医院，抵达后不久就被宣布死亡。死因尚未公布。

paras.en: Atkins is a founder of techno, a genre he co-created alongside Kevin Saunderson and Derrick May as part of The Belleville Three — so-called because the trio initially worked in the Detroit suburb of Belleville. His productions are credited for presenting not only new sounds but new sonic worlds, with fellow techno pioneer Jeff Mills remembering Atkins as being “among a rare and select group of visionary musicians who helped construct a bridge into the 21st century.”
paras.zh: 阿特金斯是 techno 的创始人，他与凯文·桑德森 (Kevin Saunderson) 和德里克·梅 (Derrick May) 共同创造了这种流派，作为“贝尔维尔三人组”的一部分——之所以这么称呼是因为三人组最初在底特律郊区的贝尔维尔工作。他的作品不仅呈现了新的声音，而且还呈现了新的声音世界，技术先驱杰夫·米尔斯 (Jeff Mills) 回忆阿特金斯时，他是“一群罕见且精选的富有远见的音乐家之一，他们帮助构建了通往 21 世纪的桥梁”。

paras.en: Following his death, Atkins was also fondly remembered by an array of fellow electronic music producers around the world.
paras.zh: 阿特金斯去世后，世界各地的许多电子音乐制作人也深切地怀念他。

articles.title: CAA Wants to Create an AI-Generated Celebrity Advertising Machine
articles.author: Winston Cho

paras.en: Celebrity ads are getting an AI makeover.
paras.zh: 名人广告正在接受人工智能改造。

paras.en: Powerhouse ad agency Ogilvy announced on Monday that it’s partnering with CAA to launch ECHO, an AI platform that allows marketers to whip up AI-generated ads featuring celebrities. The collaboration opens the door for talent to take on more endorsement deals without having to spend much more time shooting commercials while safeguarding how their digital replicas are used.
paras.zh: 广告巨头奥美周一宣布，它与 CAA 合作推出 ECHO，这是一个人工智能平台，允许营销人员制作由人工智能生成的名人广告。此次合作为人才开启了接受更多代言交易的大门，而无需花费更多时间拍摄广告，同时保护其数字复制品的使用方式。

paras.en: The platform utilizes what CAA calls its “vault,” a database that captures, stores and licenses the digital likeness, voice and intellectual property of clients who opt in. With ECHO, brands will be able to create a portfolio of media-ready assets off of a short shoot, potentially reducing costs by as much as 75 percent and vastly reducing turnaround time, the companies said. Talent must sign off on every ad, with automated compliance engines checking AI-generated materials against contracts and brand safety guidelines. The major talent agency did not disclose which A-listers opted in to the effort.
paras.zh: 该平台利用 CAA 所谓的“金库”，这是一个数据库，可以捕获、存储和许可选择加入的客户的数字肖像、声音和知识产权。两家公司表示，借助 ECHO，品牌将能够在短期内创建媒体就绪资产组合，从而有可能降低高达 75% 的成本，并大大缩短周转时间。人才必须签署每条广告，并使用自动合规引擎根据合同和品牌安全准则检查人工智能生成的材料。这家主要的经纪公司没有透露哪些一线明星选择了这项工作。

paras.en: “We built The CAA Vault to ensure that talent owns, controls, and can safely monetize their digital likeness on their own terms and only with their consent,” said CAA head of strategic development Alex Shannon. “By connecting The CAA Vault to Ogilvy’s ECHO platform, CAA is giving many of the world’s leading brands a secure, consent-first activation layer, delivering full visibility and protection for talent and high-craft, verified creative at the speed of culture for brands.”
paras.zh: CAA 战略发展主管 Alex Shannon 表示：“我们建立 CAA Vault 是为了确保人才拥有、控制他们的数字肖像，并能够按照自己的条件，并且只有在他们同意的情况下，安全地将他们的数字肖像货币化。” “通过将 CAA Vault 连接到奥美的 ECHO 平台，CAA 为许多世界领先品牌提供了一个安全的、同意优先的激活层，以品牌文化的速度为人才和高工艺、经过验证的创意提供全面的可见性和保护。”

paras.en: ECHO’s workflow can be integrated directly into standard post-production tools. A traditional asset shoot of eight to 10 assets can be expanded into roughly 30 to 50 for the creation of ads taking advantage of buzzy TikTok trends, CAA and Oglivy said. All consumer-facing products will carry a visible watermark that reads, “[Talent Name] Approved | Recreated with AI”.
paras.zh: ECHO 的工作流程可以直接集成到标准后期制作工具中。 CAA 和 Oglivy 表示，传统的 8 到 10 项资产拍摄可以扩展到大约 30 到 50 项，以便利用热门的 TikTok 趋势来制作广告。所有面向消费者的产品都将带有可见的水印，上面写着“[人才姓名]已批准|用人工智能重新创建”。

paras.en: In a statement, Ogilvy CEO Laurent Ezekiel said the tool solves the “fundamental tension between speed, scale and trust” in the AI era. “We are giving our clients unprecedented competitive advantage – allowing them to lead culture in real time with total trust and uncompromised craft.”
paras.zh: 奥美首席执行官 Laurent Ezekiel 在一份声明中表示，该工具解决了人工智能时代“速度、规模和信任之间的根本紧张关系”。 “我们为客户提供了前所未有的竞争优势——让他们能够以完全的信任和不妥协的工艺实时引领文化。”

paras.en: The tools represents the interest in monetizing the commercial use of celebrities’ digital likenesses and, perhaps, changing views among consumers regarding the deployment of AI. Brands have largely been hesitant to wade into those waters due to pushback against deepfakes and unauthorized AI use but acceptance appears to be growing.
paras.zh: 这些工具代表了人们对将名人数字肖像的商业用途货币化的兴趣，或许还改变了消费者对人工智能部署的看法。由于深度造假和未经授权的人工智能使用的抵制，品牌在很大程度上对涉足这些领域犹豫不决，但接受度似乎正在增长。

paras.en: Last month, the likeness of 1930s movie star Greta Garbo was revived in an ad from Swedish ball-bearings market SKF. ECHO is among the first to build an infrastructure around celebrities who opt into the usage of their digital replicas in ads.
paras.zh: 上个月，瑞典滚珠轴承市场 SKF 的一则广告中再次出现了 20 世纪 30 年代电影明星葛丽泰·嘉宝 (Greta Garbo) 的形象。 ECHO 是首批围绕选择在广告中使用其数字复制品的名人建立基础设施的公司之一。

paras.en: “We are witnessing the ‘NIL moment’ between advertising and entertainment,” said Ogilvy chief innovation officer Carol Reed. “Instead of fearing AI or using it to produce cheap volume, building ECHO in partnership with CAA proves that technology can protect artists while setting storytellers free. Our global research confirms that consumers don’t want AI to sideline the artist; they want explicit proof that the talent is in control.”
paras.zh: 奥美首席创新官卡罗尔·里德表示：“我们正在见证广告和娱乐之间的‘零时刻’。” “与 CAA 合作建立 ECHO 不是害怕人工智能或利用它来生产廉价产品，而是证明技术可以保护艺术家，同时让讲故事的人获得自由。我们的全球研究证实，消费者不希望人工智能让艺术家边缘化；他们想要明确的证据来证明人才处于控制之中。”

articles.title: Skydance Details Cost Savings and Plans HBO Max-Paramount+ Bundle in First Post-Deal Earnings Report
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: Skydance, in its first earnings report after completing its megadeal for Warner Bros. Discovery, outlined where it expects to drive synergies and cost savings and teased a bundle of HBO Max and Paramount+ for early 2027, as well as an investor day in the first half of next year.
paras.zh: Skydance 在完成与华纳兄弟探索频道的大型交易后发布的第一份收益报告中，概述了预计将在哪些方面推动协同效应和成本节约，并预告将在 2027 年初推出 HBO Max 和派拉蒙 + 捆绑包，并在明年上半年举办投资者日活动。

paras.en: The company reported Q3 earnings Monday afternoon, with revenue of $7 billion, net earnings of $73 million and adjusted EBITDA of $1 billion, all skewed a bit by the fact that the WBD deal did not close until after the quarter ended. As a result, none of WBD’s results are included in the report, which was authored by CEO David Ellison and co-CEO Ynon Kreiz.
paras.zh: 该公司周一下午公布了第三季度财报，营收为 70 亿美元，净利润为 7300 万美元，调整后 EBITDA 为 10 亿美元，但由于 WBD 交易直到季度结束后才完成，所有这些都略有偏差。因此，WBD 的任何业绩均未包含在由首席执行官 David Ellison 和联席首席执行官 Ynon Kreiz 撰写的报告中。

paras.en: Instead, it is the deal and what it means for Skydance’s future that will dominate the earnings conversation, with the looming bundle surely top of mind for investors and consumers, ahead of an inevitable merger of the services in the future. The move is similar to Disney’s approach with Hulu, where those two services remain distinct, but also have become increasingly intertwined.
paras.zh: 相反，这笔交易及其对 Skydance 未来的意义将主导收益讨论，在未来不可避免的服务合并之前，即将到来的捆绑交易无疑是投资者和消费者最关心的问题。此举类似于迪士尼对 Hulu 的做法，这两项服务仍然截然不同，但也变得越来越相互交织。

paras.en: As for where the cost savings will be found?
paras.zh: 至于成本节约会体现在哪里呢？

paras.en: Skydance says it expects at least $2.2 billion from corporate overhead, real estate and facilities as they rationalize office space and eliminate duplicitous corporate roles; $1 billion from marketing by streamlining spend and utilizing their own platforms for more promotional work; $1.2 billion from technology as they unify tech stacks and products; $1.4 billion from procurement and vendor management.
paras.zh: Skydance 表示，预计公司管理费用、房地产和设施将至少获得 22 亿美元，以合理化办公空间并消除双重的公司角色；通过简化支出并利用自己的平台进行更多促销工作，从营销中获得 10 亿美元； 12 亿美元来自技术，因为它们统一了技术堆栈和产品； 14 亿美元来自采购和供应商管理。

paras.en: The company also says that it sees an opportunity for savings in content, though it reiterated that it still expects to spend $30 billion on content each year.
paras.zh: 该公司还表示，它看到了节省内容的机会，不过它重申，仍预计每年在内容上花费 300 亿美元。

paras.en: “With the reach of our combined platforms across streaming, broadcast and cable, each title can work harder for us, and as one company we can make smarter choices about how we distribute and monetize our slate,” the executives wrote.
paras.zh: 高管们写道：“凭借我们跨流媒体、广播和有线电视的综合平台的影响力，每一款游戏都可以为我们带来更大的帮助，作为一家公司，我们可以在如何分发和货币化我们的产品上做出更明智的选择。”

articles.title: Jessica Lange on Bringing ‘Long Day’s Journey Into Night’ Back to the Big Screen, Returning to ‘American Horror Story’ and Retirement Rumors
articles.author: Scott Feinberg

paras.en: “You age out of a lot of parts, that’s just the nature of things,” Jessica Lange, the legendary stage and screen actress, said during a recent recording of The Hollywood Reporter’s Awards Chatter podcast at the Virginia Film Festival, where she was being honored with the fest’s Visionary Award. The 77-year-old, who also brought to the fest her latest film, a big-screen adaptation of Long Day’s Journey Into Night, was discussing the possibility of retirement and continued, “I wouldn’t mind ending on Mary Tyrone [the protagonist of Long Day’s Journey, a morphine addict in 1912 Connecticut], let me tell you. I would embrace that, because there’s no greater part I’m ever going to play.”
paras.zh: “随着年龄的增长，你会失去很多角色，这就是事物的本质，”传奇舞台和银幕女演员杰西卡·兰格最近在弗吉尼亚电影节上录制《好莱坞报道者奖喋喋不休》播客时说道，她在该节上获得了该电影节的远见奖。这位 77 岁的老人还给电影节带来了她的最新电影，一部改编自《长夜之旅》的大银幕电影，她正在讨论退休的可能性，并继续说道：“让我告诉你，我不介意以玛丽·蒂龙（《长日之旅》的主角，1912 年康涅狄格州的一名吗啡成瘾者）作为结局。我会接受这一点，因为我不会扮演更伟大的角色。”

paras.en: One of only 24 people ever and one of only 10 people still living who have won the “triple crown of acting,” as in, at least one Oscar, Emmy and Tony (she has won two, three and one, respectively), Lange has been a screen actress for 50 years. She made her film debut after being “discovered,” while working part-time as a model, and cast by producer Dino De Laurentiis in his large-scale remake of King Kong (1976). She received a huge publicity build-up, even appearing on the cover of TIME magazine. But the film proved to be such a giant flop that, she explains during this conversation, it shattered her self-confidence and almost destroyed her career.
paras.zh: 兰格是有史以来仅有的 24 名获得过“表演三重王冠”的人之一，也是仅有的 10 名仍在世的获得过“表演三重王冠”的人之一，例如至少一项奥斯卡奖、艾美奖和托尼奖（她分别赢得了两项、三项和一项），兰格已经成为银幕女演员 50 年了。她在被“发现”后首次亮相电影，当时她兼职做模特，并在制片人迪诺·德·劳伦蒂斯 (Dino De Laurentiis) 的大型翻拍版《金刚》(1976) 中出演。她获得了巨大的知名度，甚至出现在《时代》杂志的封面上。但事实证明，这部电影是一次巨大的失败，她在这次谈话中解释说，这粉碎了她的自信，几乎毁掉了她的职业生涯。

paras.en: Slowly but surely, though, she rose from the ashes, first with a supporting turn in Bob Fosse’s All That Jazz (1979), then with unforgettable lead performances in films such as Bob Rafelson’s The Postman Always Rings Twice (1981), Graeme Clifford’s Frances and Sydney Pollack’s Tootsie (both 1982, and both of which brought her Oscar nominations, the latter resulting in her first win), Richard Pearce’s Country (1984), Karel Reisz’s Sweet Dreams (1985), Bruce Beresford’s Crimes of the Heart (1986), Costa-Gavras’s Music Box (1989), Martin Scorsese’s Cape Fear (1991) and Tony Richardson’s Blue Sky (1994, for which she won her second Oscar).
paras.zh: 不过，她慢慢地从灰烬中崛起，首先是在鲍勃·福斯的《爵士乐》（1979年）中担任配角，然后在鲍勃·拉菲尔森的《邮差总是按两次铃》（1981年）、格雷姆·克利福德的《弗朗西斯》和西德尼·波拉克的《图西》（均为1982年）等电影中令人难忘的主演表演，这两部电影都为她带来了奥斯卡提名，后者为她带来了第一个奥斯卡提名。胜）、理查德·皮尔斯的《乡村》（1984年）、卡雷尔·雷兹的《甜蜜的梦》（1985年）、布鲁斯·贝雷斯福德的《心灵之罪》（1986年）、科斯塔-加夫拉斯的《音乐盒》（1989年）、马丁·斯科塞斯的《开普恐惧》（1991年）和托尼·理查森的《蓝天》（1994年，她因此第二次获得奥斯卡奖）。

paras.en: Then, as she became a mother and entered her forties, a mid-career malaise set in. For a number of years, she worked far less frequently, more often in supporting roles, and rarely in projects that excited her. That changed with the HBO limited series Grey Gardens (2009), for which she won an Emmy, and a result of her association with producer Ryan Murphy, which began soon after and encompassed four seasons of the anthology series American Horror Story (2011-2015), two of which brought her Emmys, and a single season of the limited series Feud: Bette and Joan (2017).
paras.zh: 然后，当她成为一名母亲并进入四十多岁时，职业生涯中期的不适开始出现。多年来，她工作的频率大大降低，更多的是担任配角，很少从事让她兴奋的项目。这种情况随着 HBO 限定剧《灰色花园》（2009 年）的推出而改变，她凭借该剧获得了艾美奖，同时也是她与制片人瑞恩·墨菲合作的结果。该合作很快就开始了，包括选集系列剧《美国恐怖故事》（2011-2015 年）的四季（其中两季为她赢得了艾美奖），以及限定剧《宿敌：贝蒂与琼》（2017 年）的单季。

paras.en: But no part has enchanted her more than Tyrone in Long Day’s Journey Into Night, which she first played on the London stage in 2000 (becoming the first American actress to receive an Olivier Award nomination) and then reprised on Broadway in 2016 (winning a Tony).
